thar lam gsal ba'i rjesan me/sku bcar rnam rgyal grwa tshang ston bde legs bshad gling gi shes yon lhan tshogs nas bod rgyal lo 2137phyi lo 2010lor par thengs dang por deb grangs 20༷༷dpar 'grems zhus pa dge'o//dusa'i12781140285 0032010sa11112615135khungagaX'ibu07911265261 06326906115626657776571140pa'ibya khupagasgalagaya ba'i1278110285 khubasta012'brelayugazhal byang /smos561429024512212 0 501007675) —1762192681813818215khrisamasalnga'i(5 2 )(ga214131 01892—221492775 01892—221410011 91—92184—14777792184—157772—1311 ba'i7657110235spyoXs6)21811 007

phab ra zhu ba po'i sngon gleng / (8)phab sgyur zhu ba po'i sngon gleng /da༅༅/ /lhar bcas srid zhi'i rnam 'dren 'dzam gling zhi bde'i ded dpon/ rang cag gangs can pa rnams kyi chos srid gnyis kyi 'dren mchog bla na ma mchis pa/ sa steng rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mabosgon chen po ma:snag gis cha lugs dang skad rigs mi 'dra ba'i snyigs dus kyi bgrang yas 'gro ba rnams kyi rang rang gi dad pa dang bsod nams/khams dang mos pa/ dbang po rno rtul dang / bag la nyal sesgogs kyi gnas tshul dang 'tshams par zab gsal gsung gi nying bcud ji snyed cig rgyun mi chad du stsal ba las/ da lan phyi lo 2004 zla 3 tshes 7 nas 21 bar bdun phrag gnyis lhag tsam ring bzhugs sgar theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du dpyid chos chen mor rdza dpal sprul gyi gsung rdzogs pa chen po slong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang / kun mkhyen slong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gsesgo/ rnal 'gyor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i rnam mgur bcas gsung cesas bka' drin bskyangs pa'i skabs kyi nyin re'i sngon 'gro'i gsung chos rnams dang /phyi lo 2008 lo'i zla 2 tshes 21 nyin te cho 'phrul dus chen nyin gyi zhakhrungs rabs gsung chos skabs dge sdig blang dor skor gyi bka' chos de nyid kha skong

(7) phab sgyur zhu ba po'i sngon gleng /gi tshul dang bcas yig thog phab 'bri zhus te phyogs gcig tu legs bsgrigs zhus pa yin/de yang mgon po gang nyid nas sngon 'gro'i gsung chos su chos lugs tshang ma'i dmigs yul ni mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams la phan bde skrun rgyu gcig mtshungs yin pas chos lugs phan tshun mthun lam 'o chu gcig 'dres ltar dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab pa dang / lhag par nang chos kyi zab khyad shes pa'i thog nas sdig spong dge sgrub kyis 'dod pa'i bde ba sgrub thabs dang / mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal sel thabs sesgogs las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag rten 'byung gi lta ba dang bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag tshogs gnyis gsog tshul dang byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon/ tshad ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten nas rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i bosgo 'phang sgrub thabs serdzogs sa lam rim bgrod kyis mthar thug thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar blang dor 'jug ldos dang / sa lam bgrod tshul gyi thar pa'i lam bzang gsal bar mdzad pa'i sgron me dang / yid gdung sel ba'i bdud gi sam nyi'i dra ba gcod pa'i ral gri/ rmongs mun sel ba'i snang byed dam pa sogs su 'gyur ba gdon mi za zhing /lhag par mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dgongs bcud gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu lta bde la nyan spyo zhing / yid la 'jug che ba ma zad nyams len byed sla ba sogs khyad du 'phags pa'i 'phags chos du ma dang ldan pas na/ 7gong sa 7skyabs

phab ra zhu ba d+ku sngon gleng/ (6)mgon chen po mchog nas dus rabs gnyer gcig pa'i nang pa zhig dang / nang pa shes yon can zhig byed dgos pa dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i bod mi zhig dang / 'dab ga3stog gnyis ldan gyi bod phrug shes ldan pa zhig byed dgos pa'i rin bral gyi bka' slob zab mo yang yang stsal ba'i rlabs chen gyi dgongs pa'i cha shas la sman thabs su bka' slob phyogs sgrig dang / bka' chos yig 'bebs kyis dpar bskrun zhu rgyu'i las 'char khongs nas da lan kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung gi bka' chos skabs kyi nyin re'i sngon 'gro'i gsung chos rnams phyogs btus yig thog phab 'bri zhus te dpar 'grems zhus pa yin/las gzhi 'di'i thog dpal ldan sku sger yig tshang gi sku zhabs byam sa bstan lags nas zhu dag 'drongs nges dang / lam ston gyi bka' slob lhug rtsol mdzad pa ma zad/ dpal ldan sku sger yig tshang nas par skrun gyi bka' lusal stsal gnang bcas la gus pas snying dbus nas thugs rje bka' drin bla med du che zhes zhu rgyu dang / gang gi ched du dmigs pa'i da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs rnams nas mgon po gang gi rin bral gyi bka' slob rnams la lta klog nyan gsum sogs slob spyong mthar phyin bgyis te mgon po gang gi thugs re ji ltar bcangs pa ltar chos srid gang thad nas 7rgyal dbang mchog gi rlabs chen gyi thugs bzhed sgrub pa zhig dang / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du gyur pa zhig gnang rgyu ni rang cag rnams kyi g.yol du med pa'i las 'gan lags na de

(0) phab sgyur zhu ba po'i sngon gleng/don phyag len du cis kyang mdzad par 'tshal lo zhes re skul zhu rgyu yin/bka' slob phyag deb 'di nyid zhu sgrig dang dpar skrun sogs gang thad nas bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde thabs serdzogs kyi zhabs 'degs la sman thabs lhag bsam hur bskyed zhu khul lags kyang / da dung nyes skyon gyi rigs mchis tshe gzur gnas mkhas dbang rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'bosgog gi dbeshangs 'char lhug stsol yong ba'i re ba dang / 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge bas thugs rje bka' drin gyi bdag nyid/ bstan srid rang dbang dang bcas pa'i bde rtsalagong sa 7skyabs mabordzon chen po mchog mtha' klas bstan 'gro'i mgordzon dpung dam par sku tshe 7zhabs pad yun du brtan cing / mdzad 'phrin kun gsal yangs pa'i pha mthar khyab pa ma zad/ rlabs chen gyi thugs bzhed mtha' dag gegs med lhun gyis grub pa dang / gzhis byes rje 'bangs lhan 'dzoms kyi skal bzang dga' ston myur du 'char te gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med /bang chen sto pho brang po ta la nas zab rgyas kyi tshasnas char 'bebs pa'i smon 'dun bcas/ gus rnam grwa thub bstan yar 'phel pas phyi lo 2010 zla 11 pa'i tshes 27 la//

lkotsho/ mu ba〉 ༷/ pa ritā/(ciX — snyegong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 1bstan pa'i byung rim dang / nang chos ngo spyod/da༅༅/ /thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i ston pa bka' drin can gang des bskal pa grangs med pa'i ring la tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags par mdzad nas/ dgos pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can rnams kyi ched du mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ shing / de ltar chos kyi dbyings las g.yo ba med bzhin du sprul pa'i rol gar sna tshogs su 'phro ba dang bral yang / lo ngo rnyis stong lnga brgya'i gong du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ston mchog shākya seṅge sku bltams shing / de nas rim gyis mngon par rab tu byung / lo drug dka' spyad la sogs pa mdzad/ mthar mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas gdul bya'i khams dang mo sa pa dang 'tshams par chos kyi gabor lo ji snyed cig gsungs pa las/ rab dang phul dang mchog tu gyur pa ni/sher phyin gyi mdo nas gsungs pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid kyi skor ston pa'i gzhung rnams dang /bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ de nas stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rgyud bla ma'i shes byed kyi

(1) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo spyod/rtsaba'i mdo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pa'i skabs nas bstan pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi snying po de yin/de lta bu'i bsam pa kun rdzob byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i thog nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i stong nyid snying rje dbyer ma mchis pa/ mdor na sngags bla med kyi skabs nas rtsal tu bton nas gsungs pa'i gnyug ma'i 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang byung gi rig pa'am rig pa kun tu bzang po de gnyis rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs mthar thug de yin/ de lta bu'i ston pa bka' drin can gyis zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul de dag ladron skyong spel gsum gnang mkhan thogs me da sku mched nas bzung ste/ de yang gtso bo 'phags pa thogs med nas rgya chen spyodad rgyud kyi bka' bab dang / mgon po klu sgrub nas zab mo lta rgyud kyi bka' bab/ de nas grub chen sa rā ha dang / yin dra bho dhi/ rgyal po dza la sogs pa de dag nas phal cher nyams len byin rlabs rgyud kyi rgyud pa'i bka' bab pa yin zhes brjod chog gi med dam snyam/ de lta bu'i rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs tshul ma tshang ba med pa zhig ston pa'i rjes 'brang gi mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug skyes mchog de rnams nas nye bar brgyud pa dang /de nas bod gangs can gyi ljongs su chos rgyal tho ri gnyan btsan dang / chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus nas mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dbu thog mar tshugs pa yin/ des nas rim bzhin 'dus

tshos 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (3)sde btsugs pa'i thog nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum rgya cher spel ba ni mkhan slob chos gsum rnams kyi thugs rje bka' drin la brten nas bod gangs can gyi ljongs la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ha lam 'gran zla med pa lta bu theg pa che chung sngags dang bcas pa cha tshang ba'i chos tshul 'di lta bu zhig byung ba yin/de nas bstan pa la dar gud 'phel grib sna tshogs shig byung zhing / dus kyi cha nas sod gangs can gyi ljongs la snga 'gyur rnying ma dang / gsar ma zhes sde tshan gnyis las/ gsar ma la jo bo bka' gdams pa zhes pa'i sde tshan gcig ste/ 'di ni gtso po thun mong ba'i lam rim byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems nyams bzhes gtso 'don gnang ba las gsang sngags cher mi mdzad par/gsang sngags ches shin tu gsang zhing sbas pa'i sgo nas sgrub par mdzad kyi yod pa las/ de min yongs grags khyab brdal mi gnang ba'i jo bo bka' gdams pa'i rgyud pa gcig dang / de nas nā ro pa nas nye bar brgyud pa'i mar pa dang /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ ras byung rdo rje grags pa sogs nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po'am bka' brgyud pa ste/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje nas bzung bka' phyag chu sto gnyis 'dris kyi tshul te/ mdor na jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lam rim de rnams gzhi la bzhag nas nyams bzhes kyi mthil du 'dzin pa'i thog la gsang sngags bla med kyi chos 'khor nyams bzhes gtso 'don gnang ba'i bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi

(3) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo spyod/bka' brgyud pa'i rgyud pa gcigade bzhin gtso bo rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub chen bir wa pa nas nye bar brgyud pa'i sa chen dkar po rnam gsum dang / de nas sa skya paṇa chen/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs sa chen gong ma rnam lnga nas nye bar brgyud pa ste/ de yang snang gsum gyi skabs su lam rim gyi 'gro tshul gcig mtshungs yin la/ de nas rgyud gsum gyi skabs nas bzung gsang sngags spyi dang / lhag par gsang sngags bla med kyi gnyug ma'i ye shes rtsal tu bton nas nyams len gnang ba dang / lam 'bras tshogs bshad dang / lam 'bras slob bshad bcas las thun mong ma yin pa ni lam 'bras slob bshad nas brgyud pa'i dpal sa skya pa'am lam 'bras pa/ de nas phyis su 'jam mabosnan bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos rtsab jo bo rje'am bka' gdams rnying ma'i phyag srol rnams rtsabar bzhag thog gsang ba 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bla med kyi rgyud gzhung rnams rtsal 'don gnang ba bcas nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams gsar mtham ri bo dge ldan pa dang / gzhan yang jo nang gi brgyu da pa de dang de la sogs pa'i skabs dang dus mi 'dra ba la thugs bskyed smon lam dus su smin pa'i mkhas grub kyi skyes bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyis rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams myong gi thog nas gdul bya 'khrid lugs mdzad pa'i thog nas chos rgyud mi 'dra ba byung yod pa 'di ltar yin/

( 3 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (8)47 rgyagaradusnga 'gyur rnying ma dang gsar ma zhes med par bod du dus tshod kyi cha nas rgyud rim de rnams byung ba yin/ de thams cad ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brang gcig gyur zhig dang / dpal nā len+d+ra'i mkhas pa'i dbang phyug mgon po klu sgrub serdzogs nas brgyud pa gcig gyur chags 〈snad/ tshang ma bsam pa kun slong gi cha nas bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems nyams bzhes mthil du bzung ba zhig yin pas na/theg chen gyi chos dgor gcig gyur yin la/ lta ba'i cha nas yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug mgon po klu sgrub kyis ji ltar bkral ba ltar gyi grub mtha' mthar thug dbu ma pa dang / de'i nang nas tha snyad du yang rang mtshan zhal gyis mi bzhes pa'i dbu ma pa de ga'i lugs gtso bor byed pa de yin pa gsal po yin/ spyir snga 'gyur rnying ma'i nang du phal cher 'di ltar dpyad na mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho nas brgyud pa'i rnam grangs pa'i don dam bden pa dang / rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam bden pa zhes pa lta bu'i thog nas gsung tshul te/ phal cher dbu ma'i brgyud pa rong zom paṇ+ḍi ta la sesgogs pas dbu ma rang rgyud pa zhal gyis bzhes pa gtso bor gnang gi yod ces gsung tshul yod/ ngas thag chod pa zhig mi shes/ gang ltar kun mkhyen slong chen rab 'byams pa dang /de bzhin kun mkhyen 'jegs med gling pa/ rdza dpal sprul rin sto che dang / khong gi sras kyi thu bo lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma/ de nas mkhan po ngag chung / rdo grub

(6) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo sprod/'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ sprul sku tshul blo sogs kyi gsung rnams ngas cung zad mjal myong yod pa yin/ de rnams kyis phyi nang gi dag pa dang ma dag pa'i chos gang zhig yin yang chos rnams rang ngos nas ma grub pa'i gzhi med rtsabral zhes gsungs yod/ de yang gzhi med rtsabral zhes pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug thal 'gyur lugs de nyid yin pa dang / tha snyad du yang rang mtshan zhal gyis mi bzhes pa de ga'i thog tu 'gro gi yod pa gsal po yin/ ci des na lta ba'i cha nas thams cad dbu ma thal gyur pa'am dpal mabo(na 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa mthar zug gsungs pa ste/ mdor na spros pa'i tshogs rnams nye bar zhi ba dang / yod med kyi spros pa mtha' dag las 'das pa zhes skabs re tshig gi gsung tshul mi 'dra ba'am rang rang gi sgos chos lta bu'i thog nas mi 'dra ba yong gi yod/ de thams cad dbu ma pa mthar thug gi lta ba gcig gyur yin pa dang / byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems nyams len gyi mthil du yod pa yang gcig gyur yin zhing / de'i thog la gsang sngags bla med kyi gnyug ma'i 'od gsal lam du byed pa'i gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa de nyid rtsal 'don gnang mkhan tshang ma gcig mtshungs yin/ gnyug ma'i ye shes rtsal tu bton pa 'dra mtshungs la/ dper na/ gsar ma la cha bzhag na/ dpal gsor lo sdom pa'i skabs nas gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rtsal tu bton nas gsung gi yod pa dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs su yang gnyug ma'i 'od gsal

cing ri 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen sa mchog (1)rtsal tu bton nas gsung gi yod/ de bzhin dpal dus kyi lubor lo'i skabs su'ang gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rtsal du bton nas gsung gi yod/ 'on kyang rtsal tu 'don lugs mi 'dra ba yong gi yod pa yin/de bzhin dpal sa skya pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug gam 'khor 'das dbyer med lta bu gsung skabs gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rtsal du bton nas gsung gi yerdzod/ bka' rgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po gsung skabs kyang gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rtsal du bton nas gsung gi yod/ rdzogs pa chen po mkhregs chos kyi nyams len gnang skabs kyang gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rtsal du bton nas gsung gi yod/'on kyang rtsal du 'don lugs phran bu mi m+wa ba phal cher yong gi yod pa yin/ dper na / skyes pa mahā yo ga dang / lung a nu yo ga rdzogs pa chen po a ti 'byu ga zhes gsung skabs yin rgyu gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de sngags nang pa gsum char gyi gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de lam du byed pa zhig gsung gi yod/ 'on kyang skyes pa mahā yo ga'i skabs su gnyug ma'i 'od gsal bstan gyi yod kyang /bskyed rim dang rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su yang gnyug ma'i 'od gsal gyi nyams len zhig gsung gi yod pa yin/ lung a nu yo ga gsung skabs kyang lha yi rnal 'gyor yod kyang rgyas bsdus yod/ dper na gsang sngags gsar ma'i nang du gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs su gsungs pa ltar las dang po ba dang /ye shes pa cung zad babs pa/ ye shes la cung zad dbang thob pa/ ye shes la yang

(2) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo spyod/dag par dbang thob pa bcas gnas skabs bzhi gsung gi mardzod/ gnas skabs bzhi po der lha sku bskyed pa rgyas bsdus yod pa yin/ de bzhin skyes pa mahā yo ga'i skabs su skad cig dran rdzogs byas nas bskyed pa gnang gi yod/mdor na tha mal pa'i snang zhen bkag nas lha yi snang zhen bskyed dgos pa gcig mtshungs chags kyi yod/ gang ltar lung a nu yo ga'i rtsarlung thig le'i gnad du bsnun sa gtso bo de yin la/ de la brten nas gnyug ma'i 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i chos tshul zhig gsung gi yod/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga gsung skabs/ de la nang gses kyis sems sde dang / slong sde/ man ngag gi sde zhes rtsab gnyug ma'i 'od gsal ston pa sha stag yin/ 'on kyang gnyug ma'i 'od gsal ston stangs la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod pas zhib tshags so dang yag po zhig ngas mi shes/ de dag gi spru ris phra motho 'byed nas bshad dbosgos pa zhig red 'dug spyi sgom gyi thog nas bshad rgyu las sla po red/ zhib tshags po'i thog nas 'gro rgyu de gzhung la cung zad goms 'dres ma byas na khag po yin/sems sde dang / klong sde/ man ngag gi sde bcas las ches khyad du 'phags pa ni man ngag gi sde yin la/ 'dis gnyug ma'i 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs sam snang cha thod rgal gyi stong gzugs te / gsang sngags gsar ma'i chos skad ltar na sku thugs zung 'jug sgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam sne zhig dang / gtso bo ni tshogase drug gi shes pa rags pa blosna bur ba rnams 'gags pa la mi bltos par

42 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (5)rnam rtog skyed bzhin pa'i mu nas shes pa mtha' dag la gnyug ma'i 'od gsal gyi rig chas khyab 〈snad pas na/ nyams rdzusang can gyi bla ma las mos gus rtsegacig pa'i slob ma des bla ma de'i drung nas nyams myong rgyud thog tu 'khel ba'i thog nas ngo 'phrod pa zhig ste/ gnyug ma'i 'od gsal la gosgo ba chags pa tsam min par gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rang la mngon du gyur pa'i thog nas ngo 'phrod dgos pa de gal chen po yin/deng skabs rdzogs pa chen po zhes brjod skabs/ mang po zhig gis las sla po'i thog nas shod mkhan yong gi yod kyang / de 'dra e yin snyam/ dper na/mkhan po ngag chung gi rnam thar nang gsal ba dang / lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma bcas nas rdzogs chen gsung skabs bka' rgya ma'i thog nas gnang gi 'dug pa las/ yongs grags thun mong lam sbyangs blo ldog rnam bzhi de tsho'i gras dang /sngon 'gro sbug ma bcas ha cang gal 'gangs chen por gnang ste 'khrid bskyon pa dang / sgoms su bcug pa dang / rdzogs chen gyi 'khrid de rigs ga ler gnang ba las yongs grags khyab brdal chen por gnang ba zhig min/ gang ltar rdzogs pa chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa ni tshogs drug gi zhes pa rags pa de rnams rtsol ba'i thog nas rtsarlung thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi thog nas bkag nas gnyug ma'i 'od gsal 'char thabs byed pa ma yin par thad kur gnyug ma'i 'od gsal dmar 'jus lta bu byas pa ste / nam rgyun gsang sngags gsar ma'i gzhung

(11) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo sprod/gi skabs su sku gsum dmar 'jus byas pa yin zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin/gnyug ma'i 'od gsal dmar 'jus byas pa'i steng nas 'od gsal myong thog nas ngo 'phrod nas de'i rang tshugs zin pa zhig byung na/ de'i ngos nas dag dang ma dag gang zhig yin yang / de'i rol pa dang rnam 'gyur yin pa mthong ba'i skabs thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams myong zhig yong gi yod pa yin/mdor na de thams cad kyis gnyug ma'i 'od gsal sto na pa 'dra mtshungs la ston lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad yod pa zhig chags yod/de'i ngos nas bshad na theg pa rim pa dgu gsungs pa ste/ phyi kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum dang / nang dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa gsum bcas ni rnal 'byor rgyud man chad yin la/ de nas gsang sngags nang pa ste mahā a nu a ti yo ga ste gsang ba dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa gsum bcas theg pa rim pa dgu gsungs pa'i nang gi theg brgyad blo yi grub mtha' zhes pa'i theg pa brgyad po de rags pa glo bur ba'i sems lam du byed pa gtso 'don chags kyi yod/dper na/ mahā a nu gnyis kyis kyang rtsab gnyug ma'i 'od gsal 'char thabs la 'bab cing de'i thog tu 'gro gi yod pa yin/ 'on kyang rags pa glo bur ba'i sems sngon la bcos kyi yod/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga ni gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de ga rang la thad shar dmar 'jus byas nas 'gro ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad yod/ 'on kyang zab khyad de las sla po zhig gi thog nas yong rgyu

tre cha༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (11)khag ngetho yin/de lta bu'i bod du yod pa'i sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa de rnams thams cad rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba sha stag yin zhing /blo gzu sor gnas pa'i thog nas rang rang so so'i gzhung lugs rnams mjal na ngo mtshar skye ba dang / dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba zhig yod/ des na nga rang tsho bod du de sngerdzon nas skabs re chos lugs 'then 'khyer byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'brang gcig gyur dang / theg pa chen po'i chos smra ba gcig gyur/ dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' mthar thug 'dzin pa gcig gyur yin yang nang gses nga dang khyod ces bshad pa de 'dra yong gi yod pa ni mi dgos pa zhig yin la/ thabs skyo po zhig red 'dug de'i thog tu 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog rags pa de rnams sgon skabs mgom 'ordzog chen po btsal gyi 〈snad/ byed stangs ha cang thabs skyo po de m+wa nga tsho'i lo rgyus nang byung myong yod/ 'on kyang de snga nas bod la ris med gnang mkhan med pa min par mang po byung skusgod/ rnying ma dang bka' brgyud pa'i nang nas ris med gnang mkhan skusgod la/ sa skya dang dge lugs pa gnyis/ kyi nang nas kyang ris med gnang mkhan byung yod/ de dag ni phyag srol ha cang yag po red 'dugadaper na 7rgyal dbang sku phreng gong ma rnams kyi lo rgyus la bsam :rto zhig btang na/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa phal cher dwags posna

(12) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo sgod/bkra shis rnam rgyal kyi sku mdun nas gsung chos gsan par ma zad/ mdor na rta mgrin gyi chos 'khor serdzogs rnying ma'i chos 'khor yang gsan nas nyams bzhes gnang 〈snad/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni de bas kyang yin/khong gi yab mes rnams bka' brgyud kyi 27sa gnang mkhan zhig yin pas chung dus nas bka' brgyud pa'i chos gsor gsan gnang mdzad yod/ de bzhin dge ldan pa'i chos dang / gzhan sa skya dang rnying ma'i chos gsor yang gsan yod/ de'i tshe de'i dus su thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshor ris med pa'i rgyal ba zhwa ser mo ba zhes pa'i mtshan thogs pa yin zhes g.yang pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i rnam thar nang sangod pa lta bu yin/ 7rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho mchog ni sa skya'i chos lubor dang / mgon po che chung gnyis dang / lhag par gur gyi mgon po'i gsang gnyed thun mong ma yin pa yod pa yin/ de bzhin 7gong sa lnga pa chen po ni yongs grags ris med gnang mkhan zhig yin la/ sku mdun sku gong mar cha bzhag na/ sku mdun sku gong ma dang thugs 'dres chen po yod pa rnams nas gsungs pa la/ rgan dngos grub mchog brnyes mchog nas gsung chos gsan sa'i bla ma snyan grags can khong nas gsungs pa la/ sku mdun sku gong ma phyags rogs zhabs zhu ba rnams dang mnyam du 'jigs byed dpa' gcig chag med gsungs pa dang / rin po che sku rkyang gi thog nas thun mong ma yin pa gnang ba ni/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ste phur pa gnang gi yod pa red ces gsung

treka 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (13) rgyun 'dug pa ltar yin/des na nga rang tsho sngar sod du'ang ris su ma chad pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu'i nang ris med gnang mkhan mang po byung yod/ yang rang rang so so'i chos rgyud de rkyang pa las gzhan 'dres lhad med pa gnang mkhan yang yerdzong gi yod/ rtsab chos rgyud tshang ma gsan min rang nyid kyi rang dbang yin/ 'on kyang chos rgyud gzhan dang ma 'dres pa zhig gnang ba'i 'bras bur nga dang khyod ces pa de'i thog tu phyin na de ni mi dgos pa zhig yin/ deng skabs nga rang tsho nga dang khyod ces brjod sa med par tshang ma btsan byol ba chags 〈snad/ nga tsho tshang ma bskyal mabordzo ril zhes pa ltar rang gi lung pa de bskyal nas gzhan gyi lung par mgobyu ril ril byas nas bsdad yod/ mdor na thob go sa zhes bshad sa bsdad med la/ nga tsho'i ma〈snad gzhis dang dgordzon pa zhes bshad sa de tsam bsdad med/ de lta bu'i 'og nas nga rang tsho phyi lo chig stong dgu brgya drug cu'i nang nas bzung ste nga rang tsho'i chos rgyud 〈snangs su rdzogs pa thugs mthun dam tshig 'o chu gcig 'dres yong thabs la 'bad rtsol byas shing / skabs der 'tsho zhing gzhes pa skyabs rje bdud 'groms rin sto che dang /de bzhin 'brug pa thugs sras rin po che/ bdag khri rin po che da lta'ang 'tsho bzhugs yod cing / gzhan yang rkarma pa rin po che sogs tshang mas thugs 'khur chen sto bzhes yod/chesnas tshogs thengs dang po tshogs pa'i skabs nas dmigs bsal son

(18) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo spyod/po'i ngos nas 'bod bskul byed mkhan med kyang bon po'i 'thus mi yang yod pa bcas nga tsho 'tshogs pa yin/ skabs der thugs mthun khrims gtsang yag po zhig byung na zhes re ba dang smon lam 'di 'dra brgyab pa dang / de lugs kyi 'bad rtsol byas par brten da cha lo ngo bzhi bcu zhe grangs song ba'i mtshams su yar rgyas gang 'tshams phyin yod/ ris su ma chad pa'i chos rgyud tshang ma dad pa dang dag snang phyogs ris med pa yag sto zhig yong ba la/ dus dus su nga tsho rub rub byas te skad cha 'dra chags po bshad pa dang / rnam 'gyur yang 'dra chags po bstan pa tsam ma yin par chos brgyud de dang de'i rang nyid kyi dbang lung man ngag gtso che ba rnams ris su ma chad par rang gis zhu thub pa dang / zhus nas rang nyid kyis nyams len byas te/ gzhan don gnyer can la 'chad spel byed thub pa byung na don dam pa'i dam tshig 'o chu gcig 'dres yong thub pa yin/ dper na/7gong sa lnga pa chen por cha bzhag na/ 7gong sa lnga pa chen por sa skya pa'i khungs nas rigs 'ga' zhig gis mi dga' ba byed kyi yod/ gang lags she na/ 7gong sa lnga pa chen so mchog nas sa skya'i dgon pa 'ga' zhig dge lugs kyi dgon par bsgyur gnang mdzad yod pa des min nam snyam/ sa skya'i mkhan po sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin mchog gi drung nas ngas sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum dang /sdom gsum rab dbye rin po che rang gi mchan gyi thog nas zhus pa dang / de bzhin tshad ma rigs gter yang zhus pa bcas ha cang bka' drin chen po yin/

tshod pa 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (15)mkhan po sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin mchog gis gsungs par/ sa skya pa'i nang du 7gong sa lnga pa chen por skur ba zhu mkhan yod/ 'on kyang lam 'bras ston pa'i skabs su/ lam 'bras 〈snab bshad kyi mkhyen brtse'i 'khrid yig de snang gsum sesgogs kyi skabs las rgyud gsum gyi skabs su mkhyen brtse'i 'khrid yig med cing / mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i 'khrid yig nang cha tshang 〈snad pa yin/ mkhyen brtse'i 'khrid yig nang cha tshang med stabs mkhyen brtse'i 'khrid yig la 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos zhal skong mdzad yod/ lam 'bras slob bshad kyi 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos kha skong mdzad pa'i mtshams su slebs skabs/ da ni 7gong sa lnga pa chen por mgo sgur dgos kyi red ces gsung srol yod ces gsung gi 'dugagang ltar 7gong sa lnga pa chen por cung zad mi 'dod pa zhu mkhan gyis kyang chos rgyud de'i nang du slebs skabs 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i gsung la brten nas 'gro dgos pa zhig chags kyi yod/ de ni yag po red 'dug des rang shugs su don dam pa'i chos grogs kyi 'du shes slebs pa dang / dad pa dang dam tshig gtsang ma yong ba yin/dus phyis mkhyen brtse'i dbang por cha bzhag na/ dngos gnas ris med gnang mkhan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yin zhing / de'i phyag hrengal mkhyen brtsechos kyi blo gros mchog nas 'dzin pa gnang ste/ chos rgyud tshang ma gnang gi yod/mkhyen brtsechos kyi blo gros kyi phyag mdzod da cha grongs zin cing / phyag mdzod

(16) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo sprod/spo lags des ngos la brjod gsal/ mkhyen brtsechos kyi blo gros mchog phar tshur phebs pa'i skabs su dbu zhwa sgam gang yod pa de dag nang sa skya'i sa zhu dang /bka' brgyud pa'i dwags zhwa/ dge lugs pa'i ser mdog cod pan/ de bzhin rnying ma'i dbu zhwa sogs dbu zhwa 'dra min sgam gang yod pa rnams gsung cho sa gnang bar phebs skabs nges par du dbu zhwa de rnams bsnams dgos kyi yod ces gsung gi 'dugade ltar ris med kyi bstan par gsan bsam sgom pa gnang ba'i thog nas ris med kyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhabs 'degs sgrub nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum thad mdzad rjes chen po bzhag pa gnang / dil mgo mkhyen brtserin po che mchog kyang de bzhin yin/ rtsab sa dge bka' rnying gang zhig yin yang / sngar bod du yod skabs a mdo'i dge lugs pa'i bla ma zhig la rnying ma'i chose gabor zhig phar 'bul gnang mdzad pa dang / tshur rje rin po che'i gsung bde mchog sbas don kun gsal gsan pa yin zhes gsung gi 'dug phyis su ngas dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che'i sku mdun nas gsung chos mang po zhus pa yin/ rin po che mchog nas kyang sngags rim chen mo gsan dgos 〈snad ces gsungs pa ltar ngas mgo cung zad btsugs pa dang / rin po che mchog mdzad brel chen po yod stabs mjug cha tshang zhig byung ma song / rjes su rin po che mchog nas u tshugs dang don gnyer chen ṅge gnang nas bco brgyad khri rin po

nga) lagong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (17)che'i drung nas gsan pa gnang 'dug ngas thog mar sngags rim chen mo 3ngas gnyis tsam bton pa de skabs bco brgyad khri rin so che yod/ des na nga nas brgyud pa yin stabs bco brgyad rin po che'i sku mdun nas 'phros rnams stod lhod kyis gsan pa yin zhes gsung gi 'dug de dag ni nga tshos mig dpe lta dbosgos pa zhig yin/de nas dge lugs par cha bzhag na/ ngas sngar nas nga tshos ris med byas te chos rgyud tshang mar rgyus mnga' yod pa zhig dang / sems thag nye po zhig byung na des phan thogs yod ceso brjod yod/ de bzhin rnying ma dang / bka' brgyud/ sa skya bcas kyi nang du'ang ri so dge ldan pa zhes rgyang thag ring por mi 'jog par rje rin po che'i gsung rnams la gzigs thub na yag so skusgod ces zhu gi yod/ de ltar byed thub na ha cang yag po yod/ de dag rang rang so sor thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos re yod/ dper na/ rje rin po che ni rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid ces pa dang / btags mthod ming rkyang tsam zhes brten nas btags pa'i rten 'brel phra mo'i rnam gzhag de rje rin po che lta bu su la'ang mi 'dug kun mkhyen slong chen pa'i gsung gi nang gsal po de tsam mi 'dug la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gi nang du'ang de lta bu'i gsal po zhig mi 'dugabu ston rin po che'i gsung nang la'ang gsal po med/ des na de ni thun mong ma yin pa zhig red 'dug bka' brgyud bordzong ma rnams kyi gsung gi nang dang /

(18) bstan pa'i byung rim dang /nang chos ngo spyod/mnyam med dwags sto lha rje'i gsung gi nang rtsaba'i gnad 'gag de dag tshang mas gsungs yod pa dang / dgongs pa rtogs shing don mngon du gyur yod/ 'on kyang tshig gi thog nas gsung skabs 'grel pa bud+dha paphri ta tshig gsal dang / 'jug pa rang 'grel sogs kyi tshig gnad bsgrugs nas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i de kho na nyid kyi don rnams tshig ha cang gsal po'i thog nas brdar sha chod pa ni rje rin po che'i gsung thun mong ma yin pa zhig red 'dugades na bka' brgyud dang / rnying ma/ sa skya bcas kyi nang nas rje rin po che'i gsung gzigs thub na dngos gnas dge mtshan yod pa dang / rang rang dbu ma'i lta ba'i thog dgongs pa bzhes rgyur tan tan phan thogs 〈snad/ yang gnyug ma'i 'od gsal bshad pa'i skabs rje rin po che'i gsung gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga gsal sgron semags kyi nang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs mardzod/rang bzhin brgyad cu'i kun rtog sde tshan phye ba ni thun mong ma yin pa zhig red 'dug gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de nyid gsung skabs phal cher rdzogs chen gyi gzhung nas gzhi yi rigs pa dang / ngo bo'i rigs pa/ rtsal gyi rigs pa sesgogs dbye ba mang po zhig phye yod/ de bzhin rang grol dang / gcer grol sogs grol lugs mi 'dra ba mang po gsungs pa rnams kyang thun mong ma yin pa zhig red 'dug de rnams tshur bsnan na tan tan phan thogs yod pa yin/ der brten sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad par rang nyid kyis dad pa byed pa dang / de dag gi

ci ༷༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (21) medacesamobargyab pa'am lung bstan zhu mi dgos par bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i nang gzhi yi gnas tshul ji ltar yin pa dang /gzhi de la bstan pa'i lam gyi 'gro stangs ji ltar yin pa/ lhag par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i skabs nas gzhi la 'khod bzhin pa'i snurmes shig lam gyis gzhi la rang chas su yod pa'i chos de'i nus pa rdzogs su bcug pa zhig dang / nus pa mthar thug pa yong ba'i lam gyi byed rkyen de 'dra zhig ma gtogs/ gzhi la med pa zhig lam gyis gsar pa bsgrub rgyu med pa dang / mdor na gzhi la rang chas su yod bzhin pa'i chos shig rkyen gzhan gyi dbang du mi gtong bar rang la nus pa bzang po zhig yod pa de rdzogs par bskyed pa'i lam zhe sa pa zhig gsungs yod/ de la go ba cung zad chags na/ 'bras bu'i yon tan de m+wa zhig da lta nga rang tshor stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa gsungs pa de yin par bsams nas lung la yid ches byed pa las thabs gzhan med pa lta bu yin yang / gzhi yi gnas tshul dang / de la brten pa'i lam gyi gnas tshul de rigs la go ba yag yo zhig chags pa dang bsam blo gzab nan zhig btang na/ de ni dngos gnas yong thub pa 'dug bsam pa'i chos tshul zhig nga rang tshos mjal yod/ mjal ba tsam du ma zad nga rang tsho de la yid ches kyang gang 'tshams yod pa yin/spyir btang nang pa sangs rgyas kyi yul grur skyes pa dang / lhag par hi

༷༷ 3 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (18)gces par 'dzin pa'i gces 'dzin gyis byas kyang / nga rang tshos de ha cang rtsachen du rtsibazhin yod/de bzhin rang gces par 'dzin pa'i gces 'dzin gyi dpung rogs lta bu nga zhes pa 'di nga rang tshor don gyi ngos nas tshugs thub pa dang / rang dbang ba/gzhan la bltos pa med pa'i mchen/ ljid chen po zhig tu snang gi 〈snad/ de ltar snang ba ltar zhen pa'i blo la brten nas chags snang la sogs pa yong gi yod/des na klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa'i rtsab ni/ snying rje rtsabar gyur pa'i bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba gnyis ni skyid po 'dod mkhan zhig yin na/ skyid po zhes pa ni sdug sto rtsab nas med pa zhig byung na de ni dngos gnas skyid po dang gtan du bde ba yin/ de min sdug po myong gin du skyid po yang myong na/ skyed po de ngo so thon pa zhig yong gi med dam/ yang sdug po rtsanas med na skyed po ngo mi shes pa yong srid/ de ltar bsam blo btang na/lubor bar gams na skyid pa lta bu zhig 〈snad/ sdug po myong bzhin du 'phral sel gyi skyid po yang byed bzhin du phyin na phal cher mi tshe 'di cha tshang ba lta bu dang /yang na sdug bsngal spangs nas gtan gyi bde bar rol dus gang 'tshams nas nyob mdangs lta bu yong gi med dam/ nga rang tsho de lta bu zhig yin 'dug sdug bsngal byung na sdug skad rgyag pa dang / bde ba phran bu zhig byung na de gas yid tshims te mgo lubor nas sdod kyi yod/

— 4༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (17)thogs yod pa zhig yin/ rang gi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems med kyang byang chub kyi sems la mordzos pa dang dga' po mthod/ des na byang chub kyi sems nyams 'og tu tshud yod ces phal cher brjod chog pa yin/ da dung bsgom rgyu byung na tshogs lam chung ngu zhig rgyud la skye rgyu tshod thig pa lta bu yong gi 'dug 'on kyang bsgom long yong gi mi 'dug de 'dra zhig red/ byang chub kyi sems ni mi la kha yod lag yod kyi phan thogs yod pa zhig yin/ rang skyed pa'i zhor la robo/sa pa yang skyid pa dang / tha na 'bu srin tshun chad skyid pa zhig yong gi yod/ lardom gling spyi don la nga jus tog tsha drags na yag po med/ 'on kyang tshang ma skyid po 'dod kyi yod stabs/ gang phan zhig byed thub na snyam nas bsam blo gtong gi 〈snad/ de min gang yang med/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes pa 'di ha cang nus pa chen po yod pa yin/byang chub kyi sems zhes pa de 'dra zhig 〈snang thub pa'i rgyu mtshan dang /rtsab thug gang la thug ce na/ de ni stong nyid kyi lta ba'i thog nas go ba len thub pa yin/ yang byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pa la/ stong nyid kyi lta ba dgos nges can lta bu min/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rtul po rnams kyis sngon la byang chub kyi sems skyes/ de rjes stong nyid kyi lta ba yong gi yod/ yang dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rjes su zhugs mkhan dbang rnon tshasnas kyi rjes 'brangs tsho ltar na/ stong nyid kyi lta bar bsam blo btang ste sems la 'gyur ba thebs rgyu

(18) chos lugs mthun lam dang /nang chos kyi zab khyad/yong pa dang / nyon mongs kyi gzhi rtsamed pa bzo rgyu yod pa sogs kyi bsam blo lwabor ba'i skabs su/ dngos gnas sems can la snying rje gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig skyes ba dang / des drangs pa'i gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo yong ba/ byang chub ces rang steng la nyon mongs spangs pa'i bral ba zhig yong srid pa dang / de ltar nyon mongs spangs pa'i bral ba zhig yod na/nyon mongs des bzhag pa'i bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i bral ba zhig yong thub par ma zad/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes pa'ang yong thub pa/ de ltar yong ba'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes pa zhig bsam blo'i nang gsor dus byang chub don gnyer blo yong ba yin/des na/ stong nyid kyi lta bas grogs byas pa'i snying rje'i bsam pa dang / de bzhin bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes pa ni shin tu rtsachen yin/nga rang la nyams myong phran bu zhig las med kyang / des phan thogs 'di lta bu yong gi yod na/ byang chub sems dang / stong nyid kyi lta ba'i myong ba rnal ma zhig rgyud la skyes na/ dngos gnas/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/de bas skyo ngal kun sel ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyi rta zhon nas/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems shes su zhig skyid lug 'gyus /zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 〈snang nges yin/ des na mabo(na posna klu sgrub kyis gsung rnams mjal dus/ can tsi 'di 'dra gsung 'dug

(36) chos lugs mthun lam dang /nang chos kyi zab khyad/gang zhig zhan brjod rgyu ha cang khag po yin/ sman legs nyes ni nad bye brag pa zhig dang bstun nas nad 'di'i dbang du byas na sman 'di legs zhes brjod thub pa yin/ nad bye brag pa so so dang sgo bstun nas sman legs nyes brjod thub pa las/ spyi yongs kyi thog nas sman 'di legs sgo(sa yin zhes brjod thub rgyu khag po yin/ dper na/ rin chen ril bu zhes rin thang che shos dang mche shos su rtsigi yod kyang / nad bye brag pa zhig la rin chen ril bus phan mi thub par/ sman dkyus ma rin thang de tsam med pa zhig phan nus che ba yong gi yod/ des na nad de'i dbang du byas na rin thang shin tu chung ba'i sman de yag 〈snas chags yod/der brten mi la'ang khams dang mos pa sna tshogs yod/ nang pa'i chos dang lta grub kyi ngos nas bshad na/ 'jig rten bkod pa po 'dod pa'i lta ba ni sgro 'dogs kyi lta ba chags kyi yod/ 'on kyang gang zag bye brag pa zhig la 'dzig rten bkod pa po'i lta grub sems la 'jug che ba dang / nus pa thon che ba yong gi yod/ de la brten nas byams pa dang snying rje mang tsam bsgom thub pa yong gi yod/byams dang snying rje de dag tshad can zhig yin na yang med pa las dzestod pa legs/de la brten nas byams pa dang snying rje skye thub pa yong gi yod na/ de 'dra'i khams dang mos pa ldan pa'i mi de ris/sa la 'jig rten bkod pa po'i lta grub dang 'brel ba'i chos lugs de zab sgo(sa yin/dper na/ kha zas la cha bzhag na/ pho ba thang po med pa'i mi zhig la

ci 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (31)'bras thug sla po zhig las 'thung ba'i las dang skal ba med cing / mi de la 'bras thug sla po de 'phros sgosas dang yag sgordzos yin/ pho ba yag po yod mkhan zhig la rgya zas dang bod zas gang yin yang mi 'phrod pa med/ nga'i bsam par chos yag nyes bshad rgyu khag po red snyam gyi yod/ chos yag nyes ni rang rang gi khams dang bstun dgos pa yin/ dper na/ nga rang sger la chos yag 3(sa gang zhig yin zhe na/ nang pa'i chos yag sgo sa yin/ gang lags she na/ de nga la 'phrod cesas su yod/ yang nga'i grogs po ye shu'i chos pa zhig la chos legs sgordzos gang zhig yin zhe na/ ye shu'i chos yag sgo(sa yin/ khong la ye shu'i chos 'phrod po yod pa dang / des phan gyi yod/ gal srid khong la las rgyu 'bras kyi skor dang / bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin tshul brjod na des phal cher phan thogs yong mi thub/'jig rten bkod nga po dkon mchog gi bka' dang bstun pa'i chos des khong la phan thogs yong gi yod/ des na chos yag nyes zhes pa 'di khams dang mos pa dang bstun dgos pa zhig dang / mdor na phan dang ma phan la bltas nas bshad dgos pa zhig yin pa las/ rang dgar bshad na mi 'grigs/ legs nyes dang yag sdug ni/ bde sdug gi tshor ba dang 'brel nas bshad dgos pa yin/ tshor ba myong ba po zhig gis rang gi bde sdug gi tshor ba ma 'brel ba yag nyes bshad thub thabs med/ der brten chos la yag nyes kyi skad cha bshad rgyu ha cang khag po yin/

(32) chos lugs mthun lam dang /nang chos kyi zab khyad/yang lta ba'i thad lta grub rgyas 31sa gang yin zhe na/ de ni nang pa red ces brjod thub pa la/ ngas lta grub kyi cha nas bshad pa nang pa rgyas sgo(sa dang zab shos red ces brjod kyi yod/ chos yag nyes ni gong du brjod pa ltar bshad thub pa zhig min/ de ni rang rang gi khams mos dang bstun dgos pa yin/ yang khyed rang tsho 'ga' zhig gis 7rgyal ba rin po che 'dzam gling gi yul gru gzhan du bskyod skabs chos tshang ma gcig red ces brjod pa dang / bod pa'i khrod du nang chos yag snasgos red ces brjod pa de ni mgo gnyis ma'i byed stangs lta bu mthong nyen yod/ 'on kyang 'di skor ngas gong du gsal po brjod zin pas bskyar du brjod dgos don med/theg pa che chung la cha bzhag na/ bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gsungs yod/ de dag gsungs dgos don gang yin nam/ nang par cha bzhag na 2stos yag sgo(sa theg chen gyi josgos yin/ che sa yag sgo(sa de gsungs na 'grigs pa las/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gsungs dgos don med/ 'on kyang de dag ni bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyis gsums pa zhig yin pa dang / theg chen gyi chesgos nang la'ang sems/ tsam pa'i grub mtha' gsungs dgos don gang yin nam/ gsor lo bar pa gsungs rjes mdo sde'i dgongs 'grel gsungs pa dang / lwabor lo bar pa la'ang yang sing lta bu brgyab nas gsungs pa gang yin nam/ de ltar gsungs dgos don med/ gsor

mi ci — tshan snyegong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (33)lo bar pa'i nang gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyi da kyis grub pas stong pa yin zhes gsungs pa de mthar thug gi yin lugs yin pas/ de la cha bzhag na 'grigs kyang / gzhi nas de la mtshan nyid gsum du phye ste/ kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa dang / gzhan dbang dang yongs grub gnyis rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa red ces gsungs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das thugs brtseb chen po dang ldan pa zhig yin/ gzhan la phan dang mi phan dbosgongs pa bzhes te gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa dang bstun nas/ gabor lo bar pa'i skabs su chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa red ces de kho na gsungs na/ mi khag gcig la cung zad mi 'tshams pas/ mi rnams kyi khams dang rertos pa dang bstun nas mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum du phye ste rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub ma grub cha phye nas gsungs pa de ltar yin/de min nga rang tsho rigs 'ga' zhig gis nga tsho theg chen pa yin/ khong tsho theg dman pa red ces sma 'bebs mthong chung byed kyi yod/ phar mthong chung byas pa'i 'bras bur theg dman pa rnams kyis tshur theg chen bcom ldan 'das kyi chos ma red ces brjod kyi yod/ des na theg chen pa rnams kyis theg chen sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin zhes sgrub dgos pa chags pa dang / mgon po klu sgrub dang / rje btsun byams mgon/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed/ rgyal sras zhi ba

(33) chos lugs mthun lam dang /nang chos kyi zab khyad/lha bcas kyis theg chen sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin zhes u tshugs nan pos gsungs yod/ gang 'tshams nas dkon mchog gsum theg chen sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin zhes mna' skyel dgos pa chags grabs byed pa de la snying po gang yang med/ theg dman bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' yin la/ bden pa bzhi las brtsams te so sor thar pa'i lam la brten nas rang nyid gcig pu thar pa thob pa zhig gsungs yod pa ni yang dag pa yin/ de dag blo dang 'tshams shing 'phrod pa rnams la chos 'di zab shos yin/ gal te de dag la rang yal bar dor gzhan gces par 'odzin dgos zhes brjod na/ de ni snang bar mi 'gro ba'i skad cha red ces nyan rgyu min /des na mngon rtogs rgyan las/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang / /zhes sogs nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas gnyis kyi lam bgrod tshul zhig bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyi sa bstan pa yod lugs gsungs pa 'grigs pa yin/ dgos pa'i dbang gis mthar thug theg pa gsum yin/ khyed rang gis byang chub thob pa'i skabs su 'grigs nga/ yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal rdzun gnang ba zhig min par don dngos la gnas med kyang dgos pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa yin/ des na nga rang tshos theg chen pa yin zhes theg chen par khas 'ches te theg dman la mthong chung rtsab nas byed rgyu med/ sangs rgyas kyi chos legs sbyar thog

hokhe 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (36)gsungs pa nyams len byed kyi 〈snad pa rgyu mtshan du byas te pasnyi'i thog gsungs pa'i chos dman pa red ces brjod na nor ba yin/de bzhin nga rang tsho bod gangs can ljongs kyi chos la tshur sbyar na yang /rnying ma dang gsar ma/ gsar ma la'ang bka' brgyud pa dang / sa skya dge ldan te bka' gdams gsar rnying zhes bsdod kyi yod/ de bzhin jo nang bcas 'dra min mang po 〈snad/ ri bo dge lugs par cha bzhag na/ gdams ngag thad srad dben gzhung gsum zhes srad rgyud kyi rgyud pa gcig dang / dben sa'i rgyud pa gcigadabus kyi gzhung pa'i rgyud pa gcig bcas srad dben gzhung gsum zhes pa ni a mdo'i bla ma rnams kyis gsung gi yod/ de min srad dben gnyis rkyang pa brjon na dbus kyi rgyud pa'i rgyud grwa stod smad gnyis bud 'gro gi yod/ de bud na mi 'grigs/dngos gnas rje rin po che'i bstan pa 'dzin thabs mchog tu gyur pa ni/rje rin po che'i gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel chen mo'i 'chad nyan yin/ de dus da lta bar du ma nub par gnas pa ni rgyud pa grwa tshang gnyis kyi bka' drin yin zhing / de min dbus gtsang gi sa khul gzhan la phal cher mthong rgyu med/ rje rin po che'i gsung 'bum po ti bco brgyad kyi nang sku ngal bskyon nas legs bshad bsgrigs pa ni/ gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel chen mo 'di gcig yin/ de'i sa bcad bsdus don dang / mtha' dpyod myu gu sogs kyang rje rin po ches ha las dgos pa zhig

(36) chos lugs mthun lam dang /nang chos kyi zab khyad/bsgrigs gnang yod pa dang / tshig 'grel gnang stangs kho na la ha las dgos pa zhig 'dug de bzhin steng mchan dang / 'og mchan/ zur mchan bcas pa rnams kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig red 'dug de lta bu'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba de rgyud pa grwa tshang gnyis kyi zugs rje bka' drin la brten nas dus da lta bar du gnas thub pa las/ de min khag sto yin/ der brten srad dben gzhung gsum zhes brjod na yag sto 'dug 'on kyang nang gses la mi mthun pa yong gi yod/ de bzhin yig cha rnams kyi nang nas gtso che ba se ra rje btsun pa'i yig cha dang / paṇa chen bsod grags kyi yig cha/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig cha/ de min ser smad grwa tshang gi yig cha dang / byang rtse'i yig cha sogs grwa tshang so so yig cha m+wa min gyi thog 'gro gi yod/ yongs ledrin rin po che blo gsal gling gi paṇa chen yig char thugs zhen chen po yod/ de ltar yig cha so so'i thog nas 'gro stangs mang po zhig yong gi yod/bka' brgyud la cha bzhag na/ bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad sdudags nang gses mang po zhig 〈snad/ rnying ma la cha bzhag na/ bka' ma dang / gter ma/gter ma la'ang ha cang mang po zhig yod/ de dag rnams gcig las gcig zab pa dang / nga yag kho sdug ces pa'i thog tu phyin na snying po gang yang med/ de ni smyo lab tu zad/ che sa nas nga rang tsho'i chos rgyud so sos rang lta mchog 'jin gyis/dper na/ ri so dge lugs pa zhig gis dge lugs pa yag cesas yin/ de min

ca9ri pro ༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (37)rnying ma dang / bka' brgyud/ sa skya bcas yag po med ces brjod na de ni lkugs rtags bsnyan pa yin/ de bzhin rnying ma zhig gis dge lugs pa dang / sa spyo/bka' brgyud pa bcas yag po med tshul brjod na de yang lkugs rtags bstan pa 6sgon/ dngos gnas nga tsho mi sger sesgo sarto'i khams dang mos pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ dper na/ mi kha shas jo nang gi lta grub thog nas bsam blo btang na/sems la 'phrod che ba yosnang ba de la jo nang zab sgo(sa yin/ de bzhin khag gcig rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsungs 'phrod sgo(sa yong ba de la dge lugs pa zab sgo(sa yin/ yang khag gcig la rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung ngam phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung zhig 'phrod shos yod na de dag la de zab shos chags yod/ de ltar gang zag so so la bltos nas nga la 'di zab shos dang 'phrod shos 'dug ces brjod na 'grigs pa yin/ rang sger la 'phrod sgo(sa dang zab sgordzos yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas te spyi yongs kyi thog chos 'di zab shos yin zer ba dper na/ ri bo dge lugs pa yag sgo(sa yin zer ba dang / rnying ma yag 3stos yin zer ba/ bka' brgyud yag ce(sa yin zer ba/ sa skya yag 3phos yin zer ba de dag ni nor zhakhrul red bsam gyi 'dug tshang mar dad pa byas na yag po yod/ nga rang de ltar bsam blo gtong gi yerdzod/ klong chen gyi gsung la lta skabs a tsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa red 'dug bsam pa dang / de bzhin sa chen sgordzong ma rnams kyi gsung

(38) chos lugs mthun lam dang /nang chos kyi zab khyad/dang / rigs gter la lta skabs sgra rtog sel bas 'jug tshul skor rnams ha cang rgyas po 'dug pas/ de 'dra'i ngo mtshar che ba la bsam gyis mi khyab pa red bsam pa dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i sdom gsum rab dbye la/ yongs 'dzin gling rin po ches sngar 'di la bstan bcos gze ma ra mgo zhes brjod kyi yod ces gsungs byung / gang yin zhe na/ de'i nang gang sar phog thug btang gnang yod stabs/ bstan bcos gze ma ra mgo zhes brjod pa yin 'dug sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum rab dbye ni zhal ha cang tsha po dang / gang sa gang du skyon brjod phran bu re gnang ba bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pa red 'dug bsam gyi skusgod/gzhan yang mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho dang / mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis kun gzhi'i rgyud rgyu ngos 'dzin skabs gcig gis don dam red ces gsungs pa dang / cig shos kyis kun rdzob red ces gsungs pa de ni sngon gyi mkhas pa sem sdusa'i bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba red bsam pa las/ gcig yang dag pa dang cig shos nor ba red ces brjod kyi med la/ brjod pa'i spobs pa'ang med/brjod ni dgos don gang yang mi 'dug yang dus rgyun ri bo dge lugs pa'i bla ma tshad ldan du 'bod pa'i gras/ dper na/ skyabs rje pha stong kha rin po che'i gsung gi nang /phyag rdzogs gser dngul de bsgom yang / /rtag chad g.yang sa ru lhung 'dug /ces gsungs pa de 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces sngon ma ngas

༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (39)lam rim chen mo thog mar 'chad pa'i skabs nas nor 'khrul yin pa brjod yod/de ltar spyi ma spom gyi thog nas gsungs pa yag po mi 'dug phyag rdzogs te phyag rgya chen po dang rdzogs chen gser dngul bsgom ste rtag chad kyi g.yang du lhung 'dug ces bka' mol 'di ltar gnang na ha cang gi nyen 'gan ljid po yin/ de skor gung thang rin po che'i gsung de yag pa yod/phyag rdzogs gsal stong 'dzin med cing / /'gro 'ong gzugs can ltar med da nga / /mthong bya ma mthong rgyan 'dra'ang / /gzugs su ma grub gsal rig tsam/ /myong la bden stong rlom 'chang zhing / /phyogs glang grags pa sogs kyis kyang / /de nyid ma mthong smra ba mtshar/ /zhes rgyu mtshan gsungs yod/ phyag chen dang / rdzogs chen/ gsal stong zung 'jug ces gsungs nas don dngos ngos 'odzin skabs/ 'gro 'ong gzugs can ltar med dang / /de bzhin/ mthong bya ma mthong rgyan 'dra ba/ /gzugs su ma grub gsal rig tsam/ /zhes rdzogs chen rang nyid kyi gzhung la cha ba zhag na/gsal rig gi ting nge 'dzin tsam bsgom na/ gzugs khams su 'thad pa dang /de las lhag na gzugs med khams su 'thad ces pa'i gol sa gsung gi snardzod/had de ba bzang thal le zhes pa'i sems gsal rig had de 'jog pa tsam gyis mi chog par rang byung gi rig pa bzang thal de bla ma nyams myong can gyis

(26) chos lugs mthun lam dang /nang chos kyi zab khyad/bstan pa/ slob ma bsod nams can la ngo 'phrod de nyams myong skyes pa'i thog nas bsgom rgyu zhig gsungs pa las/ ci yang mi rtogs par sems snga ma'i rjes mi mthud/ sems phyi ma'i sdun ma bsus par da lta'i sems sdus ma ma bcos pa 'di'i steng sems gsal rig tsam de ngo 'phrod pa tsam la rdzogs pa min/ gung thang tshang gi gsungs pa ni/phyag rdzogs gsal stong 'dzin med phyir/ /mthong bya ma mthong rgyan 'dra ba/ /gzugs su ma grub gsal rig tsam/ /myong la bden stong rlom 'chang zhing / /gsungs pa de yin/de bzhin lcang skya rin po che'i lta gur a ma ngos 'dzin gyi nang sa skya dang /bka' brgyud/ rnying ma bcas dang / bye brag smra ba'i 'dod tshul bcas bkod pa'i rjes su dge lugs pa la/da lta rang re yi blo gsal 'ga' zhig /tshugs thub bden grub sesgogs brda la zhen pas/ /snang ba ling ling 'di rang sor bzhag nas/ /dgag rgyu rwa can zhig 'tshol bar snang ste/ /sgrib bral a ma yi bzhin ras de na/ /lang lang ling ling 'di yod skad mi 'dug /gnad 'gag mi phigs pa'i bshad bshad mang yang / /a ma rgan mo de bros dogs 'dug go/

ci da) 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (41)yod cig yod mod kyang da lta'i 'di yo'i/ /rong rong 'gal 'du can yin tshod mi snang / /pha ma mdza' gcugs kyi 'bral med bag phebs/ /'jam 'jam skyed skyed cig yin par snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rten 'byung phra lngardzo zhes brten nas btags pa'i rkyen nyid 'di pa tsam gyi rten 'byung de dang / rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid gnyis po de mdza' gcugs red 'dug cing / ngos gcig rten 'byung phra mo bshad kyi yod la/ngos gzhan zhig nas rang bzhin gyis stong pa bshad kyi yod/ da lta nga rang tsho'i snang ba ling ling de don la gnas yod na de ni bden grub yin la/ bden grub tu snang gi yod/ de rten 'byung red mi 'dug cing / der brten/ rong rong 'gal 'du can yin tshod mi snang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ de'i skabs kyi tshig 'grel kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos gsungs 'dug kyang / de tsam gyi yid 'phrog po zhig ma byung / khyad par de tsam mi 'dug des na nga rang tsho'i chos lugs tshang ma lta grub dang chos kyi sde tshan gnyis su phye nas/ nga rang tsho nang pa nang phan tshun tsam min par chos lugs gzhan rnams la'ang 'di zab pa dang 'di dman zhes brjod thub rgyu khag po yin/ des na chos lugs tshang mar dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab pa zhig byed rgyu gal chen po yin// //

(42) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skor/las rgya 'bras dang /rten 'byudzo gi lta ba'i skor/thog mar chos 'brel dngos gzhi lung 'don rgyu yin stabs/ khyed rang chos zhu ba phyogs mtha' nas lhags pa tsho'i nang de snga chos kyi ngo spyod de tsam go myong med pa mang po mardzod pa dang / bod nas mthong mkhan rnams la cha bzhag na/cesas 'chad nyan byed pa'i skra( skabs de tsam med/ de bzhin phyi rgyal yul khag nas yong ba khyed rang rnams kyang dad pa dang don gnyer chen pos 'gro song mang po btang ste thag ring nas yong ba dang / skad brda ma 'phrod pa'i dka' ngal yod pas/lung klog skabs skad yig gzhan gyi thog bsgyur pa'i dpe cha yod tshe cung zad drag pa 'a/sa/ de min go khag po yin/ der brten nyin re'i chos thun gyi thog mar bshad pa cung zad re byas na bsam pa dran byung / de ltar nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ngo sprod byas na/ nga tsho tshang mas dus rgyun 'don bzhin pa'i oṃ ye dharmā zhes sogs kyi sngags don bod skad du bsgyur na 'di ltar/chesgos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyu la 'berteg pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos de skad gsungs/ /

7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (32)zhes pa yin la/ tshigs su bcad pa de'i don gang 'dra yin zhe na/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes pa des nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta tshul te spyir blo yi yul du 'jug pa zhig yin na/ de ni blo'i yul du bya rung gi shes par bya ba'am/ rang 'jal byed kyi tshad ma yod pa zhig gi thog nas yod med gzhi la bzhag pa yin/ de la nang gses kyis 〈snad pa'i chos la'ang 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu yod pa zhig dang / 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu med pa zhig bcas rigs gnyis yod/'gyur ba 'gro rgyu yod pa de gang gi dbang gis 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod ce na/'gyur ba 'gro ba de rang nyid skyed byed kyi rgyu las de min rkyen gzhan zhig gis 'gyur ba 'grerdzo ba phal cher mir/ de yang dper na/ theg chen lhusgos gling gtsug lag khang gi mdun ngos shing gi lo ma rnams ni dpyid sha'i dus su nyin re bzhin du 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod/ de ltar 'gyur ba 'gro ba de nga rang tshos mngon gsal dod po'i thog nas mthong thub kyi yod/ kha sang las de ring lo ma cung zad ring ba yod pa de/ nga rang tsho mi ltar mdang nub mtshan gang 'gyur ba ma phyin par nyal nas bsdad pa dang / da nang snga dro nam langs skabs gzhi nas 'gyur ba 'gro 'bosgo tshugs pa lta bu zhig min/ lo ma 'gyur ba 'gro ba de chu tshod nyi shu rtsabazhi'i ring la 'gyur ba 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa'i ngang du gnas yod/ chu tshod nyer bzhi de chu tshod gcig dang /chu tshod gcig de skar ma gcig skar ma gcig de skar cha gcig skar cha gcig de yang dum bu brgya phrag dang / stong phrag tu bgos pa'i dus tshod kyi nang 'gyur ba

(33) las rgyu tsos dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i sgoda'agro dang 'gro bzhin yod pas mngon gsal dod po'i 'gyur ba song ba de mthong gi yod/de ltar chu tshod skar cha re re'i nang 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin pa'i thog nas mngon gsal dod po 'i 'gyur ba 'gro ba mthong ba dang / mthar thug med par gyur pa zhig yong gi yod/ des na skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba 'gro ba de nga rang tshos mig gis mthong mi thub kyang / tshod dpag byas na shes thub pa yin/de tsam du ma zad deng skabs che shel gyis rdzas rdul phra mo'i thog tu bltas tshe shes kyi yod/ phra rab rdul gyi rim pa de'i thog nas bltas na ga dus yin yang g.yo zhing 'gyur ba'i chos shig las med pa ha cang gsal po yin/ de la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung nas mi rtag pa zhes gsungs 〈snad/ mi rtag pa la'ang phra rags gnyis yod/ de yang rgyun gyi mi rtag pa ni/ nga rang tshos 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa de mi rtag pa rags pa dang / skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba 'gro ba ni phra ba'i mi rtag pa ste/ skad cig gi mi brtan par 'gyur bas rgyu na gyi mi rtag pa de yong gi yod/ skad cig gis 'gyur ba 'gro ba de med na/ mthar 'jig pa de yang phal cher bshad thub rgyu khag po yin/ spyir med par song ba yod las che/de yang chos can zhig nas de'i steng gi khyad chos rnams 'gags 'gro ba dang /khyad chos kyi gras su rtag pa'ang yong mdog kha po yin/ dper na chos nyid lta bu khyad gzhi 'dus byas shig gi khyad chos rtag pa de 'dra zhig 'gags 'gro ba yong

—45 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (38)ba yin/ mdo don rgyun lta bu 'gags pa'i rgyun gyi mi rtag pa rags pa zhig ma(nga ba de skad cig skad cig gis 'jig pa'i phra ba'i mi rtag pa 〈snad pas na de yong gi yod/de lta bu'i skad cig skad cig gis 'jig pa de skad cig dang po'i skabs su skad cig gnyis pa 'jig pa'i rgyu rkyen gsar pa zhig byung nas skad cig dang po de 'gyur 'gro ba zhig min par de ni skad cig dang po rang nyid kyi dus su skad cig dang po de nyid 'jig pa'i bdag nyid du skyes yong gi yod/ skad cig dang po de nyid 'jig pa'i bdag nyid du skyes pa de skad cig dang po grub byed kyi rgyu de nyid kyis skyes pa las 'jig byed gzhan zhig la rag lus pa zhig min/ des na dngos po'i lhusgos thams cad rgyu yi ga zhan dbang can yin/ 'dus shing byas pa'i chesgos gang zhig yin yang de thams cad skad cig skad cig gis 'jig pa'i bdag nyid dang / 'gyur ba'i bdag nyid/ mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin zhes gsungs yod/de ltar 'gyur ba 'gro ba'i chos gang zhig yin yang rang nyid yong ba de rang skyed byed kyi rgyu la brten nas yong gi yod cing / skyed byed kyi rgyu'am phan 'dogs byed kyi gras nas 'bras bu'i ngo bor 'gyur 'gro ba'i rigs gcig dang / 'bras bu'i chos de'i ngo bor mi 'gyur yang / 'bras bu de gsar du 'grub pa la phan 'dogs byed mkhan gyi rgyu byed kyi yod pas nyer len gyi rgyu dang / lhan cig byed rkyen gyi rgyu bcas gsungs yod/ de lta bu'i nyer len gyi rgyu'i thog nas bsam blo

(46) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skosagatong skabs/ dngos po'i chos shig rang nyid kyi rigs rgyun gsar pa zhig 'go tshugs pa dang / rigs rgyun de 'gags 'gro ba yong gi yod kyang / de'i nyer len gyi rgyu'i thog tu bsam blo btang na/ rdzas rgyun de sngar nas yod pas rdzas rgyun gyi thog ma 'jog rgyu ha cang khag sto yin/dper na/ de ring nga rang tsho'i mdun du yod pa'i shing sna 'di dag kyang /shing 'di dag ma grub pa'i snga rol nas shing 'di'i rdzas rgyun ni shing snga ma'i son gyi thog nas yong gi yod/ shing snga ma'i son de yang shing de'i sngon gyi rgyun nas yong ba bcas 'di ltar yar ded na lo 'bum phrag dang / sa ya/ bye ba/ dung phyur bcas yar ded tshe de ring nga tsho'i mdun du yod pa'i shing bye brag pa 'di'i rdzas rgyun ded na/ 'dzam gling 'di thog mar chags pa'i skabs nas rdzas kyi rgyun de yod dgos pa yin/ de yang yar ded na 'dzam gling ma chags pa'i sngon nas stod mkha' dbyings stong par 〈snad pa'i skabs kyi stong pa'i rdul lam nam mkha'i rdul phra rab de dus nas yod pa zhig chags 〈snad/ de ni 'jig rten snga ma stongs pa'i shul nas sku(nga ba zhig chags kyi 〈snad/ des na rdzas rgyun zhes pa ni/ thog ma med pa nas yod pa zhig chags yong gi yod/ de gang 'dra byas te byung ngam zhe na/ de ni dngos po'i chos nyid yin pa las/ rdzas rgyun dang po de rtag pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin zhes barbestod mi thub la/ rgyu med las byung ba yin zhes kyang bshad mi thub / de ltar bshad na mi bde ba 〈snad/ des na rgyu med las skye ba min/ rgyu med

lke ci ri 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (47)las skyes na ha cang thal 'gro gi sku(da/ thog ma de rgyu med las skye chog na/ da lta yang rgyu med las skye chog pa yin/ de ltar 〈snang mi shes pa yin/ yang rtag pa'i rgyu las kyang skyes mi she sa pa yin/ gang lags she na/ rgyu la 'gyur ba 'grerdzo gi med na/de'i 'bras bu la'ang 'gyur ba 'byung mi shes pa yin/ 'bras bu 'gyur ba can zhig yin na/ skyed byed kyi rgyu de nyid kyang 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can zhig yin dgos pa yin/ der brten mi rtag pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin zhes gsungs pa yin/yang nga rang tsho'i 'jig rten 'dir mis dpyad pa byed skabs/ rgyu rkyen mngon gsal dod por mthong mi thub pa dang / 'jog mi thub pa zhig slebs skabs/ skabs re 'jig rten bkod pa sto zhig gis bkod pa red ces 'grel bshad cig yong gi yod/ spyir lasdeg rten bkod pa po 'dod mkhan gyi 'grub mtha' mang po zhig yod la/ 'jeg rten bkod pa po 'dod pa ltar gyi rang rang gi skyabs gnas la dad pa chen po skyes pa dang / yid ches chen po byas nas de la brten nas langeg rten bkod pa po la yar brtseb byed pa dang / langeg rten bkod pa pos bkod pa'i sgod dang bcud kyi 'jig rten nang phan tshun la'ang brtse ba byed pa bcas kyi thog nas phan thogs 〈snad pa yin/ des na 'jig rten bkod pa po 〈snad par blta ba'i lta ba de yang dag pa yin min ji ltar yang mi mang po zhig la phan gyi 〈snad pas des 'grigs pa yin/ de dag ni lha mi'i theg pa zhes pa de yin/ mdor na mi ya rabs can zhig byed dbosgos pa dang / mi bzang po zhig byed

(48) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skyodadabo(sa pa/ gzhan la phan sems byed dbeshas pa/ mi la phan 'dogs byed dbordzos zhes brjod pa de dag yag sto 'dug skye ba snga phyi khas mi len rung tshe 'di la las bzang po zhig bsags na/ skye ba phyi mar phan rgyu thag che4da pa yin/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung nas 'jig rten bkod pa sto zhes pa de bzhag na/ da dung bsam blo mang po zhig gtong dgos pa ste/ 'jig rten bkod pa po rang nyid skyed byed kyi rgyu las byung ba yin nam min/ 'jig rten bkod pa po rtag pa yin dang min/ de gang la'ang stos pa med pa'i rang dbang ba zhig yin min sogs la bsam blo btang na rnyog dra cung zad yod/ nga rang tsho'i spyir btang mthong chos kyi thog nas bsam blo zhig btang na yang / 'jig rten bkod pa po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can zhig gis 'dzam gling 'di'i steng gi rnyog dra 'di dag bzos pa brjod rgyu cung zad mi bde ba zhig yod/ de yang sems can so so'i bzang ngan gyi rnam dpyod 'byed pa'i go skabs bskrun pa lta bu serdzogs kyi 'grel bshad ldang ba zhig kyang khag po yin/des na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung nas 'jig rten bskosnad pa po zhig gis blo yi g.yo ba sngon du 'gro ba'i thog nas 'jig rten 'di bkod pa min/ 'o na 'jig rten ji ltar byas te byung ba yin zhe na/ gong du zhus pa ltar dngos po'i rdzas rgyun zhig las byung ba dang / de yang rkyen sna tshogs pa'i 'og nas 'gyur ba 'dra min 'gro gi yod/ dper na/ 'dzam gling thog mar ma chags pa'i gong du rdul

༷ rwa rngo ri/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (49)phrargeshinatuphrabarigs gcig pa yin na'ang rkyen gyi dbang gis kha gcig sa rdo ri brag tu 'gro ba dang / kha gcig ljon shing sogs su 'gro ba/ khag gcig srog chags kyi lus kyi rgyur 'gro ba semags mthar nga tsho'i lus kyi rgyur 'gro ba zhig yong gi yod/ rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin gcig pa yin yang rkyen gyi dbang gis rnam 'gyur 'dra min thon pa yong ba yin/ rkyen gyi dbang gis rnam 'gyur 'dra min thon pa de'i nang nang bcud kyi sems can gyi lus lta ci smos/ bcud kyi sems can gang du gnas sa'i phyi snod kyi bkod par 'gyur ba 'dra min 'gro ba de yang nang bcud kyi sems can gyi las dang 'brel ba phal cher 〈snad pa yin/ dper na/sa cha 'dir shing 'di 'dra zhig skyes par 'byung ba dang / gnam gshis/ chu mang nyung sogs kyi thog nas shing gi rnam 'gyur mi 'dra zhig yong gi yod/ shing 'di 'dra zhig sa cha 'di 'dra zhig dang / dus 'di 'dra zhig la skyes pa yang sems can gyi las dang 'brel ba phal cher yod pa yin/des na phyi nang gi dngos po gang zhig yin yang / rgyu gcig dang rkyen gcig las skyes pa zhig med/ de dag ni rgyu rkyen mang po zhig la brten nas yong dgos pa yin/ dper na/ nga rang tshos las kyi skad cha sgordzod skabs/ spyi mthun gyi las dang / bye brag so so'i las sogs mang sto zhig brjod kyi yod/ der brten rkyen gyi nang du las kyang 'brel ba shugs chen po yod pa yin/ nga tsho sems ldan gyi phung po'i 'gro stangs las dang 'brel ba 〈snad pa smos ci dasgordzos/ sems med

(86) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skor/bem po la'ang nang bcud kyi sems can gyi bde sdug gang la brten sa'i chos shig chags yod stabs/ las dang 'brel ba tan tan yong gi yod/ sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung nas gsung tshul 'di ltar yin/ des na/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes phyi dang nang gi chos 'gyur ba 'gro ba gang zhig yin yang / de dag thams cad rgyu dang rkyen gyi dbang gis byung ba yin zhes gsungs pa yin/de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung nas/ dngos po'i chos la 'gyur ba ji ltar byas te 'gro tshul la rgyu dang rkyen tsam la brten nas byung ba red ces gsungs pa'i sde tshan gcig dang / yang / chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i rgyu de rgyu mtshan la sbyar na/ gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar rgyu 'bras kyi rgyu ste rgyu 'bras rten 'byung gi thog nas bsam blo btang na/gong du zhus pa ltar yin la/ de la nang gses kyis nga tshor 'brel ba yod pa dang /nga tshos gal 'gangs chen por brtsib ni bde sdug gnyis yin/ bde sdug gnyis po ji ltar byas te byung ba yin zhe na/ de ni rang bzhin chos nyid yin pa las de la rgyu mtshan 3(da rgyu phal cher med/ nang gi shes pa zhig yod pa de yang chos nyid yin pa las rgyu mtshan sgo(da rgyu med/ gzugs can gyi chos sems med bem por 'gro ba de yang 'jig rten chos nyid yin pa las gzhan shod rgyu khag po yin/ de bzhin 'byung ba bzhi dang nam mkha' bcas ji ltar byas te byung ba yin

tsho — chiḥ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (31)zhe na/ chos nyid yin pa las sgosgod rgyu gzhan med/ der brten chos nyid kyi rigs pa zhes pa 'di gzhi la bzhag dbo(sa pa yin/ dper na/ tshan rig pa zhig yin yang / gzhi yi rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi gnas tshul zhig khas blangs rjes rdzas kyi 'gyur ba dang / rkyen gyi 'gyur ba ji ltar byas te yong min la bsam blo gtong dgos/ dngos po'i chos rang rang la nus pa thun mong ma yin pa re re yod pa de lhan skyes kyi nus pa dang / de la'ang dpag tshod kyis skyedar byung gi nus pa zhig kyang 〈snang ba yin/ stos pa'i rigs pa zhes pa ltar rdzas phan tshun bsdebs pa'i thog nas rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba re re yong ba yin/des na nang gi shes pa'am tshor ba la/ 'du shes kyis yul rig pa'i chos shig 〈snad pa yin/ de lta bu'i shes pa de la tshor ba bde sdug dang btang snyoms gsum yong ba las/ tshor ba bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa zhig rang gi ngang gis yong gi yod/ der brten nga tshor 'brel ba yod pa dang /nga tshor gnad 'gag gang zhig chags kyi yod ce na/ bde ba zhes pa de nga tshor dgos la/ sdug bsngal 'es pa de nga tshor mi dbordzos pa yin/ des na bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni/ nga rang tsho'i 'dzam gling 'di'i steng sems can chags pa nas bzung ste sems can thams cad kyis bde ba dang 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i dbang gis 'gul bskyod rgyag gi yod/ de'i nang tshan nas mi la cha bzhag na/ mi'i spyi tshogs 'di 'das pa'i 'ordzo khri phrag dang / 'bum phrag kha dgas

(32) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skosakyi nang ha las dgos pa'i 'gyur ba 'gro ba de dag bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i shugs rkyen gyi dbang gis 'gul bskyod rim par brgyab ste 'gyur ba byung ba yin/ des na nga tsho'i mi che'i nang la'ang gang zhig gal 'gangs chen po yin zhe na/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal zhes pa 'di gal chen po chags 〈snad/gal 'gangs chen po chags pa'i bde ba dang sdug bsngal zhes pa gang 'dra zhig yin pa der nyams zhib byed dbeshas pas na/cesas rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes gsungs yod/ spyir 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad rgyu rkyen las byung ba dang / yang gos lhag par can du nga tsho dang 'brel ba yod pas/ gal gnad che ba'i bde ba dang sdug bsngal zhes pa 'di gnyis rgyu dang rkyen tsam las brten nas byung ba yin/ de ni rtag pa'i rgyu las byung ba min la/ rgyu med las kyang byung ba min/ 'jig rten bkod pa pos bkod pa yang min/ de ni rang bzhin gyi rgyu rkyen la brten nas yong gi yod/de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bde ba'i rgyu mthun pa gang zhig yin zhe na/ gzhan la phan 'dogs pa dang / bzang po byas na de'i 'bras bu bde ba yong ba dang /gzhan la gnod pa byed pa dang / ngan pa byas na de'i 'bras bur sdug bsngal yong ba bcas de ltar rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas yong gi yod/

ci tshoX༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (82)'o na nga rang tsho su dang su yin yang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa sha stag yin/ 'o na bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba yag po zhig mi yong ba dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang sdug bsngal rtag tu yong ba de gang gis lan pa yin zhe na/ de ni ma shes pa dang ma rig pa'i dbang gis byung ba yin/ mdor na don gyi yin lugs gang zhig yin pa de ma shes pas de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang / las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis bde sdug gi rgyu la phyin ci log tu spyad pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal zam ma chad par yong ba dang / bde ba 'dod kyang bde bas phongs pa'i gnas tshul 'di byung ba yin/ des na de bzhin gshegs pas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung zhes pa 'di gsung skabs/ las kyi kun 'byung dang nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis dang / nyon mongs la'ang nyon mongs dug gsum dang /nyon mongs dug lnga/ mnyon drug sogs nyon mongs kyi rnam gzhag mang po zhig gsungs yod/ nyon mongs de dag kyang spyir nga rang tsho'i blo'i nang shes pa de mngon du gyur ba'i mtshams su rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de'i sems ma/ zhi bar gabrug pa dang ma skyid pa byed pa'i blo zhig yod pa de skyon du ngos 'dzin mkhan nang pa gcig pu min/ mu stegs pa'i gzhung gi nang du'ang nyon mongs kyi rnam gzhag thon yong gi yod/ dper na/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs la nyes dmigs su bltas nas 'og sa la rags par bltas/ rang sa 'dod pa'i nyon mongs mngon gyur ba

(88) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skor/med pa'i rang sa la zhi bar bltas nas nyon resnangs rags pa'i gras la gnyen potho bsten nas 'gro ba yod/ de ni mu stegs pa'i gzhung du yod pa tsam ma yin par nyams len 'di ltar byas nas khams bostong ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi skusgon tan mngon du byed pa de m+wa yang yong gi yod/de bzhin ye shu'i chos kyi nang ngas shes tshod ltar byas na/ rtsaba'i sdig pa bdun zhes pa zhig yong gi 〈snad/ de dag gi nang phrag dog dang / zhen chags sogs bgrang yod/ de rnams la skyon du bltas nas sdig pa'i ming btags yod/ mdo don las dang nyon mongs kyi rnam dbye phye min ji ltar yang / de rnams skyon du ngos ledron pa chos lugs mang po'i nang gsungs yod/ dper na/ khong khro shugs chen po zhig langs na ma skyed 'esgong ba dang / de bzhin chags pa shugs tshun sgo zhig smyes rna zhes/ skyang slo smyin lpa khrong gi slob/ des n+da rde gig smyon srin bla nga tshos gang 'tshams ngos 'dzin thub kyi yod/ dud 'gros /bong khro langs pa dang /chags pa skyes pa de dag skyodan yin pa phal cher shes thub rgyu khag potho yin/ mi la rnam dgyod yod pa'i dbang gis cung zad bsam blo gsor thub kyi yod/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos nas yul yid du 'ong ba la dmigs nas chags pa dang / yul yid du mi 'ong ba la dmigs nas snang ba skyes pa de gnyis ka su la yid du 'ong bar snang ba dang / su la yid du mi 'ong ba snang ba yin min byed pa po'am yid du 'ong mi 'ong snang mkhan gcig la ltos nas yid du 'ong

sna ca༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen sto mchog (88)ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba bzhag dadzasgos pa yin/ des na yul yid du 'ong ba la dmigs nas chags pa dang du len pa dang / yul yid du mi 'ong ba la dmigs nas mi 'dod pa rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i slo yong ba'i gzhi ni/ gang la yid du 'ong bar snang sa dang / gang la yid du mi 'ong bar snang sa'i nga 'am gang zag gam skyes bu zhes pa de la 'brel ba shugs chen po zhig slebs kyi skusgod/ de ni sngon gyi mu stegs pa'i gzhung dang / da lta'ang 'dzam gling 'di'i steng chos lugs mang po zhig yod pa tshang mas chags snang la nyes dmigs dang / brtseb la yon tan du lta gi yod/ de bzhin byams pa dang bzod pa la yon tan du lta gi yod/ 'on kyang de dag gi gzhi rtsang zhes pa 'di'i thog la bsam blo gtong mkhan phal cher nyung nyung yin/ phal mo ches blo lhan skyes la phung por dbang sgyur mkhan gyi nga zhig blo la shar ba'i skabs su ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi blo la 'char stangs der bden kha sbyin nas de yod par ngos ladron cing yod par thag bcad pa dang / blo lhan skyes kyis yod pa zhig la 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad rang gis mos pas kyang phung po la dbang sgyur mkhan gyi nga rje bo lta bu zhig yod dgos so zhes bdag 'dzin lhan skyes brtan du gtong ba'i grub mtha' mang sto zhig slebs kyi 〈snad/ grub mtha' de'i lugs kyi thog nas bshad tshul de la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung nas bltas na/de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /

(56) las rgyu r+sās dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skosazhes pa'i bde sdug gnyis sems dul ba dang sems ma dul ba'i thog nas yong ba dang / blang dor gyi gnas la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa'i thog nas yong gi yod ces pa de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sa zhib tshags shing / phra zhing phra ba'i sgo nas dngos po'i gnas lugs la gang zhig gnas pa de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa red ces brjod na tag tag 'gro gi yod/rtsab nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi nang nas bdag med pa'i lta ba zhes gsungs yod/ de yang / 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba ste chos kyi sdom bzhi las/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa zhes nang pa'i gzhung nas gsungs yod/ de ltar nang pa'i gzhung nas bdag med pa'i lta ba zhes gsungs pa ni/ chags snang gi glo de skyon yin pa chos la bsam blo cung zad gtong mkhan tshang ma'i mthun snang du grub pa yin pas yul de rang la le lan bda' sa med par/ yul de la dmigs mkhan gyi thog nas bsam blo'i khyad par yong ba zhig yin/ des na/de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas su grub pa min zhes dang / phung po las don gzhan pa'i bdag med/ bdag ces pa de phung sto la brten nas btags pa zhig las/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes la ji ltar snang ba ltar nga

zhesirnyi wagong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (37)tshugs thub pa phung po la ltos med rang rkya ba lta bu zhig med ces nang pa'i gzhung nas 'di ltar gsung gi yod/ des na sdug bsngal yong ba'i rkyen rnams kyang thub pa'i gsung nang yod ces gsal por gsung gi yod pa dang / sdug bsngal yong ba'i rkyen de dag gsung gi yod stabs/ sdug bsngal yong ba'i rkyen de rnams rtag pa yin na bcos su med la/ rgyu med las skyes pa zhig yin na'ang bcos su med pa zhig phal cher yin/ de yang rgyu las skyes pa zhig yin stabs/ de'i rgyu la 'gal zla yod dam med/ de la 'gal zla yod na rgyu de'i gnyen po chags kyi yod/'gal zla med na de ga yin/der brten nga zhes pa de blo la ji ltar snang ba ltar nga don steng nas yod pa'am/ nga phung po la dbang sgyur mkhan gyi rang rkya ba zhig blo la ji ltar snang ba ltar don la gnas min rtsad gcod byas na shes thub pa dang / gang zhig shes thub ce na/ phung po la brten nas btags tsam zhig las/ phung po las don gzhan pa lta ci smos/ rang rkya ba zhig kyang med pa phal cher shes thub pa yin/ de la ji tsam dpyad pa byas pa de tsam gyis je gsal dang / nges pa je cher 'gro ba yong gi yod/ dper na/ bdag med ces pa der lo nas lo bstud de bsam blo rim pas gtong skabs sems la gang 'tshams kyi tshor ba zhig slebs kyi yod/ nga zhes brjod skabs sems nang ji ltar snang ba ltar nga de med bsam pa zhig dang /goms tshos kyi dbang las blo la rang gi ngang gis yong ba zhig yong rgyu yod/

(38) las rgyu tsos dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i sgosangs bdag med phra mo swār+shags 〈snad ces brjod kyi med/ bdag med phra mo rtogs med kyang glo de'i phyogs la je nyer song ste/ nga zhes brjod skabs nam rgyun blo la snang ba ltar med bsam pa zhig rgyu mtshan la bsam blo gtong mi dbesnas par shar yong gi 'dug pa des shugs rkyen zhig tan tan thebs kyi yod/ mdor na bdag med kyi phyogs la bsam blo btang na nges pa rnyed rgyu 〈snad pa zhig dang /bdag tu grub pa'i phyogs la bordzoms pa'i dbang gis yerdzod pa red bsam pa rang gi ngang gis shar ba las/ de yod pa'i sgrub byed gtan nas med cing / blo lda gnyis 'dzin stangs 'gal ba yin pa tsam du ma zad/ de la goms kyang nges shes 'dren rgyu med pa dang / cig shos la goms na nges shes 'dren rgyu yod pa dang /nges pa je cher 'gro rgyu yod pa zhig yin/ des na de gnyis gnod bya gnod byed yin pa gang zhig la/ gcig la rgyab rten gyi tshad ma 〈snad pa dang / cig sgo(sa la rgyab rten gyi tshad ma med pa'i dbang gis bosgoms 'dres bsten na shugs che chung yong gi yod/des na nga rang tsho'i mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal de ji ltar byas te yong gi yod pa dang / mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsab bdag tu 'odzin pa phyin ci log gi blo yin pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ngo sprad pa ltar ngo lasad skabs/ de'i ldog zla'i blo ma skyes pa skyes pa dang / skyes pa gong nas gong du spel te goms 'dris bsnyen na/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu byed mkhan gyi glo de shugs je chung du 'gro ba dang /

dwa 3 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (39)de tsam du ma zad sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba red ces pa de gnyis 'brel nas bsam blo btang na/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ldog rgyu yod pa zhig de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs yod/ des na/ cesas rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ / zhes spyir rgyu dang rkyen gyi dbang gis yong gi yod par gsungs pa dang /nang gses kyis nga rang tshor thad kur gal 'gangs chen po chags pa'i bde sdug gnyis po de rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas byung ba red ces sdug bsngal ldog rim dang / bde ba 'phel rim ji ltar yin pa de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi gsungs pa ste/ de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa red ces dang /rgyu la 'besgog pa gang yin pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ni mi mthun pa'i rgyu la gnyen so skyes pa'i thog nas sam/ de'i ldog zla'i blo rgyud la skyes pa'i thog nas rim bzhin sdug bsngal gyi rtsab byed mkhan gyi rgyu de zad pa'am/ rgyu de gnyen po skyes pa'i stobs kyis bral ba/gnyen po skyes pa'i stobs kyis slar skye mi rung bar byas pa sogs 'gog pa de gsungs yod ces gsung gi yod/ des na/rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos de skad gsungs/ /

(66) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skosazhes gsungs pa yin/ der brten bcom ldan 'das kyi chos ni/ gong du zhus pa ltar byams pa dang dad pa byed pa sesgogs ni chos lugs tshang ma'i nang gsungs yod/ rang rang gi ston pa'am skyabs gnas la dad pa byed rgyu lta bu ni chos rgyud tshang ma'i nang du yod/sngar khe ṇa ḍar ngas ngo shes pa'i ye shu'i chos pa rgya'u zhig yod/ khong nas dngos gnas 'jig rten bkod pa po'i ston pa'am 'jig rten bkod pa po'i dkon ma〈snag la bstod pa'i glu /byangs len skabs mig chu phrum phrum byed kyi 'dug pas/ nga rang yang sems 'byongs po zhig byung / khong rang 'jeg rten bkod pa por rtsegacig gi dad pa ha las pa'i shugs chen po yod 'dug des drangs pa'i gzhan la 'tshe ba mi byed pa dang / kun la brtseb byed pa de srog chags kun la yong min mi shes kyang / mi la brtseb byed pa lta bu yong gi yod/ des na dad pa byed pa ni nang pa gcig pu'i skad cha min/ phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed ces gsungs pa'i skyabs 'gro ni/ thun mong ma yin pa zhig gi thog nas bsam blo gtong dgos pa ste/ thar pa sgrub byed kyi thabs dang / thar pa sgrub byed kyi chos dang 'brel ba'i skyabs 'gro'i thog nas bsam blo gtong dgos pa las/spyir btang gi skyabs 'gro ni phyi pa la'ang shugs chen po zhig yod/ nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa la/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /

— 5 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (61)zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thar pa zhes pa 'di blo la nges shing / thar pa don du gnyer ba'i blo ngo ma skyes na/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dboston mchog bcas la dngos gnas kyi dad pa zhig skyes thub/ de min thar pa zhes pa de thag ring du bzhag nas/ sngerdzon la a sgor gal che bar brtsis nas bsdad na/ phal cher nga rang tsho mngon mtho'i phun tshogs don du gnyer mkhan gyi skyabs de a sgordzor yin/ des na lus la grwa chas spyodan nas a sgor gyi rjes su cung zad rgyugs dgos kyi 'dug bod pa btsan byol bar cha bzhag na/ deng skabs a rir phyin na dpal 'byor yag po yong gi red ces a ri ni deng skabs skyabs gnas kyi yul chags grabs byed kyi 'dug spo rmo'i nang nas a rir slebs rogs byas na zhes brjod mkhan de 'dra yong gi yod/ der brten nga rang tsho'i 'phral gyi mngon mtho'i phun tshogs kyi skyabs yul a ri dang a sgor la rtsigi yod pa yin/ skabs re the wan gyi rgya mis yig skogs dmar po'i nang dngul blugs nas 'khyer yong gi yod stabs/ deng skabs the wan de nga rang tsho'i skyabs rtsis gcig chags te rgyug 'gro gi yod/ deng skabs sod nang yod pa'i bla ma dang grwa pa khag gcig ha cang yag po 〈snad/ 'on kyang 'ga' zhig gis rgya nag gi nang du rgya sgor gyi gdung 'bod byed par 'gro gi yod/ 'ga' zhig dngul don du gnyer nas chos 'tshong mkhan yang yod 'dug de tsho'i gras kyis skyabs gnas dngul la bcol ba las dkon mchog gsum la bcol gyi med/
