162) las rgyu tsos dang/rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skosade dag gis 'phral gyi mngon mtho'i phun tshogs tsam don du gnyer ba las thar pa don du gnyer gyi med pa yin/ des na sangs rgyas dkon mchog la skyabs su mchi zhes brjod nas de ring gi grod pa rgyags pa la phan gyi med stabs/ de ring grod pa ltogs pa'i skabs su kha lag rtsache bar rtsib las/ sangs rgyas de tsam rtsacher rtsigi med/rgya mi gung khran gyis sngon ma nga tsho'i bla ma dge bshes mang po btson du bcug pa'i skabs der sto chas ma sprad par khyed rang tshor sto chas dkon mchog gis sprod kyi red/ dkon mchog la smon lam rgyobs zhes brjod pa'i gnas tshul byung yod/ de ltar byas te yong thub bam/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu longs spyod kyis mi che'i dka' ngal sel thub pa yong ba de brgyud nas yong dgos pa las/ da lta grod khog stogs pa 'di skyabs 'gro byas nas de 'phral sel thub pa yong thabs med/ da lta brjod bzhin pa ltar/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi thar pa zhes pa 'di bsam blo'i nang slebs na/dngos gnas tshe 'di'i phun tshogs ji tsam yod kyang de dag bslu ba'i chos can dang / ji tsam phun sum tshogs kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin dang /las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pas/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can gyi skye

sdo 2 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (63)ba 'di dang ma bral na skyid pa zhig mi 'dug bsam pa zhig yod cing / de 'dra'i skabs su/dub pas sems nyid de ring ngal gsos shig /ces gsungs pa 'di la bsam blo btang ste/ thar pa thob na ngal gso thebs pa las/ thar pa ma thob bar du ngal gasdu'o zebs thabs mi 'dug snyam pa zhig byung na/ de mtshams dngos gnas phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed thub pa yong gi yod/ de min skyabs 'gro'i gnas lugs yag po ma shes par skyabs 'gro tsam gyis phyi nang gi khyad par 'byed thub rgyu khag po yin/ de bzhin byams dang snying rje bsgom pa cha bzhag na/ mu stegs pa'i nang byams dang snying rje sgom mkhan yod/ dper na/ gcer bu pa la cha bzhag na/ de'i thad nga tsho las lhag pa med kyang chad pa med/ 'tshe ba mi byed pa sogs ha las dgos pa 'dug de bzhin ye shu'i chos pa'i nang ha las dgos pa de 'dra 'dug nga rang tshos sems can thams cad ces smon lam rgyag gi yod kyang / don dngos thog mdze nad can gyi nad g.yog rgyugs mkhan dkon pa yin/ 'on kyang ye shu'i chos pa'i nang 'jig rten bkod pa po la yid ches dang 'brel ba'i thog nas 'jig rten bkod pa pos bkod pa'i sems can nyam thag pa la phal cher rang gi smrasag blos gtong lta bu'i sgo nas zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan 〈snang gi 'dug de ni rgya che chung gi gnas tshul tha dad yin yang don du byams pa dang snying rje nyams len byed kyi yod/

(63) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skor/der brten spyir btang byams pa dang snying rje tsam gyi thog nas phyi nang gi khyad par 'byed thub rgyu khag po yin/ de bzhin bzod pa'i thog nas khyad par 'byed dka' la/ chog shes bsten pa'i thog nas phyi nang gi khyad par yang 'byed dka'/gzhan yang tshangs spyod dang dka' thub bsten pa'i thog nas phyi nang gi khyad par 'byed khag po yin/ phyi nang gi khyad par ngo ma ni bdag med kyi lta ba'i thog nas khyad par 'byed kyi yod/ kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam bzhad ngag dbang brtsone 'grus kyi grub mtha' rtsab las/bdag lta'i zhen yul sgrub 'gog phyi nang gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa de yin/ phyi pa dang nang pa'i tshangs thig lta bu ni bdag tu smra ba'am bdag tu lta ba'i grub mtha' yod pa de chos 'di las phyi rol du gyur pa'i grub mtha' yin/ sngon la bdag med phra rags yin min ji ltar yang / bdag med ces pa'i tha snyad cig bshad pa'i thog nas brjod pa dang / da dung de las rgya cung zad che ru btang na/ bdag med ces brjod ma nus kyang / brjod du med pa'i bdag ces phung po las don gzhan pa'i bdag rang rkya ba zhig med ces brjod pa lta bu'i thog nas 'gro gi yod/ phyi nang gi khyad par des 'byed kyi yod/ des na nga rang tsho nang pa yag po zhig byed kyi yin na/ nang pa'i lta grub gang 'dra yin pa shes dgos rgyu ha cang gal 'gangs chen po yin/ nang pa'i bdag med kyi lta ba phra rags gang 'dra zhig bshad dgos byung yang / mthar gtugs bdag med

pha ——ri 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (68)pa'i lta ba rags pa zhig bshad kyang / bdag ces pa de phung po la brten nas btags pa zhig yin pa las/ phung po la dbang sgyur mkhan gyi bdag don gzhan du med ces pa 'di'i thog nas bsam blo gtong gi mardzod/ bdag med phra mo'i thog tu slebs skabs gang zag rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa red ces brjod pa de yang brten nas btags pa ming rkyang btags mardzod tsam gyi bdag cig red ces bshad kyi yod/ gang ltar brten nas btags pa'i steng nas 'gro gi yod/ rgyu 'bras rten 'byung dang / brten nas btags pa'i rten 'byung sogs rten 'byung gi rim pa mang po zhig bshad pa'i thog nas dang / spyi yongs rten 'byung gi go ba'i steng nas gsung gi yod/des na ye dhaṅgālinang gi rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas yong ba zhes pa des gang zhig gsung gi yod ce na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'byung gi lta ba de gsung gi yod/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lta ba de nang pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sgos chos yin/ de'i thog nas bye brag smra ba rnams kyis kyang dpag tshod kyis bdag med kyi skor la dgongs pa bzhes kyi yod/ de nas dbu sems gnyis kyi skabs dang / lhag par slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis 'grel pa bud+dha pa'i ta'i nang brten nas btags pa de ha cang gis gsungs pa dang / mdor na dpal mabesgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dbostongs pa dbyis phyin pa de gsung gi yod/ de lta bu'i sgo nas rten 'brel gyi don la phra rags mang po yong gi yod kyang /

166) las rgyu las dang/rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skodaspyi yongs kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba rten 'byung yin zhes brjod pa 'di gnad 'gag ha cang chen po chags 〈snad/de nas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lta ba de'i thog nas bsam blo gtong skabs/ nga rang tsho'i tshong gi las ka dang /khor yug gi gnas tshul/ 'dzam gling gi zhi bde/ chab srid kyi gnas tshul sesgogs gang zhig yin yang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lta tshul 'di'i thog nas bltas pa yin na/ tshang ma rgyu rkyen mang sto zhig dang 'brel yod pa mthong rgyu yod/ 'dis rkyen pas 'di yong ba dang /de'i dbang las de zhes pa zhig bsam blo'i nang du lusar na/ tan tan dngos yod gnas tshul la ran pa zhig 〈snang ba yin/ dngos po'i gnas tshod la thams cad 'dod pa'i don zhig dang / yang na mi 'dod pa'i don sesgogs thams cad rgyu dang rkyen mang po zhig la brten nas yong ba dang / de yang da lta yod pa'i rgyu rkyen tsam min par kha sang kha nyin dang / 'das pa'i lo dang / yang na 'das pa'i lo stong phrag gcig gi grerdzong dang / 'osgo khri phrag gcig bosgong gi rgyu rkyen dang 'brel ba zhig chags mardzod pas de las sla po zhig med/ lo stong phrag dang khri phrag nas mar rgyu rkyen smin zin pa zhig de ring dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang 'gyur ba gtong gi yin zhes brjod rgyu ha cang khag po yin/dper na/ 'dzam gling gi tsha drod la 'gyur ba 'gro ba 'di phran bu mi'i byed spyod kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod/ gzhi rtsa'e 'gro phyogs ni lo stong phrag

dzāX 7gong sa 7 bas mgon chen po mchog 167)dang khri phrag gi 'gyur ba'i thog nas yong gi yod pas/ de ni nga tshos 'gyur ba gtong thub pa zhig min/ de dag shes pa'i thog nas bsam blo btang na sdug skad rgyag sa bsdad med cing / de ni bcos su med pa zhig yin/ de ltar dngos rgyu'i nus pa therdzog med nas grub zin pa zhig yin na/ de ni bcesas su med pa zhig yin pas/ ngas zhu 'dod pa yang 'di yin/ der brten nga tshos 'tshe ba byed rgyu med/gang lags she na/ las 'bras kyi skad cha ma bshad kyang / mthong cesas su rang gi bde sdug gzhan la bltos te yod pa dang / nga rang tsho 'dzam gling 'di'i steng gi mi yin zhing / 'dzam gling 'di'i mi'i bde sdug ni 'dzam gling spyi dang 'brel nas yod pas/ lardom gling spyi skyid na nga skyed pa yong ba dang / ladzam gling spyi bde na nga yang bde po yong ba yin/ ladzam gling spyi bde na stod kyang bde po yong ba dang / 'dzam gling spyi sdug na sod kyang sdug po yong ba yin/des na 'dod par rang gi bde ba bsam gyi yod kyang / rang gi bde ba ni rgyu rkyen du ma la brten nas byung ba yin/ des na rang gi bde ba la ji tsam gyis gtsigs cher 'dzin pa de'i tshod kyis rgyu rkyen de dag la'ang do snang byed dgos pa dang / gces spras byed dbosgos pa yin/ der brten rang gi mi che'i bde sdug spyi tshogs dang 'brel yod par brten rang gi bde sdug gi don du spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa dang / rang gi bde skyid kyi don du spyi tshogs bde skyid ldan pa 〈snang ba byed dgobyus pa yin/ de la phyogs gcig nas bsam

168) las rgyu 'bras dang /rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skor/blo btang na/ byams pa dang brtseba'i skad cha min par dngos yod gnas tshul la de 'dra zhig slebs yong gi yod/ de tsam du ma zad mi mang po'i slo bur gyi bsam blo'i nang du byams pa dang snying rje lag len bstar na gzhan la phan pa las rang la phan thogs med/ da dung byams pa dang snying rje bsgoms pa'i dbang gis sems pa ma skyid pa 〈snang rgyu las gzhan med bsam pa lta bu dran gyi yod/ de 'dra rtsab nas min/ byams dang brtseb bsgoms te bosgoms 'dris chags na/ rang la phan pa las des gzhan la phan min the tshom yin/dpe chung chung zhig brjod na/ nga rang phar tshur 'gro ba'i skabs gad mo dgod bzhin 'gro ba khyed rang tshos shes gsal yin/ 7rgyal ba rin po che ga dus mjal yang zhal 'tsher 'tsher la bzhugs kyis 'dug zer/ phyi rgyal yul gru khag tu 'grerdzo skabs lam g.yas gasku(na la mi thug dus gad lngardzo dbesgod bzhin 'gro gi yod/ mi kha shas la phar gad mo bgad na tshur yang gad mo dgod kyi 'dugade ni khong rang skyed po yong gi yod la nga rang yang skyid so yong gi 'dugayang mi kha shas la phar gad mo bgad na/ ngas ngo mi shes kyang nga la gad mo dgod kyi 'dug bsams nas ma bde ba byed mkhan 'dug nga rang ni gad mo bgad nas skyid po 'dug khong rang rnam rtog za ba sdug gyong red/ gnas tshul de la gzhigs na brtsebs phar la gad mo bgad pa de pha rol po la gnod pa las phan gyi med pa yin/der brten byams pa dang brtse ba'i nyams len gyis rang nyid la tan tan phan gyi

7gong sa 7skyabs maman chen po mchog (69)yod pas/ de la dogs pa byed dgos don med/ sems glod pa lta bu'i skyid so yod/ des pha rol por phan dang mi phan ni pha rol po'i bsam blo gtong stangs la rag lus pa las/ ngas gad mo bgad pa'i rkyen gyis pha rol po'i rgyud la zhi bde bag phebs yong ba'i nges pa med/ byams pa dang brtseba'i bsam blo btang na rang la thad kur phan pa dang / gzhan la phan dang mi phan ni kho rang la rag lus pa yin/de bzhin me tog dang ljon shing la sogs par brtse ba bsgom rgyu med kyang / de dag la 'tsho ba'i thob thang yod pas don med kyi sa rko ba dang / skye ba gcod pa sogs 'gro nor sdod zhor la lo ma me tog bkog pa sogs mi byed par brtsibakur lta bu byas na/ rang gi sems nang zhi bde yong rgyur phan thogs yod/ gang ltar rje rin po ches bsam pa gzhan don bsams nas rang don zhar la sgrub pa zhes gsungs yod/ de ltar yong ba yang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gnas tshul nas yong gi yod/ rang gi bsal bya'i sdug bsngal dang / bsgrub bya'i bde ba de rgyu dang rkyen du ma tshogs pa'i steng nas yong gi yod stabs/ dngos yod gnas tshul ji tsam rgyu dang rkyen kyi rigs tshul bzhin du bsten pa de'i tshod kyis rang 'a/ 'bras bu bde skyid yong gi yod/ de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gtso bo brten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lta ba dang / de'i grub don la 'tshe ba spangs nas brtseb byed dgos zhes gsungs pa de yin/ de dag nang pa'i chos ngo spyod yin/ gzhi yi gnas tshul de 'dra yin pas na/ da dung rgyu dang rkyen zhib

(76) las rgyu tsos dang/rten 'byung gi lta ba'i skosatshags su gtong skabs/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs yod/ de ltar rang gi sems yongs su 'dul tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ thabs lam de rnams kyis rim pas sgrom gzhi bslangs te/ mthar zug ye shes kyi tshogs sam shes rab kyis sems 'dul dgos pa yin/ de la yang mdo sngags thun mong gi she sa rab gcig dang / sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i shes rab gcig de'i nang nas sngags bla med dam/ skabs 'dir nang rgyud sde gsum ste mahā/ a nu/ a ti gsum las mthar thug a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i thog nas sems 'dul ba yin/ 'di'i sems 'dul ba ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa zhi ba tsam min pas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa zhi ba ni mdo sngags thun mong gi lam gyis byed thub pa yin/ gnyis snang phra mo'am dri ma phra mo rnams sngags bla med kyi lam kho nas dri ma de sel dgos pa las thabs gzhan med/ des na sems 'dul ba'i rim pa mang po zhig gi steng nas 'gro dgos pa yin/ sems ma dul ba'i cha pags pa'i rim pa lta bu ha cang mang po zhig yod pas na/ rim pa lta bu gang 'tshams bar mdo lam gyi thog nas sel thub kyi yod/ de nas je phra je phrar phyin pa'i skabs sngags lam gyi ma gtogs sel thabs med/ des na 'od

dzi 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (71)rgesalardzogasapa chen po'i lam gyis sems kyi dri ma phra zhing phra ba sel thabs byed pa'i lam de lta bu zhig thog nas 'gro dgos pa yin/ de lta bu'i lam nyams su len pa la/ thog mar thun mong sdon 'gro ste/ ji tsam gyis dngos gzhi'i nyams len la do snang slebs pa de'i tshod kyis de'i rgyu tshogs la gces sto byed dgos pa de gal chen po yin/ lam la mtho dman brtsis na gong ma gong ma'i lam la yid 'phyogs nas de la don gnyer ji tsam skyes pa de'i tshod kyis de yi spon 'gro 'og ma 'og ma'i rgyu tshogs de dag tshags su tshud pa zhig byed dgos pa yin/ de ni dngos po'i gshis lugs yin// //cig tshoni/shig tshotsho pho ༷'i—47 (༷༷) rdo //ga byedago //sprongariX'o(

(72) sdig spong dge sgrub dang /rang sems 2la dgos tshul/ cisdig spong dge sgab dang /rang sems 'dul degos tshul/ de yang mdo las/sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su khrul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes ji skad gsungs pa ltar thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i ston pa bka' drin can 'di yongs grags ltar na lo nyis stong drug brgya tsam gyi gong du 'dzam gling 'di'i thog byon zhing / des gsungs pa'i chos tshul nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa zhes pa 'di dus da lta bar gnas pa ni gang m+wa zhig yin zhe na/ sdig pa spong zhing / dge ba bsgrub dgos pa ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyis spyod sdig pa'i las spong dgos pa dang / dge ba'i las bsgrub thos/tsho 1do(pe 1de /bye/ the/de :khro /smras phoge 1dod sa pa na/ ltar da da sa pa rgyu mtshan gang na na/ ba ba dang sdug bsngal zhes pa ni rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas byung bas/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal nga tshos mi 'dod cing / sdug bsngal mi yong ba'i thabs shes ni/ 'bras bu sdug

ca 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (73/bsngal skyed byed kyi rgyu sdig pa spong dgos pa yin/ des na/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /zhes gsungs pa yin/bde skyid ni nga rang tsho tshang mas 'dod kyi yod na/ bde skyid kyi rgyu ni dge bar spyod pa/ las bzang sto zhig bsags pa la brten nas 'bras bu bde skyed yong gi yod/ des na/ dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /ces gsungs pa yin/'o na sdig pa dang dge ba zhes pa gang 'dra zhig yin zhe na/ sdig pa zhes pa ni smod par byed pa dang / 'jigs par byed pa/ mdor na gnod pa'i rang bzhin can zhig la sdig pa zhes brjod kyi yod/ de yang bya ba gang zhig sgrub pa'i skabs su bya ba de gang zag gzhan zhig mi bde ba dang ma skyed pa byed pa dang / sdigs par byed pa/ 'jegs par byed pa bcas kyi bya ba der sdig pa zhes brjod kyi yod/ de tsam du ma zad bsam blo zhib phra btang na lus ngag gi sdig pa'i las gang zhig sgrub pa'i skabs su sgrub pa po rang gi blo yang 'khrugs te ma skyed pa yong ba'i thog nas gnod pa'i las de dag byed kyi yod/dper na srog gcod pa lta bur cha bzhag na/ pha rol po'i srog bcad de pha rol po'i lus dang phral ba'i gnod pa byed kyi yod/ nga rang tsho su zhig yin yang rang gi srog ni gces shos byed kyi yod/ rang gi gces shos byed pa de la gnod pa byed mkhan ni sdig pa'i las byed mkhan yin/ nga rang tsho nang bzhin rang gi srog la gces sesgos byed mkhan pha rol po'i srog la brtse ba dang gus zhabs

(73) sdig spong dge sgrub dang /rang sems 'dul dgos tshul/med par de'i sresag phral bar byed pa'i bya ba sgrub pa'i skabs su'ang pha rol po la khro ba'i sems dang / snang ba'i sems/ gnag sems sesgogs kyi thog nas pha rol po'i srog 'phrog par byed kyi yod/ pha rol po la brtseba'i sems shig yod na sresag 'phrog par mi byed pa yin/ pha rol por gnod pa'i sems shugs chen po skyes pa'i skabs su rang nyid kyi sems kyang skyid pa gang yang med/ de 'dra'i ngang nas sdig pa'i las byed kyi yod/ mdor na rang gzhan gnyis kur gnod cing sdigs par byed pa'i bya ba dang kun slong bcas la sdig pa'i las dang / sdig pa'i sems zhes brjod kyi yod/dge ba zhes pa ni/ dge zhing shis pa'i las te bkra shis pa'i don yin zhing / dge bar gyur cig bkra shis par gyur cig ces pa bzang po'i don yin/las gang zhig byas pa des pha rol po'i rgyud la dga' bde slebs pa dang / rang nyid las de sgrub pa'i skabs su sems dga' lhang lhang dang spro lhang lhang gi thog nas dge ba'i las gsog gi yod/ dper na/ gzhan la sbyin pa gtong ba dang /srog gcod spong ba/ sems/ can tshe thar gtong ba sogs dge ba'i las sgrub skabs tshe thar gtong ba'i sems can de la brtse ba'i bsam pa rang dang blo nye zhing snying nas brtseb dang / snying brtse'i dbang gis yul de yang rang la yid du 'ong bar snang nas/ de mthong ba tsam gyis sems nang dga' snang slebs pa lta bu yong gi yod/ des na dge ba'i las sam phan pa'i bya ba des pha rol po la phan pa

zhesi5 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (78)smos ci/ de sgrub pa'i skabs su'ang rang gi sems la skyid snang dang / zhi bde'i blo zhig yong gi yod par brten/sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /ces gsungs pa yin/ de ltar spong dgos pa'i sdig pa'i las dang / dang du len dgos pa'i dkar po dge ba'i las gnyis po ni/ blo yi khyad par dang 'brel nas yong gi yod/ sdig pa gsog pa dang dge ba sgrub pa gnyis ka rtsab sems la rag lus sku(da/ gcerdzod pa'i sems ni sems ma dul ba zhig yin la/des ma skyid pa yong gi yod/ brtseba'i bsam pas sems la bde skyid spyod kyi yod/ gnod sems skye ba'i skabs su pha rol pos nga la gnod pa byed kyi red snya ma pa'i 'jigs snang rang bzhin du slebs nas mi bde ba zhig yong gi yod/de'i thog nas zhe sdang dang khong khro skye ba dang / des zhakhrug pa brgyab nas srog gcod pa sogs yong gi yod/ spyir srog gcod la'ang gti mug gi dbang gis srog gcod pa dang / 'dod chags kyi dbang gis srog gcod pa sogs mi 'dra ba yod kyang / spyir btang gnod pa'i bsam pa'i thog nas pha rol po'i srog bcad pa yin pas/ gnod sems rtsub mo skye ba'i skabs su rang nyid kyi sems kyang ma skyid pa yong gi yod/ brtsesems bzang po skye ba'i skabs su rang gi sems la 'jegs snang med la/ brtseba'i bsam pa yod pa'i dbang gis g.yo sgyu ngo lkog byed dgos don med/ brtseba'i bsam pa zhes pa ni yul sems can dang sems

(76) sdig spong dge sgrub dang /rang sems 'dul dgos tshul/thag nye po yod pa zhig dang / gnod pa'i bsam pa ni yul sems can la pha rol so zhes sems thag ring po'i blo zhig yong gi yod/ ji tsam pha rol po dang sems thag ring ba de tsam gyis rang gi sems la the tshom slebs nas g.yo sgyu byed pa dang / phyi nang mi mtshungs pa byed pa de rigs yong gi yod/ rtsegacig tu phan pa'i bsam pa yod na/ bsnyen cing nye ba'i yul de la mgo bskor gtong dgos don med la/ phrag dog 'gran sems ni de bas yong dgos don med/ blo lda ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gu yangs po zhig sku(da/ des na sdig pa'i sems kyis sems ma skyid pa bzo ba dang / dge ba'i sems kyis sems skyed po bzo gi yod/ sems ma skyid pa bajosgo ma/khan de la sems ma zhi ba'am sems ma dul ba zhes brjesgod pa dang / sems skyid po bzo mkhan de la/ sems zhi ba'am sems dul ba zhes brjod kyi yod/ des na/rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ dge sdig gi blang dor byed pa ni khrims la brten pa lta bu min/ sems dul ma dul gyi thog nas dge sdig gi las gsesgog tshul gsungs yod/ 'o na sems 'dul lugs ji ltar yin zhe na/ yang mdo las/skar ma rab rib mar me dang / /sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang / /rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu/ /'dus byas chesgos rnams de ltar blta/ /

7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (77)zhes gsungs te rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba'i dngos po tshang ma 'jig pa'i rang bzhin dang / mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin/ gtan du mi gnas pa/ skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can/ de yang rkyen rag lus yod la/ rkyen la rag las pas gzhan la stortos pa yin pa/ gzhan la stortos pa yin pas na stortos med kyi rang dbang ba min pa/ des na dngos po'i yin lugs mi rtag pa dang / de bzhin bdag med gsungs tshul rnams bsam blor 'khor na rim bzhin sems ma rung ba de dag med par 'gro ba zhig yong rgyu yod/ des na/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi bshes spring las/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi/ /gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes pa ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba yin zhing / bosgong du bshad ma thag ji/ ltar rgyu rkyen la rag las pa nyid kyis ltos med rang dbang gis grub pa med 'i / gsungs yod/ des na mi rtag pa rtogs pa'i she sa rab dang / bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab bcas ni sems 'dul bar byed pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs rnams yin/ des na mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ ston pa'i bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas bstod phyag mdzad skabs/gang gis thugs brtses nyer bzung nas/ /lta ba thams cad spangs pa'i phyir/ /

(78) sdig spong dge sgrub dang /rang sems khrul dgos tshul/dam pa'i chos ni ston mdzad pa'i/ /skra( tam de la phyag 'tshal 'ordzo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal mi 'dod cing / bde ba 'dod pa'i sems can rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thob par byed pa'i thabs bdag med pa'i lta ba ston pa yin/ de yang nga rang tsho su zhig yin yang sdug bsngal 'dod mkhan gcig kyang med/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang sdug bsngal mang po zhig yong gi yod/sdug bsngal gzhan gyis bskosnad pa min par rang gi las kyis grub pa zhig yin/sdug bsngal de dag rgyu med pa'i thog nas byung ba min la/ rtag pa'i rgyu las kyang byung ba'ang min/ rtag pa rang byung gis skyes bus byas pa yang min/ des na rgyu rkyen la brten nas yong gi yod stabs/ mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang len byas nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sgrub kyi yod/ de ni ma shes rmongs pa'i dbang dang gcig gnyis nas phyin ci log tu rtogs pa'i lta bas byed kyi yod/ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin pa dang / bdag med pa la bdag tu lta ba/ sdug bsngal ba'i rang bzhin yin pa la bde bar lta ba/ mi gtsang ba'i rang bzhin la gtsang bar lta ba bcas kyi phyin ci log gi gtsang bde rtag bdag tu lta ba'i phyin ci log gi rtog pas sdug bsngal skye gi yod pa dang / blang dor gyi gnas la rmongs kyi yod/des na/gang gis thugs brtses nyer bzung nas/ /

/ri 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (79)ci stabathamasacad spangs pa'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyin ci log gi lta ba thams cad spong ba'i slad du chos bstan pa yin/ phyin ci 'o(ga gi lta ba spong thabs ni/ phyin ci log gi lta ba med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod pas lta ba de med par mi 'gyur la/ phyin ci log gi lta ba ni rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i log 'dzin gyi blo zhig yin/ de'i gnyen po ni yin lugs tshul bzhin du shes pa'i phyin ci ma 'ebyug pa'i lta ba gcig pus phyin ci 'ordzog gi lta ba sel thub pa las/ de min sngags bgrang nas sel thabs med la/ phyag 'tshal nas kyang phyin ci 'esgog gi lta ba med pa chags rgyu khag po yin/ brgyud nas phan thogs shig yong gi yod kyang / thad kur phan thogs yong mi thub/ thad shar phyin ci log gi lta ba med par bzo thabs ni/dper na/ mi rtag pa la rtag par zhen pa'i phyin ci log gi lta ba de nyid sel ba la mi rtag pa mi rtag pa yin pa shes pa'i glo des med par bzo gi martod/ bdag tu lta ba'i phyin ci log gi lta ba de bdag med pa'i tshul shes na bdag tu blta ba'i blo de med par chags kyi yod/ de bzhin gtsang bar 'dzin pa dang / bde bar 7ngon pa bcas kyi glo de yang glo de'i ldog phyogs skyes na 'odzin stangs 'gal ba'i blo lda dag rang bzhin gyis med par 'gyur gyi yod/ rtsab mthar gtugs skabs/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar sem/sa kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba yin pa

(66) sdig spong dge sgrub dang /rang sems 'dul dgos tshul/dang / dri ma ni glo bur ba'i tshul du byung ba las/ sems kyi lhan skyes rang bzhin la zhugs pa zhig min/ des na dri ma zhes pa ni bral rung yin pa dang / gnyen sto yod pa/ gnyen po skyes na dri ma bral rung du yod pa zhig yin stabs/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos nang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang zhes gsungs pa 'di ltar yin/ des na/ de ring cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i dus chen dang bcas ston pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i thog nas dmigs bsal phyag mchod dang / tshogs bsags sgrib spyong byed kyi yod la/ de lta bu'i go skabs dmigs bsal can 'dir ston pa'i bka' drin dran tshul ni/ ston pa'i chos tshul yag po shes pa byas/ de la brten nas ston pa'i yon tan shes rtogs thub pa dang / ston pa'i yon tan shes na ston pa'i bka' drin dran thub pa yong ba yin/ der brten/ston pa'i ngang tshul shes nas bstan pa la/ /yid ches rnyed pas rtag tu gang bar sgo(ga /ces gsungs pa ltar yin/ de yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa rang gi chos kyi thog nas bsam blo btang na/ rje bdag nyid chen pos rten 'brel bstod pa las/ don bzhin gzigs nas legs gsungs pa/ /khyod kyi rjes su slob pa la/ /rgud pa thams cad ring du gyur/ /

lke na 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (81)nyes kun rtsab bzlog phyir ro/ / khyod kyi bstan las phyir phyogs pa'i/ /yun ring ngal ba bsten byas kyang / /phyi phyir skyon rnams bos pa bzhin/ /bdag tu lta ba brtan phyir ro/ /e ma ho mkhas pas 'di nyid kyi/ /khyad par khong du chud gyur pa/ /de tshe rkang gi khong nas ni/ /khyod la ci phyir gus mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / grub mtha'i rtsab las/ston dang bstan pa lta bas phyi nang gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang / sangs rgyas pa'i chos las gzhan du gyur pa'i chos gnyis kyi khyad par shes pa'i thog nas/sangs rgyas pa'i chos la zhen khog dang / phyogs su lhung ba'i blos rang nyid kyi chos yag sgo(sa yin zhes brjod pa lta bu min par slob dpon bde byed bad ga pos mdzad pa'i lha las phul byung gi bstod pa las/bdag ni sangs rgyas mchesgog mi 'dzin/ /ser skya sogs la mi snang yang / /gang zhig rigs par ldan pa'i tshig /

182) sdig spong dge sgrub dang /rang sems 'dul dgos tshul/de nyid ston par yongs su ledron/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar blo phyogs su ma lhung bar blo gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas brtag dpyad byas/ rang gi nyams myong dang 'brel ba'i thog nas bsam blo btang na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lta ba yin zhes gsungs pa 'di dngos gnas dngos yerdzod gnas tshul dang 'tshams shing / nang bsam blo'i thog nas bsam gzhigs byas na sems la 'gul bskyedad thebs pa zhig yod/ de lta bu'i lta ba'i grogs dang bcas thar pa don gnyer gyi blo dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba dang / mdor na gzhan don don gnyer gyis rgyu byas shing / byang chub don gnyer gyi mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos tshul gyi snying po chags yod/des na ston pa'i rjes dran byed skabs/ ston pa'i yon tan rnams shes par byed dgos la/ phyi nang gi khyad par rnams kyang shes par byed dgos/ rang sde la cha bzhag na grub mtha' besgong 'og gi khyad par rnams shes pa'i thog nas ston pa'i bka' drin dran thub pa zhig byung na ha cang yag po yod/ ston pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran nas gang zhig byed dgos she na/ ston pa'i bslab bya rnams rang gi rgyud thog tu sbyar nas nyams len byed dgos pa de ha cang gal 'gangs chen po yin/ ston pa'i yon tan de yang sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mang du yod

de) 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (22)kyang / gtso bo thugs kyi yon tan dang / de la'ang yon tan mang du yod pa'i nang nas gtso so ni mkhyen pa'i yon tan dang brtseba'i yon tan yin/ de yang mgon 〈sna klu sgrub kyis/gang gis thugs brtses nyer bzung nas/ /lta ba thams cad spangs pa'i phyir/ /dam pa'i chos ni ston mdzad pa'i/ /zhes pas mkhyen pa'i yon tan dang / brtseba'i yon tan rnam gnyis gsungs yod/ des na nga rang tshos ston pa'i chos kyi snying po ston pa'i thugs rgyu da la yod pa'i brtseba'i yon tan te/ grub byed thugs rje bosgoms las byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar thugs rje chen po'am snying rje chen po goms pa la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi brtse ba'i yon tan mthar thug pa de byung ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud la 〈snad pa'i mkhyen pa'i 〈snan tan ni/ bdag med pa'i don la blo 'dris shing bostoms par byas pa'i shes rab mthar thug pa de sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i yon tan yin zhing / des na nga rang tshos ston pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran nas rjes dran ji ltar byed dgos she na/ de ni byang chub sems dang /stong nyid kyi lta ba gnyis nyams len bya rgyu de yin/ de yang spyir nga rang tsho mi tshe gcig dang / yang sgos de ring gi nyin mo 'dir gang thub byang chub kyi sems dang /stong nyid kyi lta ba'i thog bsam blo btang nas rang sems la myong ba thon rgyu yod

(22) sdig spong dge sgrub dang /rang sems 'dul dgos tshul/pa zhig dang / myong ba de'i thog nas sems la rim pas 'gyur ba 'gro thub pa'i thog nges par bsam blo gtong dgos/ phyag 'tshal skor sbyong sogs dge ba mang po zhig sgrub kyi yod pa de rnams byang chub kyi sems dang / stong nyid kyi lta ba ma skyes pa skyes pa dang / skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rgyu ru dmigs nas dge ྅1ra gzhan rnams de'i yan lag gi tshul du nyams len byed thub pa zhig byung na ha cang yag sto yong rgyu dang / ston pa'i rjes dran byed tshul 'di ltar yin zhes shāka' stsal to// //༷ —wa wa lke wa4rngubartsehwa ༷ wa wa

rtsol nga med sna//pa ri'eji/8 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 85bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang nang chos ngo sprod/༄༅/ /dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i skabs 'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas yongs grags brtsis na lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya lhag tsam phyin kyang / dus rabs 'di wo zhig gi skabs su sangs rgyas kyi chos thog mar rgya gar nas dar zhing / de nas shar phyogs kyi yul gru mang por rim bzhin khyab gdal phyin pa dang / nub phyogs kyi yul khag rnams su de snga sangs rgyas kyi chos dar myong med kyang / dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i skabs 'dir nub phyogs kyi yul gru'i nang sngon gyi bag chags sad pa lta bu'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi chos la do snang byed mkhan yong gi yod/ chos rgyud gtso che ba tshang ma ni mi la bzang po'i bslab bya rgyag mkhan sha stag dang / mi la phan thogs yod pa gcig gyur yin/ 'on kyang rang rang so so'i pha mes kyi dus chos gang zhig byed kyi yod pa de ltar byas na rlings po dang yag po yod ces brjod kyi yod/ des na nub phyogs lung pa'i nang rang nyid kyi pha mes kyi ye shu dang / 'a'u/kha che'i chos bcas gang zhig byed mkhan yin yang de ltar byas na yag pa yod ces brjod kyi yod/

186) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo spyod/dper na/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i nang cha bzhag na/ brgya cha dgu bcu go dgu lhag tsam nang pa yin/ 'on kyang kha che'i chos byed mkhan nyung shas yod la/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'go stod tsam nas ye shu'i chos byed mkhan yang nyung shas yod/dpe de bzhin du nub phyogs pa'i yul gru khag nang gi brgya cha dgu bcu go dgus rang gi pha mes kyi chos byed kyi yod pa dang / yang nyung shas nas spyir shar phyogs pa'i chos dang /de'i nang tshan nas sangs rgyas kyi chos la do snang byed mkhan yong gi yod/ de ring 'dir cha bzhag na nub phyogs nas de snga sangs rgyas kyi chos la 'brel ba gang yang med pa de 'dra don gnyer chen po byas te slebs yod/rgya mi la cha bzhag na phal mordzo che pha mes nas nang pa'i 〈snas byed mkhan yin/ de bzhin wi ti nam dang / ko ri ya/ nyi hong pa sogs ni pha mes nas nang chos byed mkhan yin/ des na nga rang tsho tshang ma'i skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen dang bla mar gyur pa ni thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i ston pa bka' drin can de nyid yin zhing / khong nyid mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i rjes su rang nyid mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa dang / sku bzhi'i bdag nyid mngon du mdzad nas chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings las g.yo ba med bzhin du sprul pa'i rol gar sna tshogs ji srid nam mkha' ma zad kyi bar du rgyun ma chad par byon nas/ cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad mkhan zhig yong ba'i gtso bo ni/ chos rnams kyi yin lugs sam

༷ ska lagong sa 7skyabs mgon chen so mchog (87)gnas lus/sa mthar thug pa de ma rtogs pa rtogs pa dang / rtogs pa de nyid bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar du goms 'dris mdzad nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin la/ sangs rgyas nas kyang gdams ngag mthar thug zab mo stong pa nyid kyi tshul las brtsams pa'am/ mdo don stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i lam bstan pa de yin/ 'on kyang thog mar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas de 'phral zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don mi gsung bar/zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud tsista bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang besgo bar mi nus pas/ / mi smra nags kyi nang du gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar de 'phral zab mo stong pa nyid kyi tshul las brtsams pa'i chesnas tshul de rnams gsungs med/ dpal mabosgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / chos 'di gdul bya blo zhan pa rnams kyis rtogs thub pa dka' bas na/ de snga thub pa bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas nas re zhig ma gsungs par bzhugs pa red ces gsungs pa lta bu dang / chos gsungs pa'i skabs su yang / thog mar bden pa bzhi las brtsams te chos gsungs pa yin/ de ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /'di ni kun 'byung 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /'di ni 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /'di ni lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /zhes bden bzhi'i ngo bo la bzlas pa zhes pa de la phyogs gcig

188) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo sprod/nas bsam blo btang na/ gzhi'i gnas tshul gsungs pa yin/ de nas gzhi yi gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og nas nga rang tsho rang bzhin gyis sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa yin pas gzhi yi gnas tshul de ltar yin stabs/ nga rang tsho lam la slob pa'am lam gyi bgrod tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ sdug bsngal shes par bya/ kun 'byung spang bar bya/ 'gog pa mngon du bya/ lam bsgom par bya/zhes gsungs pa ni bden bzhi'i bya ba la bzlas pa zhes pa de yin/ bden bzhi la spang blang 'jug ldog ji ltar byed dgos min de gsungs pa yin/de lta bu'i bden pa bzhi la spang blang 'jug ldog gi rtsol ba'i thog nas nyams len byas na 'bras bu gang zhig yong ngam zhe na/ sdug bsngal shes par bya ste shes par byar med/ kun 'byung spang bar bya ste spang bar byar med/ 'gog pa mngon du bya ste mngon du byar med/ lam bsgom par bya ste bsgom par byar med/ ces pa'i bya ba 'bras bu dang bcas pa la bzlas pa zhes pa'i bya ba de'i thob bya'am bya ba de'i dgos don grub 'bras mthar thug gang 'dra zhig yong ngam zhe na/sdug bsngal zad par spangs te sdug bsngal shes par byed pa med pa dang / kun 'byung mtha' dag spangs nas slar yang spang bar bya ba med pa/ 'gog pa mthar thug mngon du mdzad zin pa'i rjes su slar yang spangs pa'i yon tan gsar pa zhig mngon du bya rgyu med pa/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas zin skabs sngar ma thob pa'i yon tan gsar du thob pa'i lam mo slob rgyu

ru ba 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (39)med pa zhig chags kyi red ces gsungs pa yin/des na bden pa bzhi'i tshul las brtsams te gzhi dang / lam dang /'bras bu'i rnam gzhag de gsungs pa yin/ de lta bu'i bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa de nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi rmang gzhi lta bu yin/ de yang gzhi'i gnas tshul zhes brjod skabs/ sdug bsngal zhes pa ni nga rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal yin/ sdug bsngal shes par bya zhes pa ni/ sdug bsngal dud 'gros kyang shes kyi yod/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis sdug bsngal shes dgos zhes gsungs pa ni sdug bsngal la rnam grangs mang po dang / gting ring po yod pa de rnams yag po shes dgos zhes gsungs pa yin/ de ji ltar yin zhe na/nga rang tshos don du gnyer ba'i bde skyid kyi gras su zag bcas kyi bde ba mang po zhig yong gi yod/ de ltar phugs mi btsan pa'i bde skyid mang sto zhig yong gi yod/ phugs mi btsan pa'am yang dag par na bde ba min pa mang po zhig 〈snang gi yod/ de rnams dud 'gro lta bus shes mi thub/'on kyang mi blo spyang po rnam dpyod can zhig gis 'phral gyi sdug bsngal yong ba zhig yod kyang / phugs la khe phan chen po yod na/ 'phral gyi sdug bsngal de dang du len pa lta bu dang / yang 'phral du bde skyid yod kyang phugs su gyong rag gi yod na/ phugs gal 'gangs che bar brtsis nas 'phral gyi bde ba phran tshegs blos btang ba yong gi yod/ des na bcom ldan 'das kyis sdug bsngal la rim

(19) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo sprod/ pa mang po zhig yod cing / spyir btang mi zhig gis chags snang gis 'bad rtsol byed pa'i bsgrub bya'i bde skyid mang po zhig 'phral du bde skyid lta bur snang yang phugs su gnod pa'i rang bzhin can dang / mi brtan par 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can zhig yong gi yod pas de yang sdug bsngal te 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yin zhes gsungs pa yin/'o na de lta bu'i sdug bsngal yong ba'i gzhi gang yin zhe na/ ji srid las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du yod pa de srid du sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa red ces pa'i 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal de gzhi'i gnas tshul de 'dra zhig yin/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal shes par bya zhes gsungs pa des nga rang tsho sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa tshang mar yod bzhin pa yin/ de la blo bcos dgos don dang blo sbyong dgos don med/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa yin/'on kyang sdug bsngal gyi rigs gang dang gang yod pa de rnams yag so zhig shes dbo(sa rgyu gnad 'gag chen po chags sku(da pas na sdug bsngal shes par bya zhes gsungs pa yin/ skabs 'dir sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal sdug bsngal du shes nas sdug bsngal las thar 'dod kyi blo dud 'gro la'ang yod par ma zad/ 'phral du sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal las thar ba dud 'gros kyang byed thub kyi yod/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ mi'i rnam dpyod chen po yod pa'i dbang gis 'phral gyi bde ba blos btang nas phugs kyi bde skyid la bsam blo gtong ba yong gi yod/ dpag

ces nga༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 191)tshod kyis 'phral du bde ba ltar yod kyang / phugs su sdug bsngal yong ba 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal rags pa ni chos mi shes kyang mi rnam dadredad can gyis cung zad bsam blo 'khor thub pa yin/mdor na 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal du mthong nas de la yid bsun te sdug bsngal med pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms don du gnyer ba ni mu stegs pa'i nang du'ang 〈snad pa yin/ bsam gtan bzhi pa yan chad kyi snyoms 'jug gi yon tan thob pa rnams ni tshor ba btang snyoms kyi thog nas zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal las re zhig thar ba yong gi yod pa ni thar 'dod kyi blo yong ba dang / de'i thog nas thar thabs la bslab thub pa yong gi 〈snad/ thar thabs de la bslabs nas re zhig 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba yong gi yod/nang pa sangs rgyas pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes gsungs pa ni gtso bo yin/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes mdor na las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can gyi skye ba zhig yin chad la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin la/ gang ltar las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can gyi phyi snod kyi bkod pa de yang phal cher 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal chags yod/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin de shes dgos pa gnad 'gag chen po yin/ de byung na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes pa de nyid las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can te/ snod bcud kyi sdug bden sesgogs yin pas na/ 'di

(11) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo sprod/ji srid nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du yod pa de srid du sdug bsngal de'i khur de yong gi yod stabs/ sdug bsngal de'i rtsab ni nyon mongs yin pa shes thub pa zhig dang / nyon mongs yin pa ngo 'phrod pa zhig yong gi yod/ sdug bsngal de shes na sdug bsngal de las thar 'dod kyi blo zhig skye ba dang / sdug bsngal de las thar 'dod kyi bsam pas sdug bsngal de'i rtsab gang yin rtsad gcod byed 'dod yong ba yin/ grod pa ltogs pa'i sdug bsngal lta bu nang nas sgom rgyag dgos don med par sto chas bzas na grod pa ltogs pa'i sdug bsngal sel thub pa yin/ nad na tsha'i sdug bsngal zhig byung na de la sgom rgyag dgos don med/ sman bzas nas na tsha drag skyed yong ba yin/'on kyang nyer len gyi phung po'am las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can gyi phung po 'di sdug bsngal ba'i rang bzhin yin pa mthong thub pa zhig byung na/ 'di med par bzo bar rang shi brgyab kyang phan thogs dang snying po gang yang med/ slar yang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsar pa zhig len dgos pa las gzhan thar thabs med/ rang shi brgyab pas bdag med pa chags thabs med/ shes pa'i rgyun la btags pa'i bdag cig yin pas/ shes pa'i rgyun de 'gag rgyu med/ phyi nang gi dngos po gang zhig yin yang / rang nyid gnas pa la gegs byed mkhan zhig yod na/ de 'gag pa zhig yong gi yod/ 'on kyang shes pa rig tsam gsal tsam de gnas pa la gegs byed mkhan gang yang med/ de la phyi'i sa rdo ri brag gis

ci rko/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (53)mi gnod par gnas thub pa yin/ dper na/ phyi'i gzugs can gyi 27sa la rdzas rgyun lta bu brtsis na de med par bzo thabs med/ de ni nam du yang gnas bzhin pa yin/des na rang shi brgyab pas phan thogs med pas nyer len gyi phung po 'di gang zhig byas te blangs pa dang / ji ltar byas te blangs pa yin/ de ni rgyu med las byung ba min la/ mi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung ba'ang min par/ de ni mthun pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin/ de ltar rtsad gcod byed skabs de ni 'dod pa dang zhen chags kyi dbang gis yong gi yod/ de'i rtsab ni gti mug gi dbang gis yong gi yod pa dang / bdag tu 'odzin pa'i ladron pas yong gi yod pa de'i steng du 'gro gi yod/ des na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar len pa'i phung po'i khur 'di zad thabs shig dang / de blang mi dgos pa'i bsam blo zhig gtong dgos byung na/ de la bsam blo gting ring pozhig ma btang na yong thabs med/ nyon mongs pa zhes pa de gang 'dra zhig yin pa dang / nyon mongs ngo shes pa tsam gyis mi chog pa yin/de yang chags sdang gi nyon resnangs zhes pa ni phal resna che'i nyams tshungang gi thog nas shes thub kyi 〈snad/ 'on kyang chags sdang zhes pa de med pa bzo thub thabs yod dam med de'i thog la bsam blo gtong dgos pa yin/ chags sdang rags pa shugs chung du 'gro ba nga tshor mthong rgyu yod/ de yang tshe stod la mi rlung langs po zhig tshe smad la rgyud dul po de 'dra yong gi yod la/ tshe stod la mi rgyud 'jam po zhig tshe smad la rgyud rtsub po de m+wa yong gi yod/

(13) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo spyod/de bzhin chags pa la cha bzhag na/ nam rgyun grwa pa grwa rkyang 'dod chung lhusgog shes byas nas sdod mkhan zhig mthun rkyen gang 'tshams shig byung na 'dod rngam je cher 'gro ba de m+wa yong gi yod/ de yang tshe stod la 'dod chung chog shes byas nas sdod mkhan de tshe smad la rgyas spros kho na byas te sdod mkhan yang yong gi yod/ des na chags sdang gi blo la 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod pa nga tshos mthong gi yod/ 'on kyang gnad 'gag ni chags snang med par bzo thub min de yin/ des na sdug bsngal shes par bya zhes sdug bsngal zhes pa zhig 〈snad pa 'di shes par byas nas de'i rtsab kun 'byung sgrub byed kyi rgyu de rtsad bcad nas/ sgrub byed kyi rgyu de la gnod pa yod med dang / sgrub byed kyi rgyu de spong thabs yod med la bsam blo gtong dgos pa yin/ des na kun 'byung gi bden pa zhes bden pa gnyis pa de gsungs pa yin/de ltar sdug bsngal shes par bya/ kun 'byung spang bar bya zhe sa sdug bsngal de shes nas mi 'dod pa'i blo skye skabs sdug bsngal de las thar 'dod kyi blo yong bas sdug bsngal gyi rtsaba'i rgyu de shes par byas nas/ rgyu de la gnyen po yod na gnyen po de skyes pa'i sgo nas rgyu de spong dgos pa yin/ des na kun 'byung spang bar bya zhes gsungs pa yin/ de ltar kun 'byung spong thub pa'i bsam blo gdur skabs/ 'gog pa mngon du bya 'dod kyi blo slebs yong ba yin/ kun 'byung nyon mongs de rang dang 'gal zlar gyur pa'i chos shig yod pa ste/ kun

wa ri44 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (18)'byung gi rtsab nyon mongs dang / nyon mongs zhes pa ni gtso bo sems sam nang gi rnam par shes pa'i steng nas yong gi yod/ dper na/ phyi la tsha ba yod sar grang ba mi 〈snang ba yin/ tsha grang gi rgyun 'grerdzogs mi thub pa'i 'gal zla zhig yin stabs/ tsha ba'i reg pa shugs che ru phyin na/ grang reg nyung du 'gro ba dang / grang ba'i reg pa shugs che ru phyin na/ tsha ba'i reg pa nyung du 'gro ba ni dngos po'i chos nyid yin/ des na phyi ru 'gal zla btsal nas 'gal zla zhig dang mi 'dod pa zhig yod na/ dper na/ gnod pa'i dug lta bu zhig yin na/ gnod pa 'drin mkhan gyi dug des gang du gnod pa 'dren gyi yod kyang / de'i gnod pa der tag tag 'gal zla byed thub mkhan zhig byung na khosgos de bzlog thub pa zhig mardzong gi yod/ gzugs can la nus pa'am byed las kyi sgo nas 'gal zla de ltar brtsidabesgos pa yin/nang gi shes pa la byed las kyi sgo nas brtsergyu yod la/shes pa'i 'gal zla rtsis gtso bo ni/ yul rig pa'i blo gcig pa yin na yang / blo'i 'odzin stangs mi 'dra bar gcig gis 'di red ces 'dzin pa dang / cig cerdzos des de'i ldog phyogs tag tag de 'dzin pa zhig byung na/ de gnyis 'dzin stangs 'gal ba yin/dper na/ yul mi dang dngos po zhig la dmigs nas/ de ha cang yag po 'dug bsam ste de la srid pa'i chags pa de yul de ga la dmigs nas de'i skyodan mthong nas de yag po mi 'dug bsam pa'i glo des gnod kyi yod/ dper na mdun

(96) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo spyod/du yod pa'i dngos po zhig la chags pa'i blo der g.yas la yod pa'i dngos po zhig la sdang ba'i blo ldas gnod kyi med/ de gnyis dmigs pa tha dad yin/ des na dmigs pa gcig la dmigs nas gcig gis yid du 'ong ba red bsam nas thag bcad nas 'dzin pa'i blo de la dmigs pa de ga rang la dmigs nas de yag sto mi 'dug bsam pa dran pa'i glo des gnod yong gi yod/ de bzhin mi gcig la dmigs nas zhe snang skye ba de la mi de gar dmigs nas byams pa'i blo skyes na zhe snang de nyid chung du 'gro gi yod/ de gnyis 'odzin stangs 'gal ba yin stabs gcig skyes skabs cig sgo(sa de 'gags 'grerdzo ba yin/yang yul de la dmigs pa'i zhe sdang shugs che ru phyin na/ yul de la dmigs pa'i brtseb shugs chung du 'gro ba yin/ dper na/ bza' tshang gnyis de ring ha cang 'cham po yod kyang / gang 'tshams nas rkyen zhig gis dbang las 'khrug pa sgo(ra ba'i skabs sngar chags pa skye sa'i yul de ga rang la dmigs nas snang ba'i blo skye ba yin/ de gnyis phan tshun 'dzin stangs 'grel ba yin/mdor na sems nang gi nyon mongs zhes pa'i sdug bsngal 'dren pa'i zlo de'i rang bzhin ni/ glo des ji ltar ledron pa ltar don la gnas pa zhig yin na tshad ma yin la/ glo des ji ltar 'dzin pa ltar don la gnas med par tshad ma zhig gis gnod yong ba zhig yin na/ glo de phyin ci log gi blo yin/ de ltar bsam blo gtong skabs nyon mongs zhes pa de'i rtsab thug sa dbu ma pa'i lugs

tshonya 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (97)nas nyon mongs kyi rtsab gti mug bden 'dzin la thug gi yod/ de yang /rgyu dang rkyen las skye dngos rnams/ /yang dag par ni rtog pa gang / /de ni ston pas ma rig gsungs/ /de las yan lag bcu gnyis 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos rnams rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i 'jin pa de bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ma rig pa red ces gsungs pa dang / de la brten nas chags snang gis mtshon nyon mongs gzhan rnams skyes shing / des las bsags nas kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'khor 'esgo 'khor ba de gsung gi skusgod/des na rtsab ni rang bzhin rnams rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa yin nam min de'i steng la thug gi yod/ de ltar chos rnams rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa yin na/ chos rnams rang bzhin gyis yod par 'dzin pa'i glo de phyin ci log gi blo yin zhing / chos rnams rang bzhin gyis grub yod na/ de ltar du dzadzin pa'i blo de blo don mthun yin/ glo de nyid don mthun yin min ni glo des ji ltar bzung ba ltar don la gnas yod med brtag dpyad byas te bsam blo gtong dgos pa chags kyi 〈snad/de ltar bsam blo btang na phyin ci log gi blo lda sel thub pa yin/de la 'gal zla yod la/ 'gal zla der rgyab rten yod stabs 'gal zla stobs ldan zhig skusgod pas na sel thub pa zhig yin/ de ltar bsam blo gtong skabs 'bosgog pa mngon du bya zhes pa de gsungs pa yin/

198) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo spyod/des na 'gog pa thob thub pa'i gdeng gtel zhing / nges pa rnyed yong skabs de thob pa'i thabs la nyin mtshan sbrel nas brtson pa zhig yong ba yin/der brten lam bsgom par bya zhes gsungs pa yin/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bden pa bzhi'i tshul las brtsams te chos 'khor dang po bskor gnang mdzad pa yin/ de nas zhe sa ma zhus na bcom ldan 'das kyi drung nas chos zhu mkhan gyi gdul bya'i nang rim pas rnam dpyod dang nyams myong je zab tu 'gro ba zhig yong zhing / de ltar yong skabs da gzod gzhi nas sdug bsngal shes par bya ste shes par byar med/ ces gsungs pa de don gzhan zhig gi thog nas 'grel bshad brgyab yong skabs/ sdug bsngal shes par bya dgos kyang shes par bya rgyu'i sdug bsngal de phar 'tshol skabs rnyed rgyu med pa zhig dang / de bzhin sdug bsngal nyams su myong mkhan gyi nga'am bdag ces pa de yang phar 'tshol skabs rnyed rgyu med pa zhig yin pas/ sdug bsngal bral zhes pa'i sdug bsngal de dang sdug bsngal de nyid nyams su myong mkhan de yang rnyed rgyu med pa zhig yin stabs/ sdug bsngal spangs pa'i bral ba de yang phar 'tshol skabs rnyed rgyu med pa zhig yin/ des na/sdug bsngal shes par bya ste shes par byar med/ kun 'byung spang bar bya ste spang bar byar med ces pa lta bu'i thog nas go ba len stangs shig yod pa yin/ de lta bu'i sgo nas chos rnams kyi yin lugs stong pa nyid ces pa de'i thog la blo cung zad slebs pa yin/

(2 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 199)de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nam rgyun yongs su grags pa'i chos sangor rim pa gnyis pa ni/ gnas bya rgod phung po'i rir mi dang mi min gyi gdul bya du mar sher phyin gyi chos lubor gsungs shing / nga tshos rtag tu 'don bzhin pa'i shes rab snying pos mtshon sher phyin gyi mdo sde mang po zhig skabs de dus gsungs pa yin/ de ni gong du bden pa bzhi zhes gsungs pa'i nang gi 'gog pa'i bden pa zhes pa de dpyis phyin pa zhig shes pa ni gzhung de la brten nas yong dgos pa yin/ de bzhin lam gyi bden pa 'phags pa'i ye shes de kho na nyid nges pa'i blo phyin ci ma log pa zhig skyes pa ni sher phyin gyi mdo sde'i skabs nas yul stong pa nyid kyi gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin gsung gi yod pas na/ de yul du byed pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sgo thams cad nas phun sum tshogs pa zhig yong thub pa de ltar yin/de nas gabor lo tha ma'i skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pa 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo'i nang du nang gses kyi 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin lon ma thub par sgra ji bzhin par bzhed na skur 'debs su 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa dang / mdor na blor mi sho nga zhing phan ma thogs pa yong ba'i rigs la dgongs nas mdo sde dgongs 'grel lta bu rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub ma grub cha phye nas gsungs pa ste/ shes bya la dum bu gsum du phye nas kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa dang / gzhan dbang dang yongs grub

(101) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo sprod/rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa zhes de lta bu'i rnam dbye mi 'dra ba zhig gsungs yod/ de lta bu'i mdo sde'i skor yang yod pa yin/ rgyud/bla ma'i shes byed kyi rtsaba'i mdo dang /de bzhin chos dbyings bstod pa la sogs pa shes bya rtsaba'i mdo sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pa'i skabs nas sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de rtsal tu bton nas gsung gi yod/ 'di ni lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes pa'i lam gyi bden pa thar thug pa zhig skusgong thub pa dang / de'i rgyun bosgoms nas dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i sems 'od gsal ba de lam gyi ngo bor 'gyur ba zhig yod pa 'di'i thog nas go ba slebs dbosgos pa yin/ des na bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas pa'i chos tshul 'di ltar gsungs pa yin/lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi thog nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung de pasnyi'i gsung dang / paphri'i skad la'ang mi 'dra ba kha shas yod 'dug rnam kun yongs grags paldi'i skad du yod pa'i sang sa rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos 'khor sde tshan gcig dang / de nas legs sbyar skad du yod pa'i chos gsor gyi sde tshan gcig bcas gnyis yod/ dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhas pa rnams kyis legs sbyar gyi skad du yod pa'i chos gsor dang / de bzhin pa'i'i skad du yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos 'khor gnyis shar thos bsam slob gnyer gyis mdor na bshad sgrub gnyis kyi thog nas skudron skyong spel gsum gnang yod/ nga rang tsho bod du yod

ci sdo ༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (101)pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'dir nub phyogs pa nang pa'i lhusgos la nyams zhib byed mkhan rigs gcig gis 〈snad kyi :sgos la bla ma'i cerdzos zhes ming btags yod/ bla ma'i chos zhes pa ni phal cher rgya skad kyi nang du bla mar sangs rgyas rlon pa zhes pa'i ming zhig yong gi yod/ dbyin skad du'ang sangs rgyas gson pa zhes pa 'di dang 'khrug 'gro gi med dam snyam/ yang dus rabs gsum bzhi'i gong du bod la slebs pa'i phyi mi rnams kyis bod pa tshos bla mar dad pa ha cang chen po byed kyi yod pa mthong ba de 'dra'i thog nas bla ma rtsab ha cang chen po zhig red 'dug bsam nas bla ma'i lhusgos zhes ming btags pa min nam/ de ltar tha snyad mi 'dra ba zhig skusgod pa rgyu mtshan du byas te rigs 'ga' zhig gis bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di sangs rgyas kyi chos ngo ma min par/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la lhad zhugs pa zhig red brjod mkhan yong gi yod/spyir theg chen sangs rgyas kyi bka' min zhes mgon po klu sgrub ma byon gong nas byung yod/ der brten mgon po klu sgrub kyi gsung nang theg chen bka' sgrub gsungs yod la/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi mdo sde rgyan gyi nang theg chen bka' sgrub gsungs yod/ rtog ge 'bar ba'i nang du'ang theg chen bka' sgrub gsungs yod/ de bzhin rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i spyodad 'jug gi nang theg chen bka' sgrub gsungs 'dug ngas mthong ba de tsho'i gras yin/ da dung ngas ma mthong ba mang po yod shas che/ des na spyir theg chen sangs rgyas kyi bka' min zhes

༷༷ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (101)me'isangasargyas pa'i tshasnas 'dir nub phyogs pa nang pa'i lhusgos la nyams zhib byed mkhan rigs gcig gis bod kyi lhusgos la bla ma'i lhusgos zhes ming btags yod/ bla ma'i chos zhes pa ni phal cher rgya skad kyi nang du bla mar sangs rgyas rlon pa zhes pa'i ming zhig yong gi yod/ dbyin skad du'ang sangs rgyas gson pa zhes pa 'di dang 'khrug 'gro gi med dam snyam/ yang dus rabs gsum bzhi'i besgong du sod la slebs pa'i phyi mi rnams kyis bod pa tshos bla mar dad pa ha cang chen po byed kyi yod pa mthong ba de 'dra'i thog nas bla ma rtsab ha cang chen po zhig red 'dug bsam nas bla ma'i chedas zhes ming btags pa min nam/ de ltar tha snyad mi 'dra ba zhig 'byud pa rgyu mtshan du byas te rigs 'ga' zhig gis bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di sangs rgyas kyi chesgos ngo ma min par/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la snyad zhugs pa zhig red brjod mkhan yong gi yod/spyir theg chen sangs rgyas kyi bka' min zhes mgon po klu sgrub ma byon gong nas byung yod/ der brten mgon po klu sgrub kyi gsung nang theg chen bka' sgrub gsungs yod la/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi mdo sde rgyan gyi nang theg chen bka' sgrub gsungs yod/ rtog ge 'bar ba'i nang du'ang theg chen bka' sgrub gsungs yod/ de bzhin rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i sbyordzod 'jug gi nang theg chen bka' sgrub gsungs 'dug ngas mthong ba de tsho'i gras yin/ da dung ngas ma mthong ba mang po yod shas che/ des na spyir theg chen sangs rgyas kyi bka' min zhes

(102) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo sprod/brjod mkhan byung yod/yang de bzhin nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos med ces brjod pa de yang deng sang gi skad cha gsar pa min par sngar nas byung yod/ de lta bu'i thog nas bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa de m+wa yong gi yod/ 'on kyang de dag la nga rang tshos zhib 'jug yag po zhig byas na/ bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i cesas shes la ma shes mkhan gyis gtam gang byung ma byung bshad kyi yod pa de dag ni rigs rtsi sa bsdad med/ de min tshad 'dzin sa yod pa'i bod kyi sangs rgyas pa'i chos ngo ma de gang yin zhe na/ dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhas pa mang pos brtsams pa'i gzhung de dag sod kyi nang chos kyi rtsab 'dzin sa yin/ dper na/ nga rang la cha bzhag na/ dmigs bsal slob sbyong byas pa gang yang min pas spyir btang ri so dge lugs pa'i gdan sa khag gi nang slob sbyong byed srol ltar ngas slob spyong byas shing / de yang rang lo bdun brgyad tsam nas mngon rtogs rgyan dang / dbu ma 'jug pa blo 'dzin byas pa yin/ 'on kyang deng skabs brjed de blo thog nas 'gro gi mi 'dug de nas tshad ma rnam 'grel dang / mdzod rtsab/ 'dul ba mdo rtsab/ dus phyis spyod 'jug dang / dbu ma rtsab shes rab sesgogs gang 'tshams bltas pa yin/ de dag tshang ma dpal nā len+t+ra nas brgyud pa sha stag yin/mdor na/ tshad ma rigs gter lta bu bod kyi mkhas pas mdzad pa

dzo ri 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen so mchog (102)tshudademinagazhung po ti lnga'am bcu gsum dang / gzhung chen po ti bco brgyad bcas tshang ma rgya gar gyi dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhas pas mdzad pa sha stag yin/ deng skabs dbu ma rtsab shes rab rgya yig dang / bod yig legs sbyar bcas kyi nang yod/ 'on kyang phal cher dbu ma rtsab shes rab kyi nang don dbu/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / / zhes pa nas/ gau tam de la phyag 'tshal 'ordzo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi tshig don gnyis ka dbyis phyin pa zhig 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu bod yig gi thog nas slob sbyongang byas pa zhig yin na ma gtogs phal cher legs sbyar skad kyi thog nas rtsab 'don shes mkhan zhig gis 'grel bshad rgyag thub rgyu khag po yin/ dbu ma rtsab shes rab legs sbyar skad dang / bod skad bcas thog ngag skyor byed mkhan gcig pa yin na'ang / de'i nang don cha tshang 'grel bshad rgyag thub mkhan phal cher therdzod kyi mkhas pas ma gartastogs gzhan khag pordzo yin/de sngon nga the wan du 'gro dus rgya yi mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa bgres song ha cang yag po zhig 'dug nga gnyis thengs gnyis gsum zhig thug pa yin/rjes su khong ched mngags rda sar phebs pa de'i skabs nga gnyis lhod thug gis bka' mol byung bar khong dbu ma rtsab shes rab thugs rgyus 'dug khong rang de snga rgya nag ri bo rtselngar bzhugs kyi yod ces gsung gi 'dug nga gnyis nas smon lam brgyab ste ma 'ongs par nga gnyis mnyam du rgya nag ri bo rtselngar gnas skor zhig la 'gro thub pa dang / de skabs khyed kyis rgya skad thog nas rtsab shes

(104) bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang /nang chos ngo sprod/rab bton/ ngas bod skad thog nas rtsab shes rab bton/ da dung rgya gar ba dbu ma rtsab shes rab 'don mkhan zhig byung na/ des legs sbyar skad kyi thog nas rtsab shes rab bton te smon lam brgyab na yag po yong gi red ces bka' mol byung /ngas rtsab shes rab kyi don dag de tsam shes kyi med/ 'on kyang gte po'i nang gi gzugs bzang zer ba ltar/ rgya skad dang / legs sbyar skad kyi thog nas rtsab shes rab 'don mkhan gnyis las a pho nga rang phal cher drag pa yong srid/des na nga tsho bod gangs can ljongs kyi nang pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos ngo ma dpal nā len+t+ra'i 〈snas rgyud kyi rgyun 'dzin par ma zad/ mkhas pa de dag gis mdzad pa'i gzhung don gyi yig 'bru re re bzhin slob sbyordzong byed pa dang / don gal che'i rigs la ngo bo dang / dbye ba/ rnam grangs/ sa mtshams zhes dpe cha'i nang mang sto zhig gsungs sku(da/ de rnams gtan la phab skabs dgag bzhag spong gsum zhes gzhan lugs dgag pa dang / rang lugs bzhag pa/ de la rtsodi pa spong ba zhes ha cang zhib tshags po gsungs 〈snad/ des na nga tsho'i bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis sku las ha cang chen po bskyon pa dang / bsam blo ha cang gting zab po btang yod pa de la brten nas nga tsho bod pa'i shes tshad skyo po min/ nga rang de'i nang 'tshar longs byas pa zhig yin/ nga rang da cha lo bdun cu'i nang slebs kyang da dung yag po zhig shes kyi med/ 'on kyang mi shes mkhan gyi khrod du slebs dus

7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (105 /ngarangaskyosarangaredami'adugabasam pa yong gi 'dug des na nga rang tsho bod gangs can ljongs kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi shes tshad ha cang yag po yod/ de ltar yod bzhin du nyams len mi byed pa ni ha cang phangs po yin/ zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan gyi gnas tshul ni tha dad dang / de min don ngo ma'i thog bsam blo btang nas nyams len byed mkhan rnams ni 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba zhig tan tan yod/ lhag par gzhung don cung zad shes pa'i thog nas bsam blo gtong mkhan zhig yin na/rnam grangs sgo du ma ste dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ lubor ba'i sdug bsngal/ byang chub kyi sems/ de bzhin thar pa serdzogs bsam blo gtong rgyu mang po zhig yod la/ji tsam bsam blo gtong rgyu'i rnam grangs mang po 〈snad pa de tsam gyis bsam blo btang ste grub don la yid ches rnyed de sems la 'gyur ba thebs pa shugs chen po yong gi yod/ de ltar dngos nas bslab pa slob gnyer byas te chos nyams len byed mkhan rnams ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig tan tan 〈snang gi ye da/mdor na bod gangs can pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhas pa'i bzhed rgyun dri ma med pa 'dzin mkhan zhig yin/ be(nga gsal rnams ni phyogs gcig nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ngo spyod dang / phyogs gnyis nas bstan pa byung rim dang / bod gangs can ljongs kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi ngo sprod bcas yin// //

(106) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag sped kyi sgod tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang / bdag med kyi skor/da༅༅/ /de yang dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces ji skad gsungs pa ltar rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa dang / spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par byed pa la/ de'i gzhi rtsang rang tshor khams bde gshegs snying po zhes rang gi ngang gis yod pa yin/ mdor na dri ma phra rags gang zhig yin yang de rnams glo bur bral rung gi tshul du yod pa dang / stobs tshogs kyi yon tan sgrub pa'i nus pa nga rang tshor lhan skyes su yod pa gzhi rtsa'adi'i thog nas sems steng gi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi rtsab sems kyi gnas lugs 367 /ste (sku yig 1de /ngos byer 1sdom :khro nga tsha steg )sdomam nga mas kya na nyad ma na du bru/ra pa sga nas rnam ma na ba dgos pa zhig dang / sems kyi de kho na nyid ces pa ni thun mong dang thun mong ma

nga5 7gong sa 7 bas mgon chen po mchog (107sheyin pa'i sems kyi dekhonanyidacesabarjodachog wa wade lta bu'i gnas lugs mthong ba'i sgo nas sems steng gi dri ma zad cing dag dgos pa dang / de yong ba la thog mar blo sbyong ba'i rim pa rnams la rim bzhin blo sbyong dgos/ rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi blo yong ba la/ snying rje chen po dgos shing / snying rje chen po yong ba la gang sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can la gces shing phangs pa'i blo zhig dang / sdug bsngal gang gis mnar ba'i sdug bsngal ngo 'phrod pa zhig dgos pa yin/ der brten gang sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can la gces shing phangs pa'i blerdzo sgrub pa la rgya gar gyi dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhas pa'i bzhed rgyun la rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas blo sbyong tshul gcig dang / yang bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas blo sbyong tshul gcig bcas gces shing phangs pa'i blo sgrub stangs 'di ltar yin/sdug bsngal gang gis mnar ba'i sdug bsngal ngo cha 'phrod pa la/ thog mar rang steng du bsam na nges pa skyes sla bas/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa skye dgos pa dang / nyon mongs kyi nyes dmigs mthong ba dgos/ nyon mongs kyi nyes dmigs ni mdor bsdus na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bcas gsum yin/ de ltar nyon mongs kyi nyes dmigs yag po shes pa byed dgos/ nyon mongs kyi 'bras bu ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes sdug pa

(108) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skosazhig las med/ rgyu nyon mongs de nyid kyi rtsab ma rig pas byas pa yin stabs/ming la'ang ma rig pa zhes bkra mi shis pa zhig thogs yod/ de lta bu'i rmongs pa'i dbang gis spyir btang dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bshad na/ sdug bsngal gcig ni rmongs pa'i gzhan dbang can zhes brjod kyi yod/ de la brten nas lus kyi gnas stangs kyang dud de 'gro ba zhes brjod kyi yod/ dper na nga rang tsho mi'i nang du cha bzhag kyang / mi ji tsam gyi blo gros rmongs pa de gti thug can zhig yin na dus nam yang dka' sdug gi nang du tshud kyi yod/mdor na ma rig pa zhes ming de rang nas zhe sun zhing / mi bde ba dang mi dga' ba zhig yong gi yod/ der brten nyon mongs pa'i rgyu 'bras gnyis sto gang la bltas kyang ha cang thabs sdug las med/ rang gzhan tshang ma mi bde bar bzo mkhan nyon mongs pa de yin/ nga rang tsho rang gis rang la mi gces pa gcig kyang med/ 'on kyang rang gis rang la gces bzhin du mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun ma chad par yong ba 'di rtsab ma rig pa'i dbang gis byas pa gsal po yin/des na rang steng la nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul la bsam blo yag po zhig btang na/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra las rgyal ba'i thar pa zhig thob na snyam pa'i nges 'byung gi blo yong ba yin/de ltar 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las thar 'dod kyi blo yag po zhig yong ba la/ thog mar sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul dran pa'i skabs su

dzi na 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (109)tshungazadakyangami bzod pa lta bu'i blo shugs drag po zhig yong zhing / de nas thar pa don gnyer gyi blo yong ba la phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo dgos pa dang / de la yang tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog dgos pa sogs blo la rim pas sbyang dgos pa yin/ sbyor gang zag las las can/ dper na/ rje btsun mi la rang nyid dang / rje btsun mi la'i sgod ldan gyi slob ma tshe rabs mang por dge ba'i bag chags bzang po yod pa de tsho'i gras 'phral gyi rkyen phran bu zhig byung na/ des blo la 'gyur ba thebs pa de 'dra yong gi yod/ dper na/ bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su yul mtha' 'khob sgra sgrog gi rgyal po u ṭa ya nar srid pa 'khor lo'i ri mo bris pa zhig gi cesag tu/brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar sga /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par sga /'dam bu'i khyim na glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par sga /zhes 'khod pa mthong ma thag de'i thog nas srid pa 'khor ba la lugs 'byung gi sgo nas lubor bar gnor ba dang / lugs ldog gi sgo nas lubor ba las thar ba'i thar pa sgrub tshul bsam blo dngor te de ma nyid du nges 'byung gi blo skye ba dang / bden pa mthong nas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rags pa'i don mthong ba dang / rags pa'i don de la brten nas phra ba'i don mthong dus/ srid pa'i rtsab ma rig pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba bcas de ltar yin/ de ltar las kyi 'phro sad

(110) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skosacing bag chags bzang po yod pa rnams kyi gnas tshul ni tha dad yin/ de min spyir btang nga rang tsho blo la rim cagyis spyong dgos rgyu gal chen po yin/ rtogs pa mthon po'i mtho snyegs byas te sa chod thub pa yong rgyu khag po yin/ rim pa bzhin du lam bgrod thabs byas na de'i tshod kyis sa chod yong thub/mdo don snying po rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs yongs rdzogs tshur bsdus na bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yin zhing / de la brten nas rang don chos sku dam pa dang / gzhan don gzugs sku dam pa sgrub par gsungs yod/ de ltar yong ba'i gzhi rtsani/ gzhi bden pa gnyis yod pa'i cha nas yin/ dngos po'i gnas tshod la snang tshul dang gnas tshul gnyis yong gi yod/ tshig gzhan zhig gi thog nas bshad na/ snang tsam pa'i rten 'brel bslu ba med pa zhig dang / de'i sdod lugs sam yin lugs spros pa'i mtha' gang du yang ma grub pa'i yin lugs gcig bcas snang tshul gyi rang bzhin gcig dang / mthar thug sdod lugs kyi yin tshul gcig bcas kyi bden pa gnyis po de shes pa'i thog nas/ mdor na snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa de'i thog nas dal 'gyor don chen rnyed dka' dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sogs bsams nas thog mar tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog pa dang /de nas phyi ma'i snang shas ldog pa/ de rjes thar pa don gnyer gyi blo sgrub pa/de nas snying rje sgrub pa sogs 'di ltar bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi

r+sha༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (111)sems zhes pa'i glo de bsgrubs nas skyes pa dang / thabs kyi cha sbyin serdzogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslabs/ de nas chos rnams kyi yin lugs rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid shes pa byas/ rten 'byung gi de kho nyid ces brjod dgos don ni/chos rnams spros pa'i mtha' dag dang bral ba ste skusgod med kyi mtha' gang du yang ma grub pa'am/ mdor na rten 'byung 'gag sesgogs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de gtan med pa'i thog nas mtha' bral du mi 'grog par/ de nyid brten nas btags pa zhig yin stabs spro(sa pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin/ des na rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid ces pa'i tshig der go rgyu zhig yod/ phyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang na/ rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid ces brjod na/ don la 'grig gi yod/ de las rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid ces brjod na/ tshig der nus pa che ba yod/ de ltar yang dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las/skyes bu sa min chu ma yin/ /me+e min rlung min nam mkha' min/ / rnam shes ma yin kun min na/ /de las gzhan na skyes bu gang / /zhes nga'am gang zag gam skyes bu zhes pa de btags don btsal nas bsam blo zhig btang na/ rtsab nas mdzub mo 'dzugs sa med pa zhig chags kyi yod/ de 'dra ste ma rnyed pa tsam gyis yang dag pa ma grub pa red ces mi gsungs

(112) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skosapar/ de'i rjes su/de las gzhan na skyes bu gang / /zhes rtag mtha' sel ba de gsungs pa dang / skyes bu khams drug 'dus pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa'i tshig de bkod gnang mdzad yod/ des na skyes bu med pa min par phan gnod 'dren pa'i skyes bu yod pa yin/ 'o na skyes bu yod pa de gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas yod ce na/ phung po las don gzhan du med pa dang / phung po'i nang nas kyang sa la sesgogs pa khams de dag gi nang nas gang zag yin rgyu gtan nas med/ de lta na yang med pa min/ 'o na yod lugs ci 'dra yin zhe na/skyes bu khams drug 'dus pa'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skyes bu'am gang zag ces pa de khams drug 'dus pa la brten nas 〈snad pa yin/ brten nas zhes pa'i tshig 'di nga tshos ston pa lta bu yin/ 'on kyang de ltar yin pa dpal ldan zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma 'jug pa las/de ni de nyid du'am langeg rten du/ /rnam pa bdun gyis 'grub 'gyur min mod kyi/ /rnam dpyad med par 'jeg rten nyid las 'dir/ /rang gi yan lag brten nas 'dogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar brten nas zhes pa'i tshig de dpal ldan zla ba grags pas bkod pa gnang yod/ der brten dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa de yang / skyes bu khams drug 'dus pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa'i skyes bu

dzo da 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen sa mchog (112)khams drug 'dus pa la brten nas btags tsam zhig red ces gsungs pa yin/de ltar btags don btsal nas rnyed rgyu yod pa ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med la/yang med pa'ang min zhing /skyes bu khams drug 'dus pa'i phyir/ /yang dag ma yin ji lta bar/ /zhes pa'i sdom bskyon gnang mdzad 'dug de bzhin khams ni re re yang //'dus phyir yang dag nyid du min/ /zhes gsungs yod/ de bzhin gang zag gang du btags pa'i gzhi phung sogs kyi chos rnams kyang de ltar brtags shing dpyad na rnyed rgyu med la/ med pa'ang min par bya ba byed thub mkhan rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin can zhig yin pas/ de nyid yod tshul ni gang zag de khams drug 'dus pa la brten nas btags pa bzhin khams drug re re nas kyang rang rang gi cha shas dang gdags gzhi byas pa la brten nas btags tsam yin zhes gsungs yod/mdor na chos thams cad ming gi dbang gis 'byud tsam dang / btags nas 〈snad pa zhig las med pa yin/ de ni gsal po 〈snad pa ste/ nga'am gang zag ces pa de spyir mdo'i nang du/ gang cir yan lag tshogs rnams la/ /brten nas shing rtar brjod pa ltar/ /de phyir phung po rnams brten nas/ /

(113) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skosakun rjesnab sems can brjesnad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na/ shing rta zhes pa ni shing rta'i gsor lo dang / gzer bu dang / sgrom sogs la brten nas shing rta zhes pa'i tha snyad byed kyi yod/ tha snyad byas pa ltar shing rtas do po 'or 'dren sogs kyi bya ba mang po zhig byed thub kyi yod/ de ltar bya ba byed mkhan gyi shing rta zhig yod cing / de bzhin shing rta'i rgyu dang / shing rta'i bya ba/ shing rta'i 'bras bu yang yong gi yod/ de ltar shing rta skusgod kyang shing rta zhes pa de phar 'tshol bar 'gro skabs rang gi cha shas can gyi shing rta de rang gi cha shas las lerdzogs su med la/ don gzhan du yang med/ rang gi cha shas re re ni shing rta min zhing / rang gi cha shas 'dus pa la brten nas shing rta zherme bzhag pa dang / rang gi cha shas yan lag de rnams 'dus pa'i dbyibs tsam yang shing rta min la/ kha dog de yang shing rta min/ shing rta'i dbyibs gang la ldan rgyu'i shing rta dang / shing rta'i kha dog gang la ldan rgyu'i shing rta/ shing rta'i cha shas gang la ldan rgyu'i cha can shing rta zhes 'jog rgyu krerdzod/de ltar 'jog rgyu yod pa tsam min par phan gnod dngos su 'dren mkhan zhig 〈snad/ 'on kyang btsal na shing rta 'di red ces nam rgyun mdzub mo 'dzugs sa de'i gseb nas cha shas phye nas bsam blo btang na/ shing rta rnyed rgyu med pa'i dpe de bzhin du gang zag gam skyes bu zhes pa de yang skusgod pa ste nga bde ba 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa zhes nga tshos brjod kyi yod la/ brjod pa

cidzos 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (115gde don la gnas yod pa dang / tshad mas grub cing myong ba tshad mas nges kyi yod/'on kyang brtag cing dpyad nas sdug bsngal myong mkhan dang bde ba 'dod mkhan ngo ma de gang zhig yin zhes brjod na/ phal mo ches shes pa'i steng nas bsam blo gtong gi yod/ de yang shes pa'i thog nas nga de yod dgos so snyam ste bsam blo gtong gi 〈snad stabs/ skabs re sems tsam pa'i gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar rnam shes tshogs brgyad gsungs pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhes pa de gang zag yin zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin yid kyi rnam shes gang zag gi mtshan gzhir 'grog pa sengags/ mdor na gang zag gis mtshon pa'i chos gang zhig yin yang don gyi ngos nas yod pa zhig 'dod phyin chad la gang zag ces pa de yang don gyi ngos nas rnyed dgos pas na/ mi bde ba yod kyang mtshan gzhi'i yid kyi rnam shes zhes pa zhig ma bzhag thabs med yin/ de 'dra des cesas thams cad ming tsam brda tsam zhes gsung gi yod kyang bsam blo yag sto zhig btang na/ ming tsam brda tsam zhes brjod pa ltar min par yul gyi ngos nas chos de dang de yin rgyu zhig lhag yong gi yod/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa dbyis phyin pa ni/ don gyi ngos nas grub pa cung zad tsam yang med ces gsung gi yod/ de ltar btags don btsal na nga zhes pa de phung po'i gseb nas nga yin rgyu zhig gtan nas rnyed rgyu med/der brten shes pa la bsam blo btang na/ shes pa la dbang shes dang yid shes kyi

(116) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang/bdag med kyi skosasde tshan mi 'dra ba yod la/ gzhan dang sems dang sems 'byung gi sde tshan mang po zhig kyang phye gi yod/ sde tshan de dag yod pa nga tsho'i myong bas sgrub thub kyi yod/de dag cha phye nas gang zag gam nga zhes pa de ngo ma gang zhig yin bsam blo btang na yid shes kyi thog nas ma gtogs 'grog sa med pa yin/ yid shes la'ang sngags dang 'brel nas bshad dus phra rags mang po zhig yod/mdor na gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs nas gsungs pa ltar snang mched thob gsum tshun tshad kyi shes pa'am rags pa slo bur ba'i shes pa rnams ni glo bur ba yin zhing / gtan du gnas kyi med pa yin/ de dag gi gseb nas gang zag 'jog dgos byung na/ de dag 'gags zin pa'i rjes su gang zag de yang 'gags zhes 'dod dgos shing / der brten de dag 'char nub byed sa'i shes pa phra mo zhig yong gi yod/ shes pa de la brten nas btags pa'i gang zag cig kyang yod dgos pa yin/ des na gang zag de shes pa phra rags kyi 'char nub yong gi yod ces brjod dgos pa zhig dang / brjod thub pa zhig yin stabs de dag gi gseb nas gang zag lasdog thub thabs med pa gsal po yin/da ni gnyug ma'i 'od gsal snang mched thob gsum gyi shes pa mtha' dag 'gags zin nas lhan cig skyes pa'i 'od gsal de la bsam blo btang na/de nga la lasag dgos byung na'ang bde po zhig med/ gang zag de da lta 'od gsal 'char ba'i skabs dang 'od gsal 'gag pa'i skabs zhes brjod rgyu yod pas/

ne༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (117)'od gsal nyams su myong mkhan de zur du yod dgos pa zhig chags yod/ der brten shes pa'i nang gi phra 〈snas de thog ma med pa nas yod cing / thog ma dang mtha' med pa ni snang mched thob gsum 'gags zin pa'i rjes su 〈snang ba'i shes pa phra mo de yin la/ de gang zag la bzhag na bde po zhig 〈snang gi med/ da ni shes pa'i nang du gang zag rnyed du rgyu med pa ha cang gsal po yin/ lus kyi cha shas nas gang zag 'grog rgyu med pa ni de bas smos ci dgos/ der brten gang zag ces pa de btsal na gtan nas rnyed rgyu med pa zhig chags 〈snang ba des don gyi ngos nas grub pa gtan nas med pa thag chesgod pa yin/ des na gang zag med ces brjod kyang btsal nas ma rnyed pa rgyu mtshan du byed pa dang / yul gyi ngos nas ma grub pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas med ces brjod na mngon sum la bsnyon dbosgos pa yin/ bde sdug smyu1nga mkhan dang / brtag dpyad byed mkhan de thams cad/ dbu ma rtsab shes rab las/gal te phung po bdag yin na/ /skye dang langeg pa can du 'gyur/ /gal te phung po rnams las gzhan/ /phung po'i mtshan nyid med par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid yod pa ma yin na/ / bdag gi yod pa ga la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag nyid med na sdug bsngal myong ba po dang /

(118) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skosasdug bsngal las grol mkhan gyi nga zhes pa de nyid btsal nas rnyed rgyu med pas na/de'i dbang gis tha snyad byas pa'i sastor ba zhes pa de yang bzhag rgyu med la/ myang 'das zhes pa de yang bzhag rgyu med/ mdor na gang yang 'jog rgyu med pa yin/de ltar na mngon sum la bsnyon dgos pa yin/ der brten yod ni yod pa yin/don gyi ngos nas med pa der bsam blo btang na shes thub pa zhig yod pas/yod tshul ni ming gi dbang gis yod pa ni 'os med kyi 'grub pa gsal po yin/des na tha snyad la brten nas btags pa yin zhes gsungs pa de yin/ de ltar yar sangs rgyas 'phags par brtsis kyang / dbu ma rtsab shes rab las/phung min phung sto las gzhan min/ /de la phung med der de med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phung ldan min/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang zhig yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa de yang zag med kyi phung po la brten nas btags pa zhig ma gtogs de bzhin gshegs pa med/ dgor ba pa'i sems can yang med la/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang med pa yin/ myang 'das kyang med pas khyad mtshar zhig 'dug der brten shes rab snying po'i nang du gsungs pa ltar/ mdor na gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med ces gsungs pa de yin/ de ltar gsungs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug ce na/ de ni shes bya'i rnam grangs shig gtan la

0 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (119)phab pa tsam yin dang / yang de nges par shes dbe'us sam zhe na/ dbu ma bzhi basbyo| pa las/srid pa'i sa bon rnam shes te/ /yul rnams de yi spyodad yul lo/ /yul la bdag med mthong na ni/ /srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa de yin/ srid pa'i sa bon rnam shes te zhes pa ni/ srid pa 'khor ba la ming lubor ba zhes btags min ji ltar yang / nga rang tsho'i mi tshe 'dis mtshon rtog dra mang po zhig yod/ de la rgyu yod med bsam blo btang na/ nga rang tsho 'dod pa bde ba dang mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal yin yang / nam du yang gra ma 'grig pa yong ba de'i rtsab rgyu zhig yod dgos pa las/ rgyu med rkyen med glo bur stes dbang gis byung bar bshad thub rgyu khag po yin/ ma gzhi shing 'ga' zhig skye bzang ba dang / shing 'ga' zhig skye zhan pa/ rlung rgyag skabs shing 'ga' zhig chag pa dang / 'ga' zhig ma chag par sdod kyi yod/ shing chag pa de bsod nams med pa dang / shing ma chag pa de bsod nams yod pa lta bu ni stes dbang gis yong ba lta bu yin/ phyi'i dngos po la de ltar stes dbang gis yong chog gi yod na/ nang gi shes pa la'ang de ltar yong chog dang mi chog ces brjod na/ bsam blo yag sto zhig btang tshe/ sgrom lta bu sne gcig gi thog nas bsam blo btang na/ skabs re mi bde ba yong srid/ 'on kyang phyogs tshang ma'i gnas tshul la sdom lta bu brgyab

(120) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skosanas bsam blo btang na/ rang rang gi mthun pa dang mi mthun pa'i rkyen gyi dbang gis 'gyur ba 'grerdzo ba zhig yin zhes brjod rgyu las de min bshad thabs med/de ni thog mar 'dzam gling chags pa'i skabs nas byas te bsam blo zhig btang na/ 'dzam gling de la brten pa'i bcud kyi sems can zhes pa zhig yod pa dang / de'i las kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba 'gro tshul go rim ltar gyi bsam blo zhig btang na/ de la sgrig 'dzugs sam 'gro stangs shig yod pa blo la 'char yong zhing / mdor na sems dul ba dang ma dul ba'i dbang gis 'gyur ba sna tshogs shig yong gi yod pa dang / sems ma dul ba'i rtsab nyon mongs pas byed kyi yod pa ni gong du zhus pa ltar las rtog tshang ma bzo mkhan ma rig pa de yin zhing / des na/ srid pa'i sa bon rnam shes te/ /yul rnams de yi spyodad yul 'ordzo/ /zhes gsungs 〈snad/ de yang srid pa'i sa bon rnam shes zhes gsungs pa de skabs 'dir ma rig pa la gsung gi 〈snad/ ma rig pa des dmigs pa gcig la dmigs nas phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo'i dmigs pa de ni/ yul rnams de yi spyodad yul 'esgo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/de lta bu'i phyin ci log gi blo yul gcig la dmigs nas de la phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo zhig yin pas na/ de lta bu'i phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo de med par ji ltar byas te bzo dgos sam zhe na/ des yul de la dmigs nas ji ltar zhen pa ltar du med pa mthong na/ phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo lda zhi 'gro
