27༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (121)ba yin/ dper na/ nga rang la cha bzhag na chung chung skabs dgun kha rtsepho brang la sdod kyi yod/ pho brang nang gi chesad khang 'ga' zhig ha cang nag khung yod pa dang / de dag nang gdong 'dre yod pa'i shod srol yod/ der brten khang pa de tsho'i g.yas g.yon du slebs dus sems nang cung cad zhe snang yong ba dang / ltag khung rgyab nas tsha 'ur 'ur lta bu byed nyu yode/ yang sa cha 'di'i galpos g.yono lpo gang 'di med zhu mar spar ba dang / rang gi mig gis bltas te de ni rnam rtog yin pa las gang yang med pa mthong du sa 'dir gang yang med par thag chod pa'i blo des gong gi zhed snang med par 'gro ba yin/ zhed snang yong sa de nyid du 'dir zhed snang yong sa'i gzhi rtsagatan nas med pa shes rtogs ma byung bar gdon 'dre yod shag byed pa'i khang pa nag khung 'dir zhed snang byed dgos don med/ phyi la nyi ma ha cang skyid po yod ces brjod pas zhed snang sel mi thub/ der brten dag ma dag dang /bdag gzhan gyi chesgos la dmigs nas phyin ci 'ordzog tu 'dzin pa'i blo de sel ba la/ phyin ci 'esgog tu 'dzin pa'i blo ldas gang la dmigs sa'i phyi nang gi chos rnams la blo ldas ji ltar zhen pa ltar du grub med pa thag cerdzod pa zhig shes na/ de dag la dmigs nas phyin ci 'ephag tu 'dzin pa'i blo sel thub pa yin/ des na/srid pa'i sa bon rnam shes te/ /yul rnams de yi spyodad yul 'esgo/ /yul la bdag med mthong na ni/ /srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa de yin/de bzhin dbu ma rtsab shes rab las/

(122) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skodalas dang nyon mongs zad pa'i mthar/ /las dang nyon mongs rnam rtog las/ /de dag spros las spros pa ni/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin dpal ldan zla ba grags pas kyang /nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus 'jig tshogs las/ /lta las byung ba blo yis mthong gyur zhing / /bdag ni 'di yi yul du rtogs byas nas/ /rnal 'byor pa yi bdag ni 'gog par byed/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu gzhung mang po'i nang du yod/ spyir sdug bsngal gyi rtsab ma rig pas byed kyi 'byud pa grub mtha' bosgong 'og phal mo ches gsungs yod/ 'on kyang ma rig pa ngos 'dzin tshul la phra rags mang po zhig yong gi yod/ de kho na nyid kyi don lasag lugs la phra rags yod pas na/de'i dbang gis ma rig pa la'ang phra rags yong gi yod/ snying don ni nga rang tshor sdug po gtong mkhan gyi nyon mongs med par bzo ba la stong nyid rtogs dgos pa yin/ gang lags she na/ nyon mongs kyi nang du shes rab nyon mongs can zhes pa zhig yod/ de la lta bar gyur pa'i nyon mongs zhes brjod chog dper na/ khong khro dang nga rgyal sogs ni lta min gyi nyon mongs yin zhing / de dag yul la phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa mtshungs pa yin/ 'on kyang yul de la nges pa ltar snang 'dren shugs de tsam chen potho med pa zhig min nam snyam/ shes rab lhosgon rertongs can zhes pa ni/ phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo 'dra 'dra yin na yang glo des gang zhen

47 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (123)pa'i don de la nges pa ltar snang 'dren shugs chen po yod pa zhig yin/ des na de la shes rab nyon mongs can zhes brjod cing / bdag 'dzin dang / gti mug la sogs pa de rnams kyang shes rab nyon mongs can yin/spyir gti mug 'jog tshul la ma rtogs pa tsam dang / gnas lugs la rmongs pa tsam gti mug la 'jog pa dang / da lta skabs 'di'i gti mug ni phyin ci log tu dzadzin pa'i blo yin zhing / phyin ci log tu nges pa ltar snang drangs nas kho rang dpag tshod kyis sems nang nges shes skusgod pa lta bu zhig chags yod/ des na nyon mongs de rigs spang dka' ba yod/ zhe snang lta bu lta min gyi nyon mongs de la byams pa bsgom na des thad kur zhe sdang gi ngar gcog pa dang / de bzhin chags pa lta bu lta min gyi nyon resnangs de la mi sdug pa balhasnam na 'dod chags shugs chung du 'gro gi yod/ nga rgyal skye ba'i skabs su rang nyid kyi skyon cha la bsam blo btang na/ sems kyi skyon cha mthong ba'i glo des yon tan mthong ba dang / yang na rnam rtog gi blos mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi sgro btags pa'i gzhi gcig gi thog nas nga yin snyam pa'i blo lda shugs chung du 'gro ba yong gi 〈snad/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo lda la byams pa bsgom pas gnod thub rgyu khag po yin la/ mi sdug pa bsgormem pas kyang de la gnod thub rgyu khag po yin/ mi sdug pa de nyid kyang don gyi ngos nas grub pa zhig blor shar ba dang / byams pa sgom skabs byams pa de yang yul gyi ngos nas grub pa zhig dang / blos zhen pa zhig

(124) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang/bdag med kyi skyodachags yong gi yod/ de ni ha cang gnag po zhig yod pa yin/ der brten shes rab nyon mongs can zhes pa'i nyon mongs de rigs spong ba la shes rab gcig gis de la gnyen po byed dgos pa zhig dang / de la gnod pa bsnyen dgos pa zhig phal cher yin/des na spyir btang gnyen po la bsun 'byin pa'i gnyen po zhes brjod skabs/ yul gcig la dmigs nas chags pa skyes pa'i blo lda la yul de yid du mi 'ong bar mi sdug pa'i rnam pa lta bu zhig la bsam blo gtong skabs des yid du 'ong ba'i rnam par mthong nas yul de la zhen cing chags pa'i glo de shugs chung du 'gro ba de la bsun 'byin pa'i gnyen po zhes brjod kyi yod/ de lta bu'i mi sdug pa balha ma pa gcig pus chags pa de zad thub bam zhe na zad mi thub/ dbu ma pa'i lugs nas gsungs pa ltar rgyu mtshan la bsam blo yag po zhig gtong ba dang /gnad 'gag rtsad gcod yag po byas na/ nyon mongs thams cad gnyi mug la brten nas yod pa dang / gti mug ni brten pa dang / gti mug la brten nas byung bar gsungs pas gti mug ni ma rig pas byed kyi 〈snad pa yin/ des na gti mug gi gnyen por chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab bam chos rnams kyi rang bzhin mthong ba'i blo des gti mug gi gnyen po byas te gti mug bzlog thub pa yin/ de la spong ba'i gnyen po zhes gsungs yod/mdor na stong nyid ces pa de gal 'gangs chen po yin/ phyin ci log gi

sna 23 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (125skespyomangapozhigayod pa'i nang nas rtsab byed mkhan gyi yul lam don gyi ngos nas grub par 'dzin pa'i blo gcig gis rnyog dra de rnams bzos pa yin/ de la gnyen po bsten ma thub na smon lam brgyab kyang phan thogs med la/ spyir btang gi sgom brgyab nas kyang phan mi thub/ de bzhin mi sdug pa sgom pa dang / dad pa dang snying rje sgom pas kyang phan mi thub/ de ni glo des ji ltar bzung ba ltar med par mthong ba'i glo de nges par du skyes dgos pa yi na/yul la bdag med mthong na ni/ /srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ des na stong pa nyid ces pa gal chen po chags 〈snad/ byang chub kyi sems zhes pa de rigs kyis nga rang tsho'i sems la chags snang gi blo dang / sems zhum pa/ sems ma skyid pa mardzong ba bcas kyi skabs su byang chub kyi sems la bsam blo btang na/ de ma thag sems la bzo lta bzos te 'gyur ba zhig yong rgyu yod/ stong nyid la go ba chags pa dang / stong nyid la goms 'dres gang 'tshams byung yang lam sang de 'dra'i 'gyur ba zhig yong gi e yod snyam/ nga rang tsho las dang po ba'i gnas skabs su mngon gsal med pa'i thog nas 'dzin pa a 'thas rim pas shugs je chung du 'gro ba yong gi yod/mdor na blo yi skyon te rang nyid phung la sbyor ba'i nyon mongs can gyi sems 'di med par bzo ba la nyon mongs ngo shes nas nyon mongs dang du mi len par nyon mongs la gnyen po bsten dgos pa yin/ nyon mongs la gnyen po

(126) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skosabasten lugs la'ang / thabs kyi sgo nas nyon mongs la gnyen po bsten lugs gcig dang / shes rab kyi sgo nas nyon mongs la gnyen po bsten lugs gcig yod/ der yang mthar gtugs na shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po byas te mthar nyon mongs spong dgos pa yin/ de lta bu'i stong nyid sgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa yin/ ye shes kyi tshogs de la brten nas sems steng gi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas sbyangs pa'i bral ba'i 〈snan tan mthar thug de yong thub pa yin/ de ltar sems steng gi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyongang skabs shes bya shes pa la bar du gcod pa'i sgrib byed bral ba'i 'bras bur chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig gis cig car du mngon sum du mkhyen thub pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan yong ba yin/ gzhan dang mi 'dra bar mkhyen pa skad cig gcig gis ji lta ji snyed kyi don thams cad cig car du mkhyen pa'i blo 'di ltar du yong gi yod pa yin/zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul gnyis kyi thog nas 'gro dgos lugs 'di ltar yin/ de la zab mo stong pa nyid ces gal 'gangs chen por 'dzin gyi yod/bcom ldan 'das kyi chos 'di chos lugs gzhan gang dang yang mi 'dra ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad yerdzod pa gcig ni bdag med pa'i lta ba zhes pa 'di yin/ bdag med pa'i lta ba la'ang nang gses kyi phra rags mang po zhig yong gi yod/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong pa sgrub nas de lta bu'i rdzas

na 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (127)yod kyis stong pa mthong ba'i bdag med mthong ba'i blo gcig dang / yang skabs re sems tsam pa'i gzhung nas gzung 'odzin gnyis stong gi de kho na nyid ces kyang gsungs yod/ de bzhin dbu ma rang rgyud pas tha snyad du don gyi ngos nas grub pa zhig khas blangs pa'i thog nas de lta na yang kho rang yin lugs su grub pa zhig med pas bden par ma grub pa'i lta ba gcig kyang yong gi yod/ mthar thug ni chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med ces pa dang / ming tsam dang brda tsam 'ba' zhig las med pa'i chos tshul de shes dgosgos pa yin/der brten thog mar nga rang tshos rnam dpyod kyi thog nas chos rnams rang bzhin gyis grub pa med ces pa de la bsam blo zhig thongs dang / brten nas btags pa yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas bsam blo yag po zhig btang na/de las 'gro sa mi 'dug bsam pa'i blo zhig slebs skudang zhing / de slebs pa'i skabs su nga rang tshor nga zhes pa blo la 'char ba dang / yang na tshor ba bde sdug blo la 'char ba/ phyi rol gzugs sogs kyi chos blo la 'char ba de 'dra yong / de dag gang la bltas kyang bsam blo'i thog nas brtag dpyad yag po zhig byas na/ ming tsam las 'gro sa mi 'dug bsam pa zhig dang / nga rang tshor snang tshul dang / myong ba'i skabs kyi snang tshul gnyis gtan nas mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa ha cang gsal po yin/de ltar bsam blo gtong skabs/ brten nas btags pa las gzhan gyi

(128) tshogs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang /bdag med kyi skosa'agro sa mi 'dug bsam pa'i go ba cung zad chags pa'i thog nas nga rang tsho'i myong ba la gcig bltas na/ nga rang tshor 'char ba'i skabs su phyi nang gi dngos po gang zhig yin yang don gyi ngos nas yod pa zhig 'char yong gi yod/ dgag bya'i snang tshul de yin zhing / de la gang 'tshams kyi bsam blo g.yor ba dang / da dung yang bsam blo rim pas btang na/ chos gang zhig yin yang snang dus nyid nas stong pa zhig yin stabs/ don steng nas yod pa zhig snang tsam de gas de ltar du grub pa zhig med bsam pa dang / nga med bsam pa zhig blo la phal cher yong gi yod/ de ltar rim bzhin goms nas 'gro dgos/ goms na khyad par chen po yod pa yin/go ba chags pa dang rtogs pa skyes pa gnyis la nor nyen med kyang / 'ga' zhig la go ba chags pa'i skabs su ngas gang 'tshams shes sesgong bsam pa dran yerdzong ba de ni nor ba yin/ go ba chags te kha nas 3ted rgyu yod kyang / sems la tshor ba slebs pa la bosgoms dbosgos pa yin/ rim bzhin besnams nas brjod pa'i tshig dang sngar ma goms pa'i skabs rang bzhin med ces brjod pa'i tshig gnyis gcig pa yin yang / sems nang tshor ba la khyad par chen po yod/ de ltar na zab mo stong pa nyid de thog mar thos par byas/ de nas yang yang bsam blo btang / goms 'dres byas te de lta bu'i thog nas tshor ba yod pa zhig byung na/ de nas rim pas nus pa thon pa zhig yong ba yin/ de dang byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'brel nas phyin na/nyams rtogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yong ba yin/ de lta bu'i chos tshul nyams
