(136) tshad ma bzhi dang /skyabs mus rnam gzhag tshad ma bzhi dang /skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag ༄༅/ /de yang ji skad du/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i tshad ma kun btus kyi mchod brjod las/tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal te/ /zhes ji skad gsungs pa ltar spyir btang nga rang tsho mi phan tshun gcig gis gcig la brten nas 'tsho dgos kyi yod/ de lta'i gnas stangs 'og nas mi zhig la brten nas skad cha dris pa dang / slob ston nyan pa'i skabs su slob ston yang dag pa byed mkhan dang / lam ma nor bar 'khrid mkhan blo gtad 'pher ba zhig yod na/ mi de ni cha 'jog 'pher zhing tshad mar ldon pa zhig yod ces nga tshos shod kyi yod/ ldom gling 'di'i thog mi la blang dor gyi gnas ston mkhan gyi ston pa mang po zhig yong gi yod/ de'i nang chos tshul gyi lta grub rnam gzhag ston mkhan gyi ston pa yang mang po zhig byung yod/ de dag gi nang nas ston pa mnyam ()she (de//bye/:re/ zur rdo|/ shāje/shāXrdo/ste/ /khye/ ༷god shākya spyar 'dzam nga 'a nga lta grub rnam gzhag dang 'a la ba'i thog nas sems rgyud 'dul thabs ston mkhan gyi ston pa zhig yin/ ston pa

(2 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (131)rmenyamamedashākya seṅge ston pa 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa de'i sku'i rnam 'gyur dang / gsung gi gdangs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad du 'phags pa zhig yod ces brjod pa de tsam gyis mi 'grigs shing / gtso bo ni/bstan pa'i ngang tshul shes nas ston pa la/ /yid ches rnyed pas rtag tu gang bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltar ston pa gang gis bstan pa'i chos tshul de dag la bsam blo btang / nyams zhib byas/ rang gi nyams myong dang 'brel ba'i skabs su gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos yod pa shes thub pa yin/ de lta bu'i ston pa mnyam med shākya seṅge de nyid kyis thar 'dod kyi skyes bu rnams kyi 'phral gyi sdug bsngal sel thabs dang / bde ba sgrub thabs ston pa tsam min par phugs rgyang ring po'i bde ba sgrub thabs dang sdug bsngal sel thabs ston pa'i ston pa tshad mar gyur pa zhig yin pas na/ tshad mar gyur pa zhes gsungs pa dang / de ltar tshad mar gyur tshul ji ltar yin ston pa'i gsung la brtag dpyad byas na shes thub pa yin/ston pa tshad mar gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo gcig ni/ thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa de yin/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan par bzhed pa zhes thugs rje chen so'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa gsungs yod/ de ltar yin pa yang bcom ldan 'das rgya gar du byon nas mdzad pa mdzad tshul gyi thog nas shes thub pa yin/ sku tshe 'di tsam du ma zad sku'i tshe rabs mang po'i ring dang /

(132) tshad ma bzhi dang /skyabs 'tsho rnam gzhagabaskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems nyams bzhes gnang ste/ brtseb thugs rje chen po'i goms pa mthar son pa yin zhes gsungs pa yin/ ston pa zhes pa ni/ khong gis gdul byar blang dor gyi gnas bstan pa de la/ spyir gzhan la gnod 'tshe mi byed par phan 'dogs dgos zhes gsungs pa de ston pa gzhan dang gsung tshul 'dra yang / mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos shig yod pa de gang yin zhe na/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin zhes gsungs pa de yin/mdor na/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang / zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba/ zhes pa'i chos tshul gsung gi yod/ de ltar gsungs pa de yang ston pa rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas gzhan don sgrub pa la gzhan don bsgrub pa'i thabs blang dor gyi gnad spyi dang / lhag par chos rnams kyi yin lugs ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen nas gdul bya la 'doms par mdzad pa de'i thog nas/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can thugs rgyud la yod pa shes thub pa zhig yin/des na ston pa thugs rje can ni rang gi nyams myong gi steng nas gdul bya la blang dor gyi gnas spyi dang / lhag par chos rnams kyi yin lugs ji ma ji bzhin 'doms par mdzad mkhan zhig yin/ mdor na zab pa dang rgya che

naX 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (133)ṅge'ichosatshulastong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi lam nyams bzhes gnang nas spangs rtogs mthar phyin te gdul bya gzhan la rang gi nyams myong gi steng nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don mtha' dag 'grub par byed pa'i thabs tshul phyin ci ma 'ortog par 'doms par mdzad mkhan zhig yin pas na/rang gi rjes su slob mkhan gyi gdul bya rnams bde gshegs skyob ces 'dren par mdzad pa dang / rang gis rnyed pa'i go 'phang la 'god par mdzad mkhan zhig red ces gsungs pa yin/skabs re nga rang tsho'i sems nang lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya'i gong du byung ba'i lo rgyus shig deng sang bshad dus de 'dra e yin snyam pa dran gyi yod/ nga rang yang de 'dra dran myong / 'on kyang lam 'bras gsung ba'i skabs su lung tshad ma dang / bstan bcos tshad ma/ bla ma tshad ma/ nyams cadang tshad ma bcas tshad ma bzhi zhes pa zhig gsungs yod/ de ltar tshad ma bzhi po'i byung rim ltar na/ thog mar ston pa sangs rgyas kyis chos tshul gsungs nas dang po ston pa'i lung tshad ma grub pa dang /de nas ston pa'i lung tshad ma yod pa de dag 'grel byed mkhas pa rnams kyis lung don 'grel ba'i bstan bcos brtsams pas na gnyis pa bstan bcos tshad ma byung / de nas lung dang bstan bcos de dag thos bsam gyi lam la zhugs te nyams bzhes gnang ba la brten nas lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis phyug pa'i bla ma tshad ma byung / de nas bla mas gdul byar lam bstan nas

(133) tshad ma bzhi dang /skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhagagadul bya'i rgyud la nyams myong tshad ma byung ba bcas kyi rim pa 'di ltar yin/lung tshad ma dang / bstan bcos tshad ma/ bla ma tshad ma/ nyams myong tshad ma bcas de dag gang zag gcig gi rgyud la skyes pa'i go rim la mtshon na/ thog mar rang gi rgyud la nyams myong phran bu skyes pa la brten nas/ de ni nga la kha yod lag yod kyi phan thogs 'dug bsam pa dang / de yang bla ma de dang de'i bka' drin la brten nas ngas bsam shes pa dang sgom shes pa byung bas/ de lta bu'i gdams pa ston mkhan gyi bla ma de ni dngos gnas blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i thog nas gdul bya mthar thug gi bde ba la 'dren mkhan gyi bla ma mtshan nyid tshang ba'i skyes bu dam pa zhig red 'dug bsam pa'i yid ches kyis/ bla ma tshad mar nges pa rnyed pa zhig yong bas des bla ma tshad ma dang / de ltar rang gi rtsaba'i bla ma thugs rgyud lung rtogs kyi yon tan gyis phyug pa'i tshad mar gyur pa 'di yong ba yang / bod gangs can ljongs su dar ba'i chos 'di gtso so dpal nā len+t+ra nas brgyud pa'i chos rgyud yin pa ltar dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhas pa rmad du byung ba sa gsum na 'gran zla bral ba'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos ni tshad ma gsum gyis gtan la phab pa zhig yin stabs/ bla ma 'di lta bu zhig byung ba yin bsam pa dang / de la brten nas gzhung gi bstan bcos la'ang dad pa skyes pa dang / bslu ba med cing tshad ma'i skyes bu klu sgrub yab sras la sogs kyi gzhung gi rtsab brten sa ston pa mnyam med shākya

tsho 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (136)seṅges chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas gsungs pa'e rgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma 'di dag yin zhing / de ltar dgongs 'grel la brten nas bcom ldan 'das kyi lung tshad ma yin pa nges pa rnyed pa dang / de ltar ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dngos gnas smra ba zla med pa yin par brten klu sgrub kyis/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyis/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal 'ordzo/ /zhes smra ba zla med pa'i ston pa yin pa gsungs 〈snad/ngos kyi bsam par nyams myong gtso phal gnyis las/ rang gi rgyud la nyams myong phal pa zhig 〈snang ba dper na/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ zhes gsungs pa 'di sems nang dngos gnas red snyam pa zhig yong dus de'i 'bras bur tshe 'di'i lto gos gtam gsum gyis mtshon pa'i 'di snang gi lta stangs la 'gyur ba cung zad yong gi 'dugades rang gi sems nang re dogs kyi rnam rtog mang sto yong ba de dag phran bu nyung du 'gro rgyur phan nas sems nang dngangs skrag nyung ba dang / sems skyid pa yong gi 'dug de bzhin zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba yin zhes gsungs pa des nga rang tshor kha chag sna ral gyi gnas tshul ha cang thabs sdug byung skabs/las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin phyin 'di las yerdzong rgyu med bsams nas phan thogs yong gi 'dug la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang thar pa bsgrub dgos gsungs yod/ gal te las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du yod pa'i skye ba 'di phugs btsan

(136) tshad ma bzhi dang /skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhagapo dang bde skyid yod pa zhig yin na thar pa dgos don med/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba zhes pa'i lta tshul des sems can la phan thogs yong gi 〈snad/lhusgos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ zhes pa des sems nang ngar 'dzin pa'i blo cung zad shugs chung du 'gro ba dang / chags pa dang snang ba/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog de bzhin 'gran sems ni ngar 'dzin pa'i blo la brten nas yong gi yod pas/ngar 'dzin pa'i blo de ji tsam/ gyis srab tu phyin pa de'i tshod kyis de la brten pa'i nyon mongs kyi tshogs rnams kyang tan tan shugs chung du 'gro ba yin/lhag par yang mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba/ zhes pa de dang 'brel nas ched du bya ba nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du rnam mkhyen don gnyer la mos pa'i blo bsam blo'i nang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yong rgyur phan gyi yod/ mi tshe 'dir dka' ngal ji tsam byung yang snang dag mi gtong zhing / tshe rabs nas tshe rabs dang / bskal pa nas bskal pa zhes pa'i bsam blo dang / mdor na byang chub kyi sems bcas kyi bsam blo dngor na/ srog 'tsho ba 'di la dgos don snying po byung ba yin/ de min bza' btung stogs la longs skyesgod thub tsam gyis mi tshe bskyal na rang la dgos don che ba gang yang ma byung ba yin/ rang nyid 'tsho ba 'di/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las /sa dang chu dang med dang rlung / /sman pa'i dgon pa'i shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyis/ /

nga lagong sa 7skyabs mgon chen bo mchog (137)rang dgar 'gag med spyad byar 3snag /ces dang / de bzhin spyod 'jug las/ sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang / /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang sgosgog /ces gsungs pa'i de dag la bsam blo gtong thub na rab dang / de min lad mo tsam byas kyang sems nang tshor ba mi 'dra ba zhig slebs te 'ong zhing / de rjes rang gi nyams myong phal pa nas tshod dpag byas na nga rang tsho'i mi thog 'di dang / mi thog bordzong ma'i dus kyi bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar de dag yong srid pa red 'dug snyam pa zhig blo la shar ba dang / de la brten nas thugs kyi nang thabs shes kyi rtogs pa brtan po 'khrungs skabs/ de'i snang cha la dag pa'i snang ba 'dra min 'char ba de rigs tan tan yong srid pa dang / ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus de rnams dngos gnas red bsams nas yid ches dang dad pa slebs kyi skusgod/ de ltar byas te bla ma tshad mar nges pa yin/de nas bstan bcos tshad ma zhes pa ni nga rang tsho'i man ngag thor bu thor bu dag ni gnas tshul tha dad yin/ de min gzhung mang po zhig gung bsgrigs nas ma gtogs skabs re shes khag po 〈snad kyang / gzhung chen motho rnams la bsam blo btang na bsam blo gtong rgyu yod pa dang / mi'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal ji tsam gyis

(138) tshad ma bzhi dang /skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhagazab pa de tsam gyis bsam blo gtong rgyu dang / bro ba myang rgyu yod pa zhig yin/dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub lta bur cha bzhag na/ rnam dpyod ha cang 'gran zla bral zhing mkhyen pa'i yon tan 'gran zla med pa zhig yod/ khong gi phyag rtsal la cha bzhag na/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsidang / sman la sogs pa mang po zhig bzo mkhyen pa dang / gsang sngags kyi rtog pa nas bshad na/ dngos gnas rtogs pa mthon por phebs pa zhig yin/ de 'dra ba'i gang zag rnam dpyod can mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid des/gang gis thugs brtses nyer bzung nas/ /lta ba thams cad spangs pa'i phyir/ /dam pa'i chos ni ston mdzad pa'i/ /gau tam de la phyag 'tshal 'ebyu /zhes bdag cag gi ston pa ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yin pa gsungs pa de la bsam blo zhig thongs dang / ma gzhi mi sesgo sesgo'i khams dang mos pa yin/nga rang la mtshon na skabs re ha las mdog gi gnas tshul brjod pa de rigs yin nam min snyam nas the tshom 〈snang gi 'dug 'on kyang phyogs mang po nas bsam blo gtong skabs gang 'tshams nas ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bu yin pa gting nas nges pa rnyed de smra mi shes pa'i dad pa skye gi 'dugamador na skyabs gnas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / de'i rjes su slob mkhan gyi klu sgrub yab sras dang / sa rā ha la serdzogs pa'i grub chen

tshaXg / 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (139)mkhas grub kyi skyes bu dam pa de rnams dang / de dag gi thugs rgyud la yod pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan nga rang tsho'i skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dang / skyabs su song 'os pa de dag la skyabs bcol ba dang / gtso bo ni rang rgyud la spangs rtogs kyi yon tan skyes pa zhig byung na/ dngos gnas 'jigs pa las grol ba zhig yong rgyu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mthong ste nges pa rnyed pa dang / snying nas don gnyer byed pa zhig byung na/ de ni skyabs 'gro rnal ma yin/sa lam gyi rtog pa rim gyis skyes nas rang gi shes rgyud je mtho je mthor 'gro ba de ni chos dkon mchog gam 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i rtog pa'i 〈snan tan yin zhing / gtso bo chos la shes nas dad pa thob pa zhig dgos rgyu gal chen po yin/ de ltar yong ba yang rang nyid kyis dpe cha mang po bltas/bsam blo mang po btang / dpyad pa zhib mo byas/ gzhung gong 'og gung bsgrigs nas bsam blo btang na sems nang skyabs 'gro'i dad pa brtan po zhig yong thub/de min nga rang tshos nam rgyun kha nas skyabs 'gro'i tshig bton pa dang / sems nang nas skyabs su mchi bsam pa lta bu las gting zab po'i bsam blo btang nas skyabs su sesgong ba zhig med na/ 'gal rkyen zhig 'phrad pa'i skabs su sangs rgyas dang chos la sdudags pa de rnams gang 'dra zhig yin nam bsam pa dran nyen yod/ bsam blo yag po btang nas rang nyid la dogs pa yod pa rnams dogs slong gis rgyu mtshan la rim pas bsam blo btang ste nges pa rnyed pa zhig byung na/

(146) tshad ma bzhi dang /skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhaga'agal rkyen zhig 'phrad kyang de snga rang nyid kyis rgyu mtshan la bsam blo btang ba des sems nang 'gyur ba med pa brtan por gnas rgyu'i khyad par tan tan 〈snad/mdor na sangs rgyas kyi chos spyi dang / lhag par theg po'i chos kyi nang tshasnas nyams len byed mkhan gyi gdul bya la dbang non chos kyi rjes 'brangs dang / dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brangs zhes gnyis gsungs yod/ dbang non 〈snas kyi rjes 'brangs zhes pa ni nges par du the tshom can zhig dbosgos/ the tshom ni gal chen posto yin/ de ltar yin nam min/ gang 'dra zhig yin nam bsam pa'i the tshom gyi blo yod dgos/ the tshom la'ang blo rtseganyis lta bu'i the tshom dang / yang min pa'i phyogs su blo cung zad nye ba'i don mi 'gyur gyi the tshom dang / yang yin pa'i phyogs su cung zad blo thag nye ba'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom sogs the tshom la'ang mang po yod/ blo gzu bor gnas pa'i the tshom zhig dgos pa yin/ blo gzu bor gnas pa'i the tshom zhig 〈snad na des dri ba zhig slebs shing / dri ba slebs pa des don la rtsad gcod byed 'dod yong ba dang / don rtsad gcod byed 'dod byung na/ de la lan zhig yod na lan zhig rnyed rgyu dang / lan med na rdzun rkub rdol rgyu yin/ des na dri ba bya rgyu ha cang chen po yin/ de yang mi la gzhan la skad cha dris rma 'i don min par rang gis rang la dri ba 'don dgos/ yang mi tshad thub de 'dra la skad cha dris/ rang gis bsam blo btang / dpe cha la bltas/ rang gi nyams myong dang 'brel ba bcas byas na/ 'dzam gling 'di'i snang srid gdams ngag tu

sge 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (141)(charazhesagasungs yod/ de ltar 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul la zhib 'jug byed pa dang / bsam blo btang nas phyogs bsdoms byas na bsam blo'i nang don dag shes rgyu zhig skusgod pa yin/ the tshom gal chen po yin/ the tshom med par skyabs su mchi'o zhes brjod na de la nyen kha yod/ the tshom gyis rtsad gcod dang brtag dpyad byas na/de ltar byas pa'i 'bras bur lan zhig rnyed de sems la nges pa rnyed cing / des drangs pa'i dad pa de la chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis so sor rtogs pas dpyad pa byas pa'i grogs dang bcas pas dad pa zhig byung na/ de ni shes rab kyi grogs dang bcas pa'i dad pa yin pas/ dad pa de brtan po zhig yod/der brten bstan pa sgyi mtshan gyi dbang du byas na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi dad pa de 'dra zhig dgos pa yin/ bsam blo gtong bzhin dpyad pa byed pa las lam sang red ces mi brjod pa dang bsam blo btang / dpyad pa byas/ de 'dra'i thog nas nges pa rnyed pa'i dad pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dad pa ngo ma de yin/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro lta bu nyams len byed pa la nyams su len tshul shes dgos/ de la thos bsam slob gnyer bya rgyu gal 'gangs shin tu chen po yin pas de'i tshul la 'bad pa byed dgos pa yin// //

(142) byang chub kyi sems dang /de'i byed las gsum gyi skosabyang chub kyi sems dang / de'i byed las gsum/cid༅༅/ /de yang ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po byams pas/ngan 'gro'i lam ni bzlog bgyid cing / /mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal 'erto/ /zhes byams pa'i smon lam gyi skabs su ji skad gsungs pa ltar rtsab nga rang tsho'i bde ba dang sdug bsngal zhes pa 'di/ rang nyid la cha bzhag na/ bde sdug yong ba'i gzhi rtsarnam par shes pa'i steng nas yong gi yod pa gsal po yin/ cisems kyi lta stangs sam bsam blo'i gtong phyogs kyi thog nas bde sdug la 'gyur ba chen po 'gro ba gsal po yod/ de bzhin gzhan la bde ba dang sdug bsngal yong ba yang / byed pa po zhig gi sems dul min gyi steng nas yong gi yod/ des na sems ya rabs zhi zhing dul ba zhig byung na rang bzhin gyis gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa zhig yong zhing / gzhan la gnod pa byas na rang la 'bras bu ngan pa lubor rgyu yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas te gnod 'tshe sdom pa dang / de

2 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (143)bzhin gzhan yang rang dang mtshungs par bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa yin pas/ rang gi ngos nas ji tsam gzhan phan bsgrub na de tsam gyis yag po yong rgyu red bsams nas gzhan phan 'ba' zhig sgrub 'dod kyi blo zhig skye ba yin/ gzhan la 'tshe ba rang shugs kyi 'gag 'gro ba dang / des gzhan sdug bsngal bar byed pa'i 'bras bu ngan 'gror skye ba'i las la bzlog pa ni/ nyan rang dang / chos dad med mkhan gyi mi zhig gis kyang gzhan la 'tshe ba mi byed par phan btags pa de 'dra yong zhing / de la brten nas ngan 'gro'i lam bzlog pa yong gi yod/'on kyang gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems kyi thog nas gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa de'i 'bras bu ni ha cang chen po zhig yong gi yod pa ni/ ngan 'gro ngan song gi gnas la skye ba'i las sngar bsags rnams lhag med du dag 'gro ba dang /phyis gsar du mi gsog de yang rang nyid smos ci gzhan la'ang shugs rkyen thebs te de dag gis kyang dngos dang brgyud pa'i thog nas ngan 'gror skye ba'i las las bzlog par byed thub/ de ni bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis yin pas na/ngan 'gro'i lam ni bzlog bgyid cing / /zhes gsungs pa yin/ mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /zhes pa ni spyir btang chos dad med mkhan zhig yin yang / bsod

(143) byang chub kyi sems dang /de'i byed las gsum gyi skyod nams bsags pa dang / gzhan la phan btags pa sengags phan bde bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bur mngon mtho'i lus rten thob thub pa yong gi yod/ 'on kyang byang chub kyi sems kyi mthu la brten nas tshogs skad cig skad cig la rdzogs te mngon mtho'i lus rten rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i lus rten gyi mchog bde blag tu bsgrub thub pa dang / mngon mtho'i lus rten rim par brgyud nas rnam mkhyen bde blag tu bsgrub thub pa bcas mngon mtho'i lus rten zhar la sgrub pa yong gi yod/dmigs sa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can la phan bde'i bsgrub pa'i ched du dmigs nas rnam mkhyen don du gnyer yang / rnam mkhyen bsgrub par byed pa'i mthun rkyen lus rten bzang po thob dgos pa la sogs pa'i thams cad zhar la sgrub yong ba yin/ des na/mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa'i/ /zhes rang gzhan sems can thams cad sdug bsngal bar byed mkhan ni nyon mongs yin la/ nyon mongs pa'i rtsab gti mug bden 'dzin yin/ ji tsam sems can la brtseb yod pa tsam gyis sems can sdug la skyedar mkhan gyi nyon mongs nyes dmigs su mthong shugs che ba yong thub/ des na nyon mongs kyi rtsab gti mug bden 'dzin la mi 'dod pa shugs chen po yong zhing / gti mug gi gnyen sto byang chub kyi sems kyis shes sgrib spong ba gtso bor byed cing / shes

— ) lagong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (145gasgobasgongabalabaden 'dzin gyi bag chags spangs te bag chags 'jog byed kyi bden 'dzin zad pa zhig ma byung na mi 'ong / mdor na nyon mongs kyi rtsab gti mug bden 'odzin la ched du gnyer nas gnyen po'i phyogs bzung ba zhig yong ba de la/mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa'i/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal 'erto zhes gsungs pa yin/ mthar thug rga shi nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis skyes pa'i skye ba dang /de lta bu'i nyer len gyi phung po rga ba'i sdug bsngal dang /de'i rigs mthun rgyun chad pa'i 'chi ba tsam du ma zad/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ba zhes pa de yong ba'i ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang / zag med kyi las la brten nas byung ba'i yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus de rgas pa yod med mi shes kyang /lus de 'gyur ba 'gro ba dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ba zhes pa de dag las kyang 'das pa'i bdud bzhi phra rags mtha' dag las rgyal ba'i rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob thub pa gsungs yod/des na sems bzang po'i mthar thug pa bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes pa 'di skyes na tshogs bde blag tu rdzogs pa dang / sdig sgrib myur du sbyang ba/ des rkyen pas 'phral gyi mngon mtho bde blag tu thob pa/ ma zad mthar thug nges legs thar pa cadang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yang thob ste/ rang don mthar phyin pa byed thub/ gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa skyes pa'i

(146) byang chub kyi sems dang /de'i byed las gsum gyi skosanyin nas bzung dngos dang brgyud pa'i thog nas gzhan la phan bde sgrub pa zhig yong zhing / de ni rnam par shes pa'i rgyud la brten nas btags pa'i nga'am gang zag ces pa zhig yod pa de yod go chod pa zhig byung ba yin/de min rang nyid gcig pu thar pa thob pa ni rang don la cha bzhag na spangs rtogs mthar phyin med la/ gzhan don yang nye tshe ba zhig las yong mi thub cing / rang mgo ma thon par gzhan don sgrub thub rgyu khag po yin/ de 'dra'i bsam blo'i thog nas dngos gnas rang gzhan gnyis ka bde ba 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa mtshungs pa dang / rang steng gi sdug bsngal zad rung yin pa ltar nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal yang zad rung yin pa gcig tu mtshungs pa la/ rang gcig pu sdug bsngal zad pa'i don kho na lhur blangs pa dang / mtha' dang mu med pa'i nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can gyi don ji mi snyam par bzhag pa yin na/ dngos gnas thabs skyo sto yin/ des na bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes pa rang rgyud la skyes pa zhig byung na dngos gnas gtan du skyed pa'i skyid 'go tshugs pa dang / mi lus blangs pa'i go chod pa byung ba yin/der brten nga rang tsho tshang ma theg pa chen po'i chos dang mjal ba dang /theg pa chen po'i chos kyi sgo ni byang chub kyi sems zhes pa 'di yin zhing / de lta'i byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa skyes pa dang / skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel

zh-i sde 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (147)thebasabyedalugs shes pa'i skabs su tshang mas bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems zhes pa 'di la 'bad rtsol byas te thog mar sems la bosgo ba yag po chags pa zhig byas/ de rjes sems kyi rnam pa yid la byas te da lta nas bosgoms su bcug ste rim pas goms 'dres chags pa byed dgos pa dang / de'i phyir du tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong byed pa dang / bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa/ rang nyid 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi spyod lam gang gi skabs su yang byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa skyes pa dang / skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i thog nas goms 'dres yang yang bsten na/ rim gyis da lta rang gces 'dzin gyi gong bu lta bu yin pa'i sems 'di la rim pas 'gyur ba thebs nas gzhan gces 'dzin gyi gong bur 'gyur ba zhig yong thub/des na nga rang tsho tshang mar slob dpon nam bla ma kha mar slog mkhan gyi ngos nas kyang / byang chub kyi sems la ci nus kyi goms 'dres bsten dgos la/khyed rang tsho slob ma kha yar slog mkhan tshang ma lo rgan gzhon dang /ser skya pho mo/mi rigs 'dra min/ dbul phyug gzugs po thang dang ma thang bcas kyi khyad par med par thams cad sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa gcig pa yin/ byang chub kyi sems skye rung yin pa gcig pa yin pas/ des na tshang mas bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes pa rmi lam tshun chad la goms 'dris bsten rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ gzhan yang zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug las/

(148) byang chub kyi sems dang /de'i byed las gsum gyi skosalangeg rten bde ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung / /lareg rten sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /de kun rang bde 'dod las byung / /mang du bshad lta ci zhig dgos/ /byis pa rang gi don byed dang / /thub pa gzhan gyi don mdzad pa/ /'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par stos / /zhes gsungs pa ltar nga rang tsho rang gzhan rogs gsum su zhig yin yang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag las/ sdug bsngal 'dod pa gcig kyang med/ 'on kyang 'dzam gling 'di'i kha phyogs nas bsam blo zhig btang na/ dud 'gro phar bzhag smra shes don go ba'i deng dus kyi shes yon cha tshang sbyangs shing /mthun rkyen yongs su tshang ba'i mi rnams de tsam gyi skyid pa zhig med/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag yin yang / sdug bsngal mang po zhig nga tsho mis ched mngags bzos nas byung ba yin/ de ni sdug bsngal byung na bsams nas byas pa min yang / ma shes 'khrul pa'i dbang gis byas te sdug bsngal dang du len pa dang / sdug bsngal ched du gnyer nas sgrub pa lta bu chags kyi yod/ de'i rtsab gang la thug gam zhe na/ dpyad pa rim par byas na rang gces 'dzin la thug pa ha cang gsal po yin/des na nga tshos kha phyir slog na/ 'dzam gling 'di'i rgyal khab phan tshun gyi

tsho wa ) 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog ( 149)rnyog dra/ dper na/ deng skabs yul lung mang pos 'jigs bskul ring lugs pa zhes 'jigs skrag la brtsis te gdong len mang po byed bzhin yod/ 'on kyang spyi yongs spyi tshogs kyi nang gcig gis gcig la chags snang dang / khon 'dzin/phrag dog 'gran sems sogs nyung du 'gro thabs la spyi yongs kyi 'brel ba zab tu gtong ba dang / phan tshun grogs po dang snying nye'i 'du shes bzhag thub pa'i 'gyur ba zhig 'grerdzo ma thub na/ 'jigs skul ring lugs pa mi nyung shas kyis lag len bstar thub kyi yod/ 'dzam gling thog mi ji srid gnas pa de srid du rtog dra bzo mkhan gyi mi rgyun ma chad pa yosgong rgyu yin pas ha cang khag po yin/ mdor na nga rang tshor mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs yong ba ni/ bsam blo yag po zhig btang na rtsab nyon mongs la thug yod/ nyon mongs skye ba'i gzhi rtsagacig ni rang gces 'dzin gyis byed kyi yod pas na/'jig rten rgud pa ji snyed pa/ /de kun bdag bde 'dod las byung / /langeg rten bde ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung / /zhes gsungs ltar 'dzam gling thog byis pa dmar sbyar srog 'tsho ba de yang brtseba'i bsam pa'i 'og nas byung zhing / nad pa sa ya mang po skyabs med mabordzon med du ma lus par lta rtog byed mkhan gyi sman pa dang / sman gamardzog de'i sbyin bdag bcas ni :rdzos bsams nas byas pa yin min ji ltar yang / gzhan

(151) byang chub kyi sems dang /de'i byed las gsum gyi skyodaphan dang brtse ba'i bsam pa'i 'og nas nad kyis mnar ba rgyu mtshan du byas te rang gis 'gul bskyod byed mi thub pa lta bu dang / rang mgo rang gis ma thon par gnas te skyabs med mgon med du lus pa der mi'i spyi tshogs nang de la rogs ram byas te lta mkhan yong ba'i rtsab ni/ phan bde bsgrub 'dod kyi bsam pa'i thog nas byung ba yin/ rgas khogs chags te rang nyid rang rkya mi 'pher zhing / na rgas jib rdib kyis dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i rgan rgon rnams la lta rtog byed mkhan dang / spyi tshogs kyi zhabs 'degs sgrub mkhan rnams ni phan pa'i bsam pa'am brtseba'i bsam pa'i thog nas phan thogs byed kyi yod/nga rang tshor cha mtshon na/ rang nyid dka' ngal chen po zhig 'phrad nas ma skyid pa'i skabs grogs po sogs kyis dka' ngal der sems 'khur dang sha tsha byed mkhan zhig byung na sems la dga' po yong gi yod/ de ni brtsebs rang gzhan kun la phan bde bskrun gyi yod pa ha cang gsal po yin/ des na che sa mthar thug rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa dang / mngon mtho'i lus rten thob pa yang mi dge bcu spangs pa'i dge bcu'i tshul khrims la bslabs nas thob dgos pa yin/ mi dge bcu'i rtsab ni srog gcod dang / ma 'byin len/ 'dod log sogs spangs nas yong dgos pas/ cha/dor na de dag yul sems can la brten nas yong dgos pa yin/ der brten pha rol po'i ngos nas rang la phan bde bsgrub 'dod kyi blo yod min la ma bltos par/ pha rol po de dag rang gi dge ba

der 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (151)bsgrub rgyu'i rkyen du 'gyur bas de ni mchen du brtsi'os pa yin/ dper na/ sman ni nad la phan pas rtsachen du rtsigi yod/ sman de ha cang phan thog yod ces ril bu'i cha shas tsam sa la lhung yang phangs sems byed kyi skusgod/ de ltar gces po byed pa ni sman des rang la brtseba'i bsam pa 〈snad pa rgyu mtshan du byas te gces po byas pa min/ sman la de 'dra'i kun slong med kyang sman gyis rang la phan gyi yod stabs der gces po byed kyi yod/ de bzhin dngul la cha bzhag na/ dngul rang gi lag tu yod kyang des rang la brtseb gang yang byed mi shes shing /dngul rkun ma'i lag tu stasner yang rin thang gcig pa yin pa las/ dngul rang lag tu yod skabs rin thang che ba dang /rkun ma'i lag tu slebs skabs rin thang med par gyur na/ dngul gyis bsam blo cung gtong shes kyi yod pa lta bu yin/ 'on kyang de ltar min par dngul rang lag tu 〈snad dus phan thogs 〈snad pa ltar rkun ma'i lag tu slebs skabs kyang des phan gyi yod pas/ dngul la legs nyes 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod med/ dngul des rang la brtseb yod pa rgyu mtshan gyis der brtsidagos don gang yang med/ 'on kyang dngul des phan thogs yod pas dngul la rtsipo byed kyi yod/der brten rang la phan thogs na de la bdag po spyod 'os pa dang / brtsebar cesas pa zhig yin na/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can de dag la brten nas srog gcod spong ba dang / ma 'byin len dang / log g.yem/ rdzun/

(152) byang chub kyi sems dang /de'i byed las gsum gyi skosaphra ma/ tshig rtsub/ nga rgyal/ brnab sems/ gnod sems spong ba sogs tshang ma yul sems can la brten nas yong dgos la/ 'phral gyi mngon mtho sgrub pa dang / mthar thug thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa la bslab pa gsum nyams len thog nas yong dgos/ de yang gtso so shes rab kyi bslab pa yin zhing / de la ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang / de la tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dgos pa yin/ tshul khrims zhes brjod skabs gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa las bzlog pa zhes gsungs yod/ des na gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las log pa zhes gsungs yod stabs/ gzhan la gnod pa byed sa yod pa las bzlog pa zhig sku(nga bas na/ bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len byas shing / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yang yul sems can la brten nas yong dgos pa dang / rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa la med thabs med pa'i rgyu ni/ dbu ma 'jug pa la sa/nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing / /snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /gang phyir brtsenyid rgyal ba'i lo tog phun tshogs 'di'i/ /sa son dang ni spel la chu m+wa yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod gyur pa/ /de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rtsab snying rje chen por thug

ga snyegong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (152)yod/ snying rje chen po yod na rnam mkhyen sgrub rgyu yod la/ de med na rnam mkhyen sgrub rgyu med/ snying rje chen posna zhes pa ni nyam thag pa'i sems can la dmigs nas snying rje skye gi 〈snad pas skyabs med mgon med rang mgo ma thon zhing / sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang sdug bsngal dang du len pa dang / bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu sgrub mi shes pa'i nyam thag pa'i sems can la dmigs nas snying rje chen posna skye gi yod pas na/ rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rgyu'i rtsab snying rje chen po yong ba la yul sems can dbostos shing / byang chub kyi sems 〈snang ba la'ang yul sems can dgos pa yin/ des na mngon mtho sgrub pa dang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gordzo 'phang sgrub pa de dag yul sems can la brten nas 〈snang dgos pa ma zad/ tshe 'di'i dbang du byas te nga rang tsho'i bde skyid rtsis gtso bo lto gos gtam gsum yin zhing / lto besgos spus dag po zhig dang / gnas mal spus dag po/grogs bzang po zhig de'i thog skyid sdug 'grigs tsam zhig skusgod tshe gtam gal chen po yin/ sprang por gtam la brtsidagos don med pas/ rnam rtog dang phrag dog nyung ba yod/ sprang so rnams ni rang nyid mi yi gral mthar gnas yod pas phra dog dang 'gran sems byed sa bsdad med pas yag po red snyam gyi 'dug de bzhin 'tshul chos kyang phal cher nyung ba yod/de min rgyu dpal 'byor cung zad yod pa rnams phrag dog dang / 'gran sems/ nga rgyal serdzogs mang ba 〈snad pas dka' las khag po yin/ da lta zhus pa

(153) byang chub kyi sems dang/de'i byed las gsum gyi skos bzhin spru cung zad skyes pa rnams kyis gtam gal chen por brtsigi yod/ der brten tshe 'di'i lto gos gtam gsum gyi bde skyed de yang jo bo sems can la brten nas yong dgos pa ha cang gsal po yin/ rang gi gyon gos kyi ras la mtshon na/ zhing pas dka' las brgyab pa dang / 'phrul gsor gyis bzos shing dka' las rgyag mkhan gyi mi de rnams snying rje/ gla phran bu'i don du rngul chu rdzir jir gyis lag pa'i pags pa dregs pas mthug po ma chags bar dka' las brgyab nas byung ba zhig yin/ bal gyi rigs yin tshe sems can gyi lus la brten nas yong ba dang / gnas mal gyi khang par cha bzhag na/ deng skabs khang pa zhig brgyab tshe ar dam dang lcags rigs semags las grub pas/ thog mar lcags rdo bton rgyu dang / yang na ar dam thog mar bzo ba'i rdo bkog mkhan nas bzung ste mi rnams kyis dka' las ha las pa brgyab nas yong ba zhig yin/ma gzhi rang rang so so'i lto gos kyi don du las ka byed mkhan sha stag yin/ 'on kyang mi de rnams kyi lag pa brgyud nas nga rang tsho'i khang pa brgyab chog chog gi rgyu cha rnams byung ba yin/ de bzhin lto chas kyi za 'bru'i rigs dang / tshal gyi rigs/ sha la cha bzhag na de bas kyang yul sems can mang sto brgyud nas yong dgos shing / gtam la cha bzhag na rang gcig pu mi su gcig gis kyang mthong sa med pa zhig tu bya ba bzang po rnam dpyod dang ldan pa zhig byas kyang / gtam snyan grags yong rgyu gang yang med/ mi gzhan gyis mthong ste mi

te sku lagong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (155)gcig gi kha nas gzhan zhig gi rna bar bshad de 'di lta bu'i thog nas gtam snyan grags yong gi yod/ de yang jo bo sems can la brten nas yong dgos pas mi tshe 'di mngal du gnas pa'i skabs su ma yi drin yin pa gsal po yin la/mngal nas btsas te dus da lta bar du nga rang tsho jo so sems can gyi dngos dang brgyud pa'i drin la brten nas 'tsho ba gsal po yin/des na ma shi tshun tshad kyi tshe 'di'i don la cha bzhag kyang / jo bo sems —can gyi drin la brten nas 'tsho bo dang / phyi ma mngon mtho sgrub pa yang jo bo sems can la brten nas yong dgos/ thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa yang jo bo sems can la brten nas yong dgos/ mthar thug rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa yang jo bo sems can la brten nas mardzong dbosgos pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don mtha' dag jo so sems can la brten nas yong dgos pas na/ jo bo sems can la brten nas yerdzong ba shes pa'i thog nas sems can la gces pa'i blo skyes thub na de ni bde skyid kyi rtsab yin pas/ spyod 'jug las/'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung / /zhes gsungs yod/ mdor bsdus na byis pa nga rang tsho dang 'dra ba bde bas phongs lugs dang / sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul dang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa nye bar zhi ba'i gtan du bde zhing / rang don dang gzhan don gnyis ka mthar phyin pa 'di lta bu yong ba gang gi khyad par yin

(156) byang chub kyi sems dang /de'i byed las gsum gyi skyodazhe na/ byis pa nga rang tsho dang m+wa ba so so'i skye bos rang gces legan snying dbus su bcangs nas nyin gyi gnas skabs dang / mtshan mo gnyid kyi gnas skabs sogs nam du yang nga zhes rtsachen por rtsi ba'i dbang gis kha 'thab 'di las ma byung ba yin/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa yong ba ni/ gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i tshul rnams shes pa thog nas bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems la 〈sna kun nas blo kha sdusags pa byed dbesgos pa gtan mdun gyi snying po sgrub pa'i rtsab yin/ byang chub kyi sems skyes pa'i gtso bo nga rang tshos dmigs rnam sbyangs nas blo lda rim gyis bcos nas sgrub dgos pa dang / byang chub kyi sems la myong ba sne zin byung tshe smon pa cho gas bzung na sems brtan po yong ba'i phan thogs chen po yod/de nas spyod pa la slob 'dod sbyang pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa nyan nas spyod pa la slob 'dod sbyangs pa dang / spyod pa la slob 'dod sbyangs nas byang chub sems dpa'i phyin drug gi skyedad pa la slob 'dod shugs drag skyes pa'i mtshams su byang chub sems dpa'i 〈snam pa blangs dbosgos pa yin/ 'di ltar byas te smon sems cho gas bzung ba dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bzung ba gnyis kyi go rim 'di ltar du 'gro dgos pa yin// //

ma gari 41(pa ri'e / 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 157rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub thabs/༄༅/ /de yang ji skad du/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis dbu ma rtsab shes rab kyi mchod brjod du/gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ /spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod phyag ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin du ston pa bcom ldan 'das rang nyid spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing zhi ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi go 'phang mthar thug pa mngon du mdzad nas/ rang gis lam ji m+wa zhig dang / tshul ji lta bu zhig gi thog nas spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing zhi ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i thabs tshul rnams gdul bya la thugs brtse ba chen po'i

(158) rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub thabs/dbang gis 'doms par mdzad pa dang / de yang chos rnams kyi yin lugs rang bzhin stong pa nyid rten 'byung spros pa mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid de rang dbang gi sgo nas 'doms par mdzad cing smra ba zla med pa'i ston pa zhes gsungs yod/ de ni gang zhi rgyu'i spros pa la/las dang nyon mongs rnam rtog las/ /de dag spros las spros pa ni/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa de spros pa gcig yin/ 'on kyang de tsam gyi mi tshad par gnyis su snang ba'i gnyis snang gi spros pa dang / de bzhin chos can gyi spros pa sogs mdor na spros pa yin no cog nye bar zhi ba yin pas/ ji srid stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i mnyam bzhag las slar ldang ba med pa mnyam par bzhag pa'i gnas skabs su chos can gyi spros pa'i snang ba nub kyang / de la gtan du gnas mi thub par mnyam bzhag de las langs pa'i rjes thob kyi skabs su chos can gyi snang ba de rnams slebs yong gi yod/ rgyud bla ma las gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi sa la mnyam rjes 'dres shing mnyam rjes ro gcig pa chags kyi yod/ des na chos can gyi spros pa de rnams nye bar zhi zhing / de lta na yang /dngos po byas pa can la ma reg par/ /rang bzhin 'ba' zhig thugs su chud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar chos rnams kyi yin lugs ji lta ba bzhin du

ca2 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (159)gzigs shing / de ltar gzigs bzhin pa'i mu nas chos can de yang 'gag med du shar ba zhig yong gi yod/ de lta bu'i spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i zhi ba de yong ba la/ bden 'odzin gyi spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi'i dbyings mngon du bya rgyu ni stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab de ga bsgoms nas yun bsring na dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed thub/ 'on kyang de kho na ma yin bzhin du de kho na bzhin du snang ba'i spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi'i dbyings de lta bu mngon du mdzad pa la/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i skabs su stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba de ga shes sgrib kyi gnyen por skyes pa la bsesgod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po'i grogs kyis zin par byas te rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid bsgoms nas/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po byas te de lta bu'i mnyam rjes ro gcig pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed tshul zhig gsungs yod/ yin na yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang / lhag par rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam gyi 'gro stangs rnams shes par byas te/ de nas bltas na de lta bu'i rags pa glo bur ba'i sems kyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba goms shing /goms pa sngon du 'gro ba'i 'phags pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen posgo'i grerdzogs kyis zin pa bcas de tsam gyis shes bya'i sgrib pa'i dngos kyi gnyen po byed mi thub/ shes sgrib dngos kyi gnyen po yong ba la/ yul shin tu phra ba stong pa nyid shes pa tsam gyis mi chog par/ stong pa nyid

(161) rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub thabs/nges byed kyi blo de yang yul can shin tu phra ba snang ba gsum pa gsum gyi mthar shar ba'i gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo la skyes pa'i thog nas de lta bu'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo khyad par ba zhig sgrub ste gnyis snang gi spros pa mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i thog nas yong dgos/des na dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sras kyi thu bo'i gras slob dpon klu yi byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i las mtha' rnam 'byed kyi skabs su/bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar du mgo dang rkang lag sogs sbyin pa gtong ba dang / de bzhin tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / bzod pa sgom pa sogs kyis chos la ji tsam bslabs kyang / de tsam gyis rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang thob mi thub par gsungs yod/ de'i shugs kyis blo rags pas snang ba gsum po ma dag phyin chad la thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob mi thub ces gsungs pa'i gsung de'i shugs las snang gsum tshun chad kyi blo rags pa zhig gis de kho na nyid don mngon du gyur nas de lta bu'i stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'phags pa'i ye shes mngon du byas nas lan grangs du mar goms kyang des snang ba gsum gyi gnyen po byed mi thub/ des na thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob thub pa zhig mi yong zhes gsung gi yod/der brten yul stong pa nyid rtogs pa tsam gyis mi chog par yul stong pa nyid rtogs mkhan gyi blo lda snang gsum 'gags pa'i rjes kyi blo phra mo zhig yong

da༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (161)dgos/ gang lags she na/ rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po'i rigs 'dra'i nyer len gyi rgyur 'gro mkhan ni de lta bu'i 'od gsal gnyug ma'i blo zhig dgos pa las/rags pa slo bur ba'i blo zhig gis rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po'i nyer len gyi rgyur 'gro mi thub/ de ni dngos po'i gnas tshul yin pas/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing zhi ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i sgrub byed mthar thug pa ni/ rags pa glo bur ba'i shes pa 'gags nas phra ba gnyug ma'i 'od gsal thog ma dang mtha' ma med pa/ kun tu bzang po de lta bu'i gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de lam du skyes nas sgom pa zhig byung na/ des rnam mkhyen sgrub thub pa zhig yong ba gsungs yod/snang ba gsum po dag pas ni/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa yin/ der brten spyir nga rang tsho'i gsang sngags kyi gzhung tshang mas sku gsum gyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa ni/ sngags lam la ma brten par sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob mi thub ces gsung gi yod/ spyir ni blo gcig la thabs shes gnyis sha'i gnad tshang ba zhig pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i skabs nas gsungs med/ yang sgos lhag par can du gsang sngags bla med kyi skabs nas gnyug ma'i 'od gsal zhes sems la phra rags phye nas rags pa glo bur ba'i sems de rnams btsan thabs su 'gog thabs byas shing / de nas gnyug ma'i 'od gsal yul 'jal rung gi rnam par gsal bar skyes pa'i thog

(162) rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub thabs/nas des rnal 'gror du skyes nas lam bgrod pa zhig gsungs yod/des na ri bo dge lugs par cha bzhag na/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs su rje rin po ches ha cang gsal por gsungs yod/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i kun rtog srid pa 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rkyen ni kun rtog gi dbang las yong gi yod pas na/ rang bzhin brgyad bcu'i kun rtog dang / de nyid gang las shar ba'i rgyu ni/ snang mched thob gsum ste snang gsum zhon pa'i rlung dang bcas pa 'gags pa'i rjes su shar ba'i thams cad stong pa 'od gsal zhes gsungs pa de mngon du byas shing / de nas rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rigs 'dra'i thun mong ma yin pa'i nyer len gyi rgyu skyes pa tsam du ma zad/ rnal 'byor de'i steng nas gzugs sku sgrub pa'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa zhig sgrub yong ba 'di ltar yin/de bzhin dpal dus kyi gsor lo'i skabs nas kyang / gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de nyid lam du byed pa rtsal 'don byas nas gsung gi yod/ gzugs sku sgrub pa'i rgyu ni/ yang stong gzugs kyi sku sgrub pa zhig gsungs te mi 'dra ba zhig yong gi yod/ rtsab de dag gnyis gas 'od gsal de nyid lam du byed pa gcig mtshungs yin/ mchesgog mi 'gyur gyi bde ba lta bu'i thog nas gnyug ma'i 'od gsal mngon du byed pa de ga yin/dpal sa skya pa'i skabs su yin yang snang gsum gyis thun mong gi lam de dag sbyangs shing / de nas thog mar rgyud gsum gyi rnam gzhag gi thog nas

tshoneri 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (162)kun gzhi rgyud rgyu zhes pa de gtan la phab nas de lam du byed pa'i rnal 'byor rim par gsungs pa dang / mdor na gnyug ma'i 'od gsal la kun gzhi'i ming btags na/ kun gzhi'i rten dkyil gabor gzhi dang bcas pa zhes kun gzhi'i rgyud rgyu gsungs pa'i thog nas gnyug ma'i 'od gsal lam du byed pa de gsung gi yod/de bzhin du phyag chen dang rdzogs chen pa dag gis kyang gnyug ma'i 'od gas la nyid rtsal 'don byas te nyams len byed pa zhig gsung gi yod/dper na/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos rje rin po che'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor dag rim gyi 'grel pa'i nang gi 'chi ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer gyi skabs der klu sgrub yab sras kyis rlung gi rnal 'byor la brten nas 'od gsal mngon du byed thabs zhes pa zhig gsungs pa dang / de nas bsgom rnying ma ba rnams kyis 'od gsal mngon du byed thabs de rtsarlung gi rnal 'byor la bltos pa med par mi rtog pa sgom pa kho na'i steng nas 'od gsal mngon du byed pa de gsungs yod/des na phyag rgya chen po'i skabs nas rtsegacig dang / spros bral/ ro gcig zhes pa de phal cher 'di'i skabs nas yong gi med dam snyam/ yang sngon gyi mkhas pa so so'i gsung stangs mi 'dra ba phran bu re yod/ hob ste bltas na rtse gcig gi skabs su gtso bo bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i thog

(164) rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub thabs/nas zhi gnas sgom pa dang / spros bral gyi skabs su bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid sgom pa/ gcig byas na de la rdzogs rim gyi cha med dam snyam/ gtso bo ni ro gcig gi skabs nas phal cher gnyug ma'i 'od gsal nyag cig rtsal du bton nas bsgom pa 'di ltar min nam snyam/ de nas slob pa'i zung 'jug gi skabs su slebs skabs/de thob nas gsar slob mi dgos kyang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar lam gsar du bslab rgyu med pas 〈snam med ces pa de'i steng du phal cher slebs yong gi yod/ der brten gnyug ma'i 'od gsal nyag cig sgom gyi yod pas na/ rags pa slo bur ba'i sgom las 'das pa yin/rdzogs pa chen po'i skabs su'ang de bzhin yin la/ gsham du rim pas thon rgyu yin/1 zab mo stong pa nyid kyi de kho na nyid de yang ji ma ji bzhin gsung gi yod/yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i skabs nas gsungs pa dang / de yang kun mkhyen rnam pa gnyis ga'i gsung gi nang du tha snyad du yang rang mtshan 'gog pa'i lugs de yin pa ha cang gsal po yin/de bzhin phyis kyi mkhan po ngag chung gi gsung nang rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid nan tan byas te gsung yong gi yod/ khong ni dus phyis kyi snga 'jir rnying ma/'i bī la'i yang srid ces gsung gi yod la/ khong ni thun mong ma yin pa zhig red 'dug grub pa'i dbang phyug phal cher zung 'jug gi rtogs pa'i mtshams su

da ci lagong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (165skephebs pa zhig min nam snyam/ ha las pa zhig red 'dug khong nyid sku gzhon nu'i skabs nas gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bag chags sad pa zhig yin la/ mkhas pa la cha bzhag kyang / mkhas pa chen po zhig red 'dug khong gis rje rin po che'i mdo sngags kyi lam rim gnyis smos ci dgos/ rje rin sto che'i 'jug ṭika dang / rtsaṭika dag kyang gsan gnang mdzad 'dug pas khong ni gzhung mang po gsan mkhan zhig red 'dug rtsod pa'i thog nas zhib phra sbyangs gnang yod med mi shes kyang /mkhas pa chen po red 'dug khong gi gsung nang ye shes bla ma'i rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi khrid yig gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 〈snad pa yin/ de'i nang ha cang gsal sto yod/ rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid ces pa ha cang shugs chen po yod/des na dbu ma'i lta ba tha snyad du'ang rang mtshan mi bzhed pa de gzhir bzhag yin/gzhi med rtsabral zhes pa ni tha snyad du yang rang mtshan 'gog pa'i tshig de thon yong gi 'dug snyam/ dper na/ rang rgyud pa'i 'dod pa ltar na gzhi med pa rang min/ pha rol don nam yul gyi ngos nas 'jog dgos pa yin/ des na gzhi med rtsabral chags kyi med/ rkyen nyid 'di pa tsam smra ba'i grub mtha' de'i lugs kyi thog nas bshad na yul gyi ngos nas grub pa cung zad kyang med pas gzhi med yin la/ rang bzhin rtsab nas bral ba zhig yin/ bden pa'i dngos po rtsab nas med pa ha cang gsal po 'dug mdor na mdo sngags thun mong gi dbu ma'i lta ba de rnams rdzogs chen pa'i gzhung nang rigs 'ga' zhig gsal po yod la/

(166) rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub thabs/rigs 'ga' zhig gsal po med/ des na gsal ma gsal tsam yin/gsang sngags gsar ma la bzhag na/ rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid de sngags bla med kyi gzhung dag gi nang mdor bsdus te yong gi med/ 'on kyang mdor bsdus tsam las ma gsungs pa des mi dgos pa'i don min/ de ni thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs zin pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ dper na/bla ma mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig tshe 'dir bslab pa slob gnyer byas nas de tsam mi shes mkhan zhig yin yang / bla ma mtshan ldan zhig gis nyams tshungang gi steng nas gsung skabs don la 'grigs yod pa yin/ dper na/ rdo grub 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung nang / mig sgrib pa zhig sman pa mkhas pa zhig gis mig de kha phye na/ mig kha phye ba'i rjes su dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa'i gzugs rnams kyi snang ba 'char ba de zur du sgrub mi dgos par/ mig sgrib phye ba tsam gyis phyi rol gyi mthong bar byed pa'i gzugs rnams rang bzhin gyis mthong ba'i dpe ltar nyams myong can gyi bla mas snod ldan gyi slob ma la rig pa kun tu bzang po'am rang byung gi rig pa de ngo sprad nas/ ngo 'phrod pa zhig gis nyams myong gi rtogs pa skye ba zhig byung na/ chos thams cad de yi rnam 'gyur dang / de yi rol pa/ de yi cho 'phrul yin pa zhig mthong skabs/ ming tsam brda tsam rtog pas btags tsam yin pa de zhar la shes yong ba yin zhes gsungs yod/mdor na rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung la nyams len byed mkhan de yis

pā/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (167)medosngagasathun mong gi dbu ma'i lta ba de tshig rgyas bsdus gang zhig yin yang /gzhi med rtsabral zhes brjod skabs tshig kha nas skyor ba zhig min/ de ni blo'i zhe phugs nas phyi nang gi snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad don gyi ngos nas grub pa cung zad tsam yang med pa zhig mdo sngags thun mong gi dbu ma'i lta ba'i thog nas nges pa zhig chags kyi yod/ snying don go dgos pa zhig chags kyi yod/yang rdzogs chen po yod tshad kyi de ltar brjod kyi yod med mi shes/ phyis kyi rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dngos slob sprul sku tshul blo'i rdzogs chen gyi khrid yig nang ha cang gsal po 'dug mdo sngags thun mong gi dbu ma'i lta ba rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid med na rdzogs chen gyi nyams len gnad la 'khel ba zhig mi yong zhes gsungs 'byud/ de bzhin mkhas pa mi pham gyi gsung nang rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la thal gyur ba'i lta ba de sngon 'gror nges par du dgos zhes gsungs pa de ltar yin/de ltar dngos gzhi sgom pa'i gnas skabs su nam rgyun ma yin dgag ces gsungs pa ltar bdag med kyi lta ba gtan la phab nas rang bzhin med pa yin pa de tsam sgom pa zhig min par dngos gzhi sgom pa'i skabs su rig pa kun tu bzang po de ngo sprad nas ngo 'phrod pa zhig byung ba'i mtshams su rig pa'i ngo bo bskyangs nas 'gro ba de chags kyi yod/ sngar rang bzhin med pa gtan la phab zin pa'i gang zag cig gis rig pa'i ngo bo skyong skabs snang yang mi bden pa sgyu

(168) rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub thabs/ma lta bu blor 'char gyi yod/ de ni sngon la ma yin dgag sgom pa de chags kyi yod pa yin/des na rdo grub 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas gsungs pa ltar dbu ma'i lta ba gtan la phab pa'i gnas skabs su lta ba med dgag gi lugs de gtso bo dang / sgom pa'i gnas skabs su ma yin dgag gi sgom tshul de gtso bor slebs yong gi yod ces gsungs pa ltar yin/ de tsam du ma zad rje bdag nyid chen ngo/sa gsang 'dus rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron gyi snying po bsdus pa rdzogs rim bden rdzogs kyi nang du'ang re zhig stong nyid mi sgom par bde chen skyong ba zhes pa'i tshig cig thon yong gi yod/ de gnyis gcig mtshungs chags yod/ der brten bde chen skyong mkhan de stong nyid nges pa zhig yin na/ bde chen skyong ba'i skabs su ma yin dgag sgom pa zhig phal cher chags yong gi yod/ de rnams gnad la bab pa gcig pa yin pa de ha cang gsal po yin/mdo don ngas da lta 'dir zhu dgos pa ni/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing zhi ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi dbyings de mngon du byed pa la/ rtsab shes rab kyi skabs nas 〈snas thams cad rang bzhin med pa gtan la phab pa de tsam gyis mi chog par/ sngags bla med kyi skabs nas gsungs pa'i glo bur ba'i kun rtog thams cad bkag cing sel ba'i shul du gnyug ma'i shes pa zhig yod pa de nyid lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa des de kho na nyid kyi don mngon du byas nas/ de yis snang

3 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (169)gsum tshun chad kyi glo bur ba'i rtog tshogs thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'gags nas skyes pa zhig yin pas na/ de'i thog nas rnam mkhyen mngon du byed dgos/de lta bu'i gnyug ma'i shes pa de lam gyi ngo bor skye thabs la/ gong du zhus pa ltar gsang sngags gsar ma'i skabs nas kyang thams cad kyis gnad bab sa de'i thog tu bab kyi yod/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i skabs su'ang gnad bab sa de'i steng du bab kyi yod/ mi 'dra ba ni rdzogs pa chen so a ti yo ga nyams su len pa'i skabs rtsarlung thig le'i rnal 'byor mi dgos par/ thad kur rig pa rjen la phud nas de nyid ngo 'phrod pa'i thog nas de'i nyams myong mngon du gyur nas 〉sgom thub pa zhig byung na/ tshogs drug gi shes pa 'gag pa la mi bltos par tshogs drug gi shes pa mngon du gyur bzhin pa'i thog nas dang / kun rtog gi g.yo ba yod bzhin pa'i ngang nas shes pa mtha' dag la til 'bru snum khyab kyi tshul du yod pa'i rig cha la ngo sprad nas de ga rig pa bskyangs ded thub pa zhig byung na/ kun rtog de rnams rang bzhin gyis shugs je chung du 'gro ba zhig dang /mthar 'gag 'gro ba zhig yong gi yod/ de ni rdzogs chen pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'gro stangs shig red 'dug des na gnad 'gag chen po zhig 'dugakha sang zhus pa ltar bden 'dzin spong ba la bdag med kyi lta ba bsgom dgos pa gcig dang / bden 'dzin bag chags dang bcas pa spong ba la/ yul gyi 'od gsal stong pa nyid sgom pa tsam gyis mi chog par stong nyid de nyid sgom

(171) rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang sgrub thabs/mkhan gyi blo de yang rags pa glo bur ba'i shes pa mtha' dag 'gags nas shin tu phra ba gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i 'od gsal gyis sgom pa zhig dbosgos pa yin/ de yong ba la sngags bla med kyi lam kho na la brten nas yong dgos pa las/lam 'og ma nas yong rgyu med pa yin/de sgom stangs la rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skad ltar byas na/ skyes pa mahā yo ga'i skabs nas sgom tshul gcig dang / lung a nu yo ga'i skabs nas sgom stangs gcig de nas rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga la'ang sems sde'i skabs nas sgom stangs gcig dang / slong sde'i skabs nas sgom stangs gcigaman ngag sde'i skabs nas sgom stangs gcigade la'ang phyi bskor dang /nang bskor/gsang skor/ yang gsang bla med bcas kyi thog nas sgom stangs bcas mi 'dra ba ha cang mang po yod/ sems sde la'ang nang gses kyis sems sde bdun tsam yong gi yod/ slong sde la'ang klong sde dkar nag khru gsum sogs bzhi tsam yong gi yod pas zhib phra ngas mi shes/ khyed rang tshos kyang dpyis phyin pa shes kyi yod med mi shes/ tshig spam po re brjod thub na las ji ma ji bzhin shes pa sku mnyes sto yin 'gro/ yun ring po ma sbyangs na shes thabs med/ de lta bu'i rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i lam thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len wa la/ sngon la blo rim gyis sbyangs nas 'gro dgos nga sa na/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnams sngon du btang nas bsgom dgos pa yin// //

mo sde'isna 31/rdzu ri'eji/7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 171sa lam rim bgrod kyis rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub tshul /༄༅/ /de yang dga' ldan lha brgya ma las ji skad du/skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces gsungs pa ltar nga rang tsho rang gzhan rogs gsum su zhig yin yang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang bde ba 'dod pa sha stag yin zhing / de lta bu'i sdug bsngal de yang gtso bo lus tshor la brten pa'i sdug bsngal gcig dang /gtso bo yid blo ltog pa'i steng nas yong ba'i sdug bsngal gcig bcas sdug bsngal la rigs gnyis yod/ de bzhin bde ba la'ang rigs gnyis yod pa nga tshos shes pa de yin/ lus kyi sdug bsngal ni tha snyad rang mtshan pa'i sdug bsngal zhig yin la/yid blo ltog pa'i steng gi bde sdug mang po zhig rnam rtog gis bcos nas yong ba zhig yin/

(172) sa lam bgrod de rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub tshul/dper na/ lus kyi sdug bsngal zhig yin na/ dgra phyogs kyi mde'u phog nas rmas pa de dang / gnyen nam rang phyogs kyi mde'u phog nas rmas pa gnyis lus tshor gyi sdug bsngal gcig pa yin/ dgra phyogs kyi mde'u de sdug pa zhig dang / gnyen gyi phyogs kyi mde'u de yag pa gang yang med/ 'on kyang nang gi bsam blo'i thog nas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod/ dper na/ rigs 'ga' zhig gis nang khul gyis nor nas me mda' brgyab pa red ces brjod na sems nang khong khro mi za ba sku(da shas che/ rigs 'ga' zhig ni dgra yis me mda' brgyab pa chos nyid yin yang / nang khul me mda' brgyab pa gang 'dra zhig yin nam bsams te khong khro za ba sdug pa yong srid/ gang ltar bsam blo'i gtong phyogs kyi thog nas khyad par chen po yong gi yod/lus kyi sdug bsngal ni rang mtshan lta bu zhig yin/ 'on kyang bsam blo'i nang du gcig a'u tsam red snyam pa dang / cig shos la mi bzod pa lta bu yong ba dper na/ mi gcig la dmigs nas mi gcig gis 'di nga'i gnyen yin zhes dga' po byed pa dang / mi gcig gis 'di nga'i dgra yin zhes mi dga' ba byed pa de gnyis thad gar lus la phan gnod gang yang med kyang / nang gi bsam blo'i thog nas 'du shes legan stangs la khyad par chen po yod/ dper na/ de ring phan chad nga'i gnyen yin zhes dga' po byes sa'i mi zhig gis rang la gtam ngan brjod pa zhig go thos byung na/ khos kyang nga la 'di ltar brjod kyi 'dug snyam nas

teri 7gong mu 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (172)sang nyin mi de dgra la mthong ba lta bu yong gi yod/ de dag ni bsam blo gtong stangs dbang gis bde sdug yong ba yin/ des na lus tshor gyi bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni dud 'gro dang nga tsho thun mong la skusgod pa yin/ des na sdug bsngal sel thabs dang / bde ba 〈snang thabs byed dgos pa yin la/ byed 'os pa zhig kyang yin/ sdug bsngal rtsab nas sel thub pa ni re zhig las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can gyi phung po zhig yod phyin la yong thabs med/ 'on kyang rim bzhin sdug bsngal gyi rten byed pa'i skye ba rtsad nas gcod thub pa zhig byung na/ lus tshor gyi sdug bsngal kyang sel thub pa yin/gtso bo ni nga rang tsho gson pa'i ring nang bsam blo'i thog nas bde sdug yong ba de la/ bsam blo gtong phyogs kyi khyad par ha cang chen so yod/dper na/ nga tsho bod pa'i spyir btang gi bsam blo gtong tshul ni/ phal cher nang bsam blo'i sdug bsngal dang dngangs skrag cung zad nyung ba yod/dper na/nga rang tshor dka' ngal 'phrad pa de rigs la rang bzhin bsam blo'i nang de ni nga rang gi las yin bsam pa'i las 'bras kyi lta tshul sgyusgog nas rang la sdug bsngal byung ba de la ha cang ma 'os pa zhig byung sesgong bsam pa'i sems la khong khro dang /mi bzod lta bu byed pa cung nyung ba yod/ yang bsam glo de las kyang cung zad rgya che ru btang na/ gsor ba'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra rang red bsam pa dang / mdor na las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can gyi srid pa 'khor ba'i 'jig rten 'dir bkra mi

(174ga sa lam bgrod de rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub tshul/shis pa las yostong rgyu med bsam pa'i bsam blo 'khor ba de'i tshod kyis bsam blo'i nang nga la shin tu ma 'os pa zhig byung bsam pa'i nad mi lusag pa dang / mi bzod pa byed pa de nyung ba yong ba yin/ de nas kyang da dung bsam blo rgya che ru btang na/sdug na kun gyi sdug bsngal 'khur/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par 31ga /skyid na bde ba tshogs su bsngo/ /phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar sgo(ga /ces gsungs pa ltar sdug pa zhig byung na des gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gyi skra( lhusgod pa'i bsam blosna btang ste/ nam mkha'i mthas gnyugs pa'i sems can mtha' dag gi sdug bsngal nga rang gi sdug bsngal de'i thog tu smin par sgo(ga bsam pa'i bsam blo btang na/ sdug bsngal myangs pa de myang dgos chod pa yin/ de bzhin skyed pa zhig byung na/skyed na bde ba tshogs su bsngo/ /phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar sgo(ga /ces gsungs pa ltar skyid pa zhig byung na rang gis sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu bde skyed thams cad nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can gyi ched du bsngos nas smon lam brgyab na skyid pa'i skyid go chod pa lta bu yong gi yod/ sdug po byung bas sems zhum pa dang khong khro langs pa lta bu

ril༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (176)med la/ yang skyed po byung bas nga rgyal dang rnam g.yeng lta bu med par nam yang sems pa de gcig tu gnas thub pa yoteng gi mardzod/mi tshe 'dir cha bzhag kyang / bsam blo'i gtong phyogs kyis khyad par chen po yod/ de lta bu'i gnas lugs shes pa la/ blang dor gyi gnas ston mkhan zhig da〈snas pa ni ha cang gal 'gangs chen po yin/ tshe 'di'i bya ba chung chung zhig yin yang gzhan gyi slob ston la brten nas shes thabs byed dgos kyi yod/ der brten nga rang tsho'i nang bsam blo la 'gyur ba thebs pa la/ bsam blo zhes pa de ji 'dra zhig gi thog nas yong gi yod pa dang / de la'ang nang phan tshun mi mthun pa'am/ 'dzin stangs 'gal ba'i blo gang dang gang zhig yod pa/ de dag rkyen gang dag yod pa/ grogs ji ltar byed kyi yod pa'i tshul rnams shes dgos pa yin/de shes pa'i thog nas sdug bsngal bar byed mkhan dang / ma skyed par bzo mkhan gyi blo de sel thabs la de'i ldog phyogs kyi blo de rigs gang dag yin pa rtsad bcad nas de dag dang du blangs shing / sdug bsngal bar byed mkhan gyi glo de la mi 'dod par bltas nas dang du mi len pa lta bu byas na bsam blo'i nang du 'gyur ba thebs thub pa gtan gtan 〈snang ba yin/ de ltar byung na tshe phyi ma mthong rgyu med kyang / tshe 'di ga gsesgon pa'i ring la gtan gtan sems skyid pa yong ba brgya cha brgya gtan khel ba yin/de ltar sems skyid pa byung na lus kyi 'byung ba cha snyoms shing / 'byung

(176) sa lam bgrod de rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub tshul/ba rang bab su gnas rgyu de'i thog nas lus bde ba yong zhing / mdor na lus bde ba dang sems skyid pa yong ba des rang nyid tsam ma yin par rang gi nye lubor du yosgod pa'i mi rnams la don med kyi 'khrug rtsod dang / phrag dog 'gran sems byas nas rnyog dra bzo ba lta bu phal cher mi yong ba yin/ der brten rang nyid bde ba'i zhor la gzhan rnams la'ang bde ba yong gi yod/de las ldog ste nyon mongs drag po'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa yin na/ rang nyid skyid sto med la/ rang nyid ma skyid pa'i zhor la g.yas g.yon mi bde ba bzos pa dang / khong khro dang tshig za byas tshe stod sgal na ste dbugs ring btang nas sdod dgos pa yong gi yod/ de ltar rang nyid ma skyed pa'i zhar la dga' nye blo dkar rnams kyang 'khrugs nas ma skyid pa bcas de 'dra'i ngang nas mi tshe sdusang na phangs po yin/ yang mi de rigs la rig rtsal dang / dpal 'byor/ chab srid bcas kyi nus pa chen po yerdzod na/ sems 'khrug dus gnod 'tshe chen po bzo snyan skusgod/'das pa'i lo gnyis kyi gong du a ri'i ni'u yog gi khang chen gtor dus nga'i bsam blo'i nang / mi zhes pa 'di'i blo ma dul bar nga rgyal dang / zhe snang / phrag dog khon 'dzin bcas kyi bsam pa shugs chen po 〈snad na/ mi de'i rnam dpyod khon 'dzin dang / zhe gnag gi bsam pa dang zung du 'brel ba'i kun nas bslangs na nyen kha chen po yod/ deng skabs 'dzam gling 'di'i thog lag rtsal yar rgyas chen po song ba des gtor bshig ha cang chen po gtong ba'i gnas

2 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (177)tshul yong gi 'dug der brten mi'i sems dul po ma byung na/ rang gzhan rogs gsum tshang ma phung la sbyodar zhing / mi lus byur po che zhes gsungs pa ni/ skyes tsam nyid nas mi lus byur po che min yang / nar son pa'i skabs su bsam blo gtong stangs nyon mongs rags pa'i gzhan dbang du song na/ de ni mi lus byur po che chags pa yin/ dngos gnas phan sems dang / ya rabs kyi bsam blo mardzod na/ de ni mi lus rin po che chags pa yin/mdor na nga rang tsho'i bsam slo gtong stangs shes dgos pa dang / de shes pa la ston mkhan zhig dbosgos pa yin/ der bstan bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gal chen sto chags yod/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji tsam gal chen po yin pa de tsam gyis de dag mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig dgos rgyu gal chen po yin/ dper na/ nga rang tsho slob sbyong byed mkhan zhig la cha bzhag na/ slob sbyong de tsam gyi tshad mtho po med mkhan zhig la/ dge rgan yang de tsam gyi tshad longs pa zhig med kyang gnad 'gag che ba med/ slob sbyong tshad mtho po nang don gting zab po dang / rgya chen po byed mkhan zhig yin na de'i tshod kyis dge rgan yang shes yon tshad dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du nga rang tsho'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes pa mtshan nyid tshang skyib zhig dgos rgyu ha cang gal 'gangs chen po yin/ der brten ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dam chos 'dul ba'i gnas kyi bla ma'i mtshan nyid nas bzung rgyud kyi rdo rje slob dpon bar gyi bla

(178) sa lam bgrod de rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub tshul/ma'i mtshan nyid gzhung sesgo serdzo'i skabs rnam gzhag zhib phra gsungs nas gal cher brtsis pa gnang don 'di ltar ro//des na nga rang tshos bla ma mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig btsal nas/ de la brten te sems rgyud 'dul thabs byed dbostos pa yin/ nga tshos da lta bar byed ma myong ba'i las dang / rgyus med kyi lam la zhugs kyi yod pas/ lam ston byed mkhan zhig dgos shing / nga tsho'i nang bsam blor bsgyur bcos gtong ba'i lam ston mkhan ni bla ma yin/ bla ma de yang rang nyid la shes tshad yod pa tsam gyis mi chog par nyams myong yod pa zhig dgos/ der brten lung gi yon tan yod pas ma tshad/ lung don tshul bzhin bsgrubs te sgrub pa nyams len gyi nyams smyu1nga 〈snad pa zhig dbosgos pa yin/mdor na mkhas grub gnyis ldan te mkhas pa'i yoston tan 〈snad la/ grub pa'i yon tan yang yod pa zhig dgos/ de lta bu'i bla ma rang gis bsten nas de'i rjes su bslabs te 'bad brtson byas na/ tshe smad kyi mi tshe de tshe stod dang mi 'dra ba zhig yong nges yin/ de ni bla ma'i bka' bzhin rang gis 'bad brtson byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ do nub nyal ba'i skabs su mi phal pa zhig sang therdzogs langs pa'i skabs su glo bur 'gyur song ba de m+wa re zung bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / sngon bosgoms bag chags sad nas 〈snang gi 〈snad na las de min khag po yin/ 'gyur ba ni rim pas 'grerdzo dbesgos pa zhig yin/

— ༄ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (179)nga rang tshor cha bzhag na/ da lta'i rang gi bsam blo dang / lo lnga'i gong gi bsam blo gnyis la khyad par gang 'dug bsam blo btang na/ 'ordzo lnga drug bosgong gi bsam blo gtong stangs dang / da lta'i bsam blo gtong stangs gnyis la cung cad mi 'dra ba yod pa gsal po shes thub/ lo lnga drug gong bsam blo'i nang zhi bde ji tsam 'dug pa dang / deng skabs rang gi bsam blo gtong stangs la yar rgyas kyi 'gyur ba phran bu phyin pa des rang gi snying stobs che ru song ba dang / de'i dbang gis dngangs skrag dang / re dogs kyi rnam rtog 'dra min yong ba de dag kyang nyung du phyin nas sems stod shig shig gi tshor ba mang ba 〈snad pa shes thub/ 'di ltar byas te sems rim pas yar rgyas skusgong gi 'byud/ kha sa'i sems dang de ring gi sems gnyis bsdur nas yar rgyas song ba mthong mi thub/ nyin skyed zhag skyed thon zhes pa ni/ slob sbyong lta bu la mtshon na nyin skyed zhag skyed yong zhing / kha sang ma shes pa zhig de ring shes pa yong gi yod/ 'on kyang sems kyi 'gyur ba la nyin skyed zhag skyed phar bzhag zla skyed kyang yong rgyu khag po yin/ lo skyed yong rgyur phal cher re ba byed chog pa de yang khag po yin/ yun ring bsam blo gtong ba dang / yun ring dmigs rnam sbyangs nas rim pas bgrod thabs byas na/ 'dus byas sesgo na mi gnas pa yin pas/ 'ebyu brgyar mi skye snyam pa zhig kyang da gdod na skye 'ong zhes bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros su yosgod pa bzhin gtan gtan sems la 'gyur ba 'gro ba 〈snang thub/

(180ga sa lam bgrod de rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub tshul/nga rang la cha bzhag na/ sems la 'gyur ba thebs pa'i rlabs chen po'i yon tan gang yang med kyang / dpag tshod kyi lo bcu nyi shu'i gong dang / lo sum cu bzhi bcu'i gong / de nas kyang lo lnga bcu'i gong bcas la bsam blo btang na/bsam blo'i nang 'gyur ba gtan gtan song 'dug nga rang tsho tshang ma mi gcig pa yin/ rang nyid kyis 'bad rtsol byas te bsam blo gtong stangs shes pa zhig dang /de ltar shes pa'i thog nas 'bad rtsol yag po zhig byas na/ gtan gtan rim pas 'gyur ba thebs thub pa zhig yosgong rgyu dang / 'gyur ba thebs pa'i 'bras bur mi de lhod shig shig cig yong gi yod/ de ltar mi tshe 'di bzang po zhig bskyal thub pa byung na yag po yin/rje btsun mi la'i rnam par thar pa'i rjes su bslabs nas de ltar byed thub rgyu rang gzhan su yin yang khag po yin/ de ltar ma byung rung nyon mongs zhes pa de rang gi nang gi dgra yi gtso bo yin pa ngo shes nas nyon mongs dang du mi len pa zhig byung na/ gtan gtan mi tshe la 'gyur ba 〈snang rgyu yin/ de ltar rang nyid gson pa'i ring 'gyur ba je bzang du 'gro ba zhig byung na/ 'chi khar gtan gtan dge sems khyad par can skye thub pa zhig yong zhing / de ltar byung na skye ba phyi ma skye gnas gang 'dra zhig tu skye min ni/ gal 'gangs che sgo(sa 'chi kha'i dge sems stobs che chung la rag lus skusgod/ dus rgyun mi sdig pa gsesgog mkhan zhig yin yang / 'chi khar dge sems 〉rtobs ldan zhig skyes na/ skye ba phyi ma lan

/dwa spu lagong sa 7skyabs mgon chen sto mchog (181)gcig bzang po zhig thob rgyu thag lhusgod pa yin/ 'chi khar dge sems khyad par can zhig skye ba'i rkyen gtso bo gcig skabs der dge sems kyi gsal 'debs byed mkhan gal chen po yin yang / gtso bo'i nang gi gtso bo ni/ dus rgyun nas dge ba'i blo la goms cha 〈snad pa zhig yin na/ 'chi khar dge sems khyad par can skye thub pa'i re ba chen po yod/ de min rang gi ngos nas dge sems skye ba zhig med pa'am yang na 'jags snang dang / gnyen nye du/ bu phrug longs spyod sesgogs la chags nas chags sems drag po'i gzhan dbang du sesgong ba'i mu nas grongs pa yin na thabs skyo po yin/yang zhe sdang shugs drag pos nga'i dgra de dang 'di 'dul rgyur lus pa de'i sngon la nga rang shi song bsam ste khong khro'i ngang nas shi na ha cang thabs skyo po yin/ de ltar 'chi khar nyon mongs mngon gyur shugs drag po zhig byung na/ gshin po de'i rjes su phyag mchod 'bul byas kyang phan thogs yong rgyu khag po yin/ bla ma rtogs pa ldan zhing mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig yod na phran bu phan thogs yong shas che/ de min 'pho ba rgyag rgyu sesgogs ni ha cang khag po yin/ mthar gtugs nas bshad na bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin zhes gsungs yod pa dang /bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi kyang /ngas ni khyod la thar pa'i lam bstan gyis/ /thar pa rang la rag las shes par gyis/ /zhes rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lta ba'i rnam gzhag gi thog nas

(182) sa lam bgrod de rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub tshul/gsungs pa ltar/ 'bras bu bzang ngan gang zhig yong min rang nyid kyi lag tu yod pa las/ mi gzhan zhig gis bzo thub rgyu ha cang khag po yin/ der brten nga rang tsho tshang mas mi tshe bzang po skyel thabs dang / rgyun du dge sems yag sto sgom thub pa byung na 'chi khar dge sems yag so skye thub pa yong rgyu dang / de ltar byung na skye ba phyi ma skyes gnas bzang po zhig thob rgyu yin/ tshe 'dir bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig tshul bzhin du bsten pa yin na/ de'i rjes mthun gyi 'bras bur skye ba phyi ma yang bla ma mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig mjal ba dang /de'i gnas skabs su tshe sngon dge bar goms pa'i bag chags kyis sad de nyams len la brtsone ba zhig yong rgyu yin/ des na/skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces gsungs pa yin/ de ltar nga rang tsho'i smon lam 'grub pa zhig yong ba la/ smon lam brgyab pa gcig pu ma yin par don lag len tu bstar nas 'esgo rgan drug cu bdun cur slebs kyang bla ma mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig bsten te de'i drung nas sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya che chung la ma bltos par rkang grangs tshang ba zhig zhus te/ shes rab snying po las/ tabya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te so rnyi swāhā/ zhes song zhig song zhig pha rol tu song zhig pha rol tu yang

2 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (183gdag par song zhig byang chub tu zhi'o zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdor na lam la ji ltar byas te bslab nas bgrod tshul gyi rtsaba'i sgrom gzhi shes pa byed dbo sa rgyu ha cang gal 'gangs chen po yin/da lta nyon mongs dug gsum gyi gzhan dbang du yod pa'i ma rungs pa'i sems 'di ji ltar byas te rim pas 'gyur ba yong bar byed pa'i tshul rnams shes pa'i thog nas lam nyams len byed rgyu zhig byung na/ bsam blo'i nang byed stangs 'di 'dra yin bsam pa'i tshod thig pa dang / lag len thog kyang sa lam rim gyis bgrerdzod tshul 'di 'dra zhig yin bsam pa sems la nges thub pa yong rgyu yin/ de ltar 'char gzhi cha tshang blo ngor nges thub na yag po yod/ der brten nga rang tsho tshang mas smon lam brgyab pa ltar don de 'grub pa zhig yong ba la sbyordzor ba lag len gyi thog nas rgyu rkyen bsgrub dgos pa yin/ de ltar rgyu rkyen bsgrub pa'i tshul ma nor ba'i gzhung cha tshang ba zhig nyan nas nyams len la brtsone dgos pa yin no// // riciringawa stse wa wa sde —

slob ston pa/rnam grwa mkhan posna/ khrom thog rin po che ma〈snagasku sger drung che/ bre srang tshe ring lags/sku sger sku zhabs/ byams bstan lags/rnam grwa sku zhabs/ bstan 'dzin nyi ma lags/zhu dag pa/ sku zhabs byams bstan lags/rgyab sha jus 'bosgod pa/rnam grwa sgra brnyan sde tshan gyi las byed/ bstan 'dzin don yod/deb gzugs jus 'god/nyi smon glog klad sde tshan/yig 'beb dang glog klad du 'jug 'god/— rnam grwa thub bstan ya ra 'pheg
